‣ Respecting Privacy : The app is designed with privacy in mind - does not identify people, does not track, and does not collect personal information. Ads-free.

‣ Saves Your Battery and Space : Doesn’t drain your battery like other navigation apps. Compact maps save precious space on your phone.
‣ Free and Built by the Community : People like you helped build the app by adding places to OpenStreetMap, testing and giving feedback on features and contributing their development skills and money.
‣ Open and Transparent Decision-making and Financials, Not-for-profit and Fully Open Source. 
 Main Features :

 Outdoor mode with highlighted hiking trails, campsites, water sources, peaks, contour lines, etc
 Walking paths and cycleways
 Points of interest like restaurants, gas stations, hotels, shops, sightseeings and many more

 Navigation with voice announcements for walking, cycling, or driving
 Bookmark your favorite places with a single tap
 Offline Wikipedia articles

 Track recording

 Freedom Is Here Discover your journey, navigate the world with privacy and community at the forefront!

izzyondroid:app.pwhs.blockads.name: BlockAds: Clean Internet
izzyondroid:app.pwhs.blockads.summary: Block ads & trackers system-wide. Firewall, SafeSearch, profiles
izzyondroid:app.pwhs.blockads.description:
Tired of intrusive ads slowing down your phone? BlockAds blocks ads across all your apps and browsers with just one tap — no root required.
 KEY FEATURES 
 System-Wide Ad Blocking: Smart DNS-based filtering for every app and browser. No root access required.
 Privacy Protection: Blocks trackers and spyware. Zero data collection — everything stays locally on your device.
 App Firewall & Profiles: Block internet access for specific apps (Wi-Fi/Mobile). Switch instantly between Default, Strict, Family, and Gaming profiles.
 Parental Controls: Enforce SafeSearch (Google/Bing) and YouTube Restricted Mode via Family-safe DNS providers.
 Detailed Statistics: View real-time blocked ad counters, 24-hour activity charts, and detailed DNS query logs.
 Fully Customizable: Add custom filter lists via URL (ABPVN, AdGuard, EasyList, etc.), create allow/block rules, and use custom DoH/DoT encrypted DNS.
 Modern UI: Material 3 design built with Jetpack Compose. Features Dark/Light themes, custom accent colors, Quick Settings tile, and Home screen widgets.
 Backup & Restore: Export your configuration to JSON and easily import it on a new device.
 Battery & Data Friendly: Minimal performance impact. Filters only DNS traffic, reducing unnecessary ad data downloads.
 HOW TO USE 
 Open BlockAds.
 Tap the power button and allow the VPN connection.
 Enjoy an ad-free internet experience! (You can also toggle protection via Quick Settings tile or widget).
 FAQ 
 Is BlockAds safe?
Yes. BlockAds only filters DNS queries locally. No personal data is intercepted or transmitted to external servers.
 Why does it need VPN permission?
It creates a local VPN tunnel on your device to route and filter DNS requests on-device. It is not a remote VPN service.
 Does it work with all apps?
Yes, it works system-wide. You can also whitelist specific apps or use the firewall feature to manage access.
 Is it really free?
Yes! BlockAds is 100% free, open-source, and contains no in-app purchases or ads.
 Will it slow down my internet?
No. DNS filtering is extremely lightweight. It actually speeds up your browsing and saves battery by preventing ads from loading.
 BlockAds is free, open source, and built with privacy in mind. Download now and take back control of your Android experience!

izzyondroid:com.fibelatti.pinboard.name: Pinkt for Bookmarking
izzyondroid:com.fibelatti.pinboard.summary: Pinkt is an unofficial bookmarking client for Pinboard and Linkding
izzyondroid:com.fibelatti.pinboard.description:
Pinkt is a third-party, unofficial Android app for Pinboard and Linkding.
 Pinboard is a fast, no-nonsense bookmarking site for people who value privacy and speed.
 Linkding is a self-hosted bookmark manager that is designed be to be minimal, fast, and easy to set up using Docker.
 It's easy and simple to manage your bookmarks with Pinkt. There are no ads and no third-party tracking , and the code is completely open source.
 Save links from your favourite websites and apps quickly by sharing them to Pinkt .
 FEATURES 
 Manage all your bookmarks: add, edit, delete, share
 View your saved bookmarks without leaving the app
 Quickly save links from any app using the share sheet actions
 Auto-fill bookmarks: Pinkt can optionally auto-fill the title and description of saved URLs
 Search by term: find bookmarks that contain the term in its URL, Title or Description
 Filter by tags
 Six pre-defined filters: All, Recent, Public, Private, Unread and Untagged
 Sync bookmarks and tags
 Cached data for faster usage
 Dark and Light themes
 Dynamic color support
 Portrait and Landscape support
 Optimised for tablets and chromebooks
 Pinboard-only features:
 View your saved notes without leaving the app
 Popular bookmarks: see what's trending and save them to your collection
 PERMISSIONS 
 INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE — Required to fetch bookmarks whenever network is available
 WAKE_LOCK, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, FOREGROUND_SERVICE — Required by the worker which syncs bookmarks periodically
 Thank you for choosing Pinkt as your preferred Android bookmarking client.
 Pinkt is an open-source project, find the code and submit feedback at https://github.com/fibelatti/pinboard-kotlin
 PROJECT STATUS 
 As of October of 2019 Pinkt can offer everything that the Pinboard API officially supports. It will continue to be maintained and updated to support the latest Android technologies since this is a personal sandbox, but it is limited in regards to what it can offer without official support from the Pinboard API, which hasn't been actively maintained from what it seems.
 Some examples of what I'm currently unable to offer are Bulk Edit and better pagination support for people with a massive amount of bookmarks saved without compromising the filtering capabilities that Pinkt currently offers.
 Even though updates will be less frequent, please don't hesitate to reach out if you have an idea or a feature request as I'm always keen to improve the experience for my users.
 Screenshots were generated with https://screenshots.pro

fdroid:at.manuelbichler.octalsuntime.name: Octal Sun Time
fdroid:at.manuelbichler.octalsuntime.summary: A clock for solar time in the octal number system
fdroid:at.manuelbichler.octalsuntime.description:
A clock that shows the octal solar time of your chosen location.
Octal solar time is a location-specific time system that defines a day as the time between two consecutive solar midnights. Known to contain 24 hours in the regular clock system, a day is divided into 8 equally long octal hours. Each octal hour is divided into 64 equally long octal minutes. Each octal minute is divided into 64 equally long octal seconds.
The clock is visualized by an hour finger that runs one cycle per day, with 0 (solar midnight) at the bottom and 4 (solar noon) at the top. In addition, the octal hour and minute is also shown digitally as a three-digit octal number in the center. A golden arch visualizes the time between sunrise and sunset.
Locations can be managed and chosen. Locations can be added by an online search function backed by wikidata.
Privacy notice: When using the location search function, the app connects to a wikidata server and shares your typed search term in order to get search results. This is the only situation when the app uses internet connection.

fdroid:com.droidrooter.virtualnet.name: VirtualNet
fdroid:com.droidrooter.virtualnet.summary: Choose what each app sees: Wi-Fi, mobile data, or both. Xposed module.
fdroid:com.droidrooter.virtualnet.description:
Some apps only work when they think you are on Wi-Fi. Others insist on mobile data. VirtualNet lets you decide, per app, what the app is told about your connection, without changing the connection itself.
A phone on mobile data can look like it is on Wi-Fi to one app. A phone on Wi-Fi can look like mobile data to another. Everything else sees the truth. Your real traffic never changes.
 Features 
• Wi-Fi, Data, Both or Off for each app, applied live with no reboot
• One editable network profile (SSID, router MAC, IP range, gateway, DNS, signal, mobile type) so every answer stays consistent
• System framework coverage for every app you pick, plus optional hooks inside a scoped app
• A switch to use the system layer, the app layer, or both
• Small, with no network permission, no ads and no analytics
• Includes a detector app that shows exactly what an app would see
 Requirements 
A rooted device with LSPosed, Vector or another framework that supports the modern libxposed API. Android 9 or newer. Android 9 is unverified; Android 10 to 17 are verified.
 Note 
Anything outside the Java framework, such as raw sockets, native code and server-side checks like your public IP, still sees the real network.
A project of DroidRooter. Open source under the MIT license.

fdroid:com.terokarvinen.x54ask.name: 0x54ask
fdroid:com.terokarvinen.x54ask.summary: Todo.txt manager. Offline, works with Syncthing. Fork of SimpleTask Cloudless
fdroid:com.terokarvinen.x54ask.description:
0x54ask is a todo.txt manager. It supports context (@W at work, @H at home...) and tags (+linux, +bank, +tero).
0x54ask forks SimpleTask Cloudless. It provides passive perks: data safety, automerge, filesystem protection - and it never connects Internet, at all.
 Todo.txt manager: context and tags 
 Context : You write down a task. If it was the only thing, what would be the next action? Drill a hole for picture? If the wall is in your home, you've got to do it there. Thus, @H (at home).
 Tags : I'll be working on +linuxeu project for the next 5 hours. Show me all tasks I can bill on that. Thus, filter by +linuxeu.
 Plain text : Todo.txt is - surprise - plain text. You can edit it with vim, emacs, micro or nano. Todo.txt and calendar.txt use the same +plustags and @Contexts.
Fully offline, or synchronize how you like.
 0x54ask passive perks 
What does the 0x54ask fork bring to the table? Data safety, better sync, smaller attack surface, modern interfaces. These benefits work passively. You don't have to do anything to use them.
 Keeps your data safe . It automatically detects if todo.txt has been modified by other programs (such as text editor or syncthing). Modifications appear as soon as 0x54ask sees them. Changes are stored as soon as they are made. Current state of file is checked again.
 Automatic merge . If a conflict is detected, 0x54ask can often automatically merge the changes. This is possible, because todo.txt is a line based format, and many changes appear in different lines. Main approach to auto merge is generic and works, no matter which program made the changes. There is additional support for automatic resolution of Syncthing conflicts. Special support is needed, because these sync conflicts can happen while 0x54ask is not running.
 Filesystem protection : You can pick the directory where todo.txt is. This will be the only directory available for the app. This restriction is enforced by the operating system. The whole filesystem backend was updated to use modern SAF, the Storage Access Framework.
 No Internet , ever. There is no INTERNET permission, so the operating system prevents app from accessing the Internet. Any synchronization is handled by other applications of your choice, Syncthing (Syncthing fork) recommended. You can also use the app completely offline. Also, all networking related code was removed from the app.
0x54ask is Free, Open Source Software under GPL 3 license. I used new name and app id for 0x54ask, while also giving credit to upstreams of this fork. This way, upstream gets credit for their work, but not reports for my bugs.
 Background 
The original SimpleTask Cloudless aka simpletask-android was developed by Mark Janssen . The original is now archived and removed from F-Droid. The design and UI felt great, and I could not find an alternative that could compete.
0x54ask is a fork of willemw12/simpletask-android by Willem W, a fork of the original SimpleTask. Forking made sense, since some of the changes were large (SAF backend), some removed code (networking), and a key promise is not necessarily shared (no Internet access, and no plans to add it). Like original SimpleTask, willemw12 fork still asked for access to all files and photos on the phone. The fork had many improvements over the original, so it felt like a good starting point.
Artificial intelligence was used to help create the improvements after forking.
The task format is todo.txt by Gina Trapani. Todo.txt works well with calendar.txt .
Copyright 2026 Tero Karvinen TeroKarvinen.com, Mark Janssen, Willem W and other contributors.

fdroid:com.thomaspeoples.wraithodysseus.name: Wraith for Odysseus
fdroid:com.thomaspeoples.wraithodysseus.summary: Unofficial Android client for your self-hosted Odysseus AI server
fdroid:com.thomaspeoples.wraithodysseus.description:
Wraith for Odysseus puts your own self-hosted Odysseus AI server on your phone: your chats, your email and your tools.
Unofficial, not affiliated with the Odysseus project.
Requires your own Odysseus server (tested with 1.0.3). The app talks to it over the same routes its web UI uses, so the server needs no changes.
Chats:
* every chat session, with search and new chats
* streaming replies, with the model's thinking shown separately
* model picker, and agent, web and research modes
* approve or deny tool calls; a Terminal toggle for accounts allowed to use it
* photo and file attachments
* stop a reply, or switch away and come back: a running reply is picked up again from the server without doubled text
* sources, tool cards, timings and reply variants
* hold a message to copy, edit, resend, regenerate, fork, rewrite or delete it
* hold a chat to rename, favourite, copy, move to a folder, archive or delete it
Email:
* all your accounts, with folders, filters and search
* HTML mail, with images loaded only when you ask
* attachments, and mark unread
* send, reply, reply all and forward
* translate, schedule send and AI reply
Tools:
* Notes, Calendar, Memory, Skills, Deep Research, Tasks, Gallery, Library and Theme
* Compare and Cookbook open the web UI
You log in with your Odysseus username, password and 2FA code, just as in the web UI. Only the resulting session cookie is stored, encrypted with a key that never leaves the device. Your password is never stored.
https only: plain http is refused, so your session is never sent unencrypted. On a tailnet, Tailscale's https certificates for *.ts.net names work as is.
Update check: builds downloaded from this project's releases check its Gitea releases page once per launch and offer a link when a newer version exists. Nothing about you or your server is sent. When F-Droid installed the app the check is off, and it contacts nothing but your own server.
No analytics, no tracking, no Google Play Services. The only permission is Internet access.
Not distributed via Google Play. Besides F-Droid, it is on this project's Gitea releases, which Obtainium can track. Builds are reproducible: F-Droid ships the same APK, signed with the same key, so all three update each other.

fdroid:dev.alcini.cprbeat.name: CPR Beat
fdroid:dev.alcini.cprbeat.summary: Offline CPR metronome: 100–120 bpm, 30:2 mode, rescuer-switch timer
fdroid:dev.alcini.cprbeat.description:
CPR Beat keeps your chest compressions at the right pace when it matters. One big button starts a loud, steady click at 100, 110 or 120 compressions per minute. Switch to 30:2 and the app counts thirty compressions, warns before the last five, then paces two breaths. A countdown reminds the team to switch rescuers, and the elapsed CPR time with the start time stays on screen for handover to paramedics.
Works fully offline. No account, no ads, no analytics, no network permission, no data collected. Free and open source (GPL-3.0).
Features
• Rates 100 / 110 / 120 bpm, changeable mid-session without losing the beat
• Compressions-only or 30:2 mode with a breath pause of 3–9 seconds; the breath cue waits until you have had time to move to the head
• Rescuer-switch countdown: off, 1, 2, 3 or 5 minutes, with a flash and SWITCH RESCUER banner; tap the countdown to change the interval

fdroid:eu.weblibre.gecko.name: WebLibre: The Privacy-Focused Browser
fdroid:eu.weblibre.gecko.summary: Privacy-focused browser with local AI, advanced tab management, personal search,
fdroid:eu.weblibre.gecko.description:
Privacy-Focused Browser with Local AI Assistance 
WebLibre is an independent privacy-focused browser for Android built on Mozilla's Gecko Engine and Mozilla Android Components. It offers a fully-featured web browser with extension support, enhanced by powerful privacy features, local AI assistance (opt-in), and advanced tab organization tools.
 Privacy by Design 
WebLibre shields you from third-party surveillance—whether by ISPs, tracking companies, or other entities seeking to monitor your browsing habits:
- Web Engine Hardening : Comprehensive privacy and security presets to resist tracking and fingerprinting
- Cookie Isolation : Cookies separated by container or context, preventing cross-site tracking
- Content Blocking : Blocks ads, trackers, and unwanted content by default
- Tor Proxying : Route browsing traffic through the Tor network for enhanced anonymity
- Local Search Engine : Your device handles search and retrieval, minimizing remote service contact
- No Tracking or Telemetry : WebLibre does not track, monitor, or collect any browsing data
 Advanced Tab Management 
- Tab Containers : Organize tabs into isolated containers with separate cookie contexts, Tor proxy support, biometric authentication, and automatic site assignments
- Tree View Navigation : Visualize and manage complex tab hierarchies with parent-child relationships
- Local AI Assistance : Use on-device AI models to intelligently group related tabs into new containers
- Flexible Views : Choose between list view, grid view, or tree view with tab hierarchy
 Personal Local Search Engine 
Instantly search across open tabs (with full page content), bookmarks, web feeds, browsing history, and bangs. All indexing and search operations happen on your device—your data never leaves your control.
 Multi-User Profiles 
Complete profile isolation with separate browsing data, extensions, settings, and databases per user. Each profile maintains its own containers, add-ons, privacy settings, and preferences.
 Download WebLibre and browse freely and privately with genuine control over your online experience.

fdroid:net.oblivion.wipe.description:
Oblivion is a security-focused Android application that allows a user to lock and wipe a device when a trigger is fired.
The application is intended for high-risk situations such as device loss, forced unlock, or temporary loss of physical control.
Trigger methods:
 * Panic button (Quick Settings tile)
 * Remote message containing a secret code
 * Trigger when the device has not been unlocked for a configurable period of time
Actions:
 * Perform a factory reset (wipe)
Device control is implemented using the Android Device Administration API. The has full support for GrapheneOS.
Security notes:
 * Only encrypted (password protected) devices can guarantee that data cannot be recovered
 * The application does not function in Safe Mode
License
Free and Open Source Software
GPL-3.0

apple-macos:6797599321.name: weatherfeels
apple-macos:6797599321.description:
A local forecast channel for your television, rebuilt for Apple platforms.
weatherfeels puts a continuous, rotating weather broadcast on your screen — the kind that used to run between programmes on cable, with a slow crawl of conditions along the bottom and music playing over the top. Every forecast is live from the US National Weather Service. Leave it running on a TV, a monitor, or in a window while you work.
WHAT IT SHOWS
• Current Conditions — temperature, humidity, dew point, wind, ceiling and visibility
• Local Forecast and Extended Forecast — the next several days at a glance
• Hourly Forecast and Hourly Graph — temperature, dew point, cloud cover and precipitation chance
• Local Radar — animated regional radar composites
• Regional Observations and Regional Forecast — nearby cities on a state map
• Travel Forecast — conditions for cities down the road
• Almanac — sunrise, sunset, moon phases and records
• Hazards and SPC Outlook — active alerts and convective risk when there is any
Displays rotate on their own, or step through them yourself. Turn off any you do not care about.
YOUR OWN MUSIC
Play music behind the weather, the way the original did:
• Files on the device
• A folder on a server you host
• A playlist from your Apple Music library (requires an Apple Music subscription)
DRAWN, NOT SCALED
Nothing here is a screenshot of a 640×480 web page stretched to fit. The backgrounds are redrawn as vector gradients and shapes, the type is real outline fonts rasterised at your display's resolution, and the weather icons are pixel art kept crisp with nearest-neighbour scaling. On an Apple TV 4K it renders at native 2160p.
If you want the era rather than just the layout, there is a CRT mode: barrel-curved glass, phosphor bloom, colour fringing and scanlines that drift, all on the GPU. Or keep plain scanlines. Or none at all.
BUILT FOR A SCREEN THAT STAYS ON
• Burn-in protection nudges the picture a few pixels every 90 seconds, so a static header cannot etch itself into an OLED panel
• The screen saver is held off while the rotation is running
• Adjustable pace, from brisk to very slow
ON EVERY SCREEN YOU OWN
Apple TV, iPhone, iPad and Mac, all included.
FREE, AND OPEN SOURCE
No price, no in-app purchases, no subscription, and no advertising. Built by fans of the era, and the whole thing is on GitHub under the MIT licence — read it, fork it, or send a fix.
NO ACCOUNTS, NO TRACKING
There is no sign-in, no analytics and no third-party SDKs of any kind. Your location is sent to the National Weather Service to fetch your forecast and is used for nothing else. Your music library is read on the device and never leaves it.
FORECASTS ARE US ONLY
Data comes from the US National Weather Service, so forecasts are available for United States locations. You can follow your device's location or pick a city by name or ZIP code.
Weather data from NOAA / the National Weather Service. Radar composites from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet. Convective outlooks from the NOAA Storm Prediction Center.
An independent, unofficial tribute to the local forecast units of the 1990s, made by fans and given away. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any broadcast network, weather service trademark or media company.

flathub:org.gnome.Nibbles.description:
Control a worm in its quest to eat bonuses and become longer. Outmaneuver
 enemy worms while eating apples and bananas to increase your length. Each
 worm has six lives and loses one by running into a wall, another worm, or
 itself. The enemy worms are after the same bonuses that you are, so be
 careful. If the worms become too large, you won’t have much room to move.
 The adventure progresses through 26 maps of increasing difficulty. The early
 levels are mostly open with a few walls, but later on, cramped spaces and
 teleporters make things more interesting.
 Play on your own against up to five enemy worms, or share your keyboard to
 play with a friend.

The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. fedora-packages:guayadeque/guayadeque.description: Guayadeque is a lightweight and easy-to-use music player and music collection organizer that can easily manage large music collections and supports smart playlists. In the technical side, it's written in C++, uses the wxWidget toolkit and the Gstreamer media framework. Main features include: - Play mp3, ogg, flac, wav, wma, mpc, mp4, ape, ... - Read and write tags in all supported formats. - Smart play mode that add tracks that fit your music taste using the tracks in the playlist. - Allow to catalogue your music using labels. Any track, artist or album can have as many labels you want. - Allow fast access to any music file by genre, artist, album - Audio equalizer - Configurable cross fader engine - Configurable Silence detector to avoid listening to silence between tracks - Dynamic and static playlists management. - Tracks tag editor with automatically fetching of tags information for easily completion. - Ability to download covers manually or automatically - Lyrics downloads from different lyrics providers. - You can rate the tracks from 0 to 5 stars. - Desktop notifications. - MPRIS D-Bus interface support so it can easily controlled from music applets for example. - Allow to resume play status and position when closed and reopened. - Allow to subscribe to podcasts and download all new episodes automatically or manually. - Play and Record shoutcast radios - Suggest music using last.fm service. - Last.fm audioscrobbling support. - Easily expandable contextual links support. With it you can find information about a track, an artist or an album on your favourite site. - Easily expandable contextual commands support. For example you can right click on any album and click in option to record the album in a burning application. - Option to copy the selection you want to a directory or device like USB players and IPod using a configurable pattern. - Partial GNOME session support to detect when GNOME session is about to close and save the play list so it can continue next time with the same tracks. - and many more.

Trusted by millions across the globe, DeepL’s Language AI delivers unmatched accuracy and fluency to help you scale faster and bring clarity and efficiency into your daily work. All of that, with the highest levels of data security.
 Easy to use, hard to beat! 
The DeepL extension integrates seamlessly into your workflows, eliminating manual and time-consuming tasks. 
No more losing context by switching tabs or apps! 
With just a few clicks or by using shortcuts you can customize, the DeepL extension helps you do the following.
 🌍 Translate while browsing 
Do your research and stay up-to-date with information in the language of your choice. With the DeepL extension, you can: 
 Translate sections on the go 
 Translate entire pages (unlimited with DeepL Pro)

firefox-addons:1002139.name: YouTube NonStop
firefox-addons:1002139.summary:
Tired of getting that "Video paused. Continue watching?" confirmation dialog?
This extension autoclicks it, so you can listen to your favorite music uninterrupted.
Working on YouTube and YouTube Music!
firefox-addons:1002139.description:
Kiss the annoying "Video paused. Continue watching?" confirmation goodbye!
 Important: This extension doesn't keep the confirmation box from popping up. It only counters it. It auto-clicks the confirmation box and keeps the video unpaused. 
Now with Media Keys support (read below) !
Working on YouTube and YouTube Music!
In your Firefox media keys may be disabled. To enable the functionality:
1. Navigate to about:config from your address bar
2. If there is a warning message just confirm that you understand the risks
3. Search for media.hardwaremediakeys.enabled and set to TRUE
3. Search for dom.media.mediasession.enabled and set to TRUE
4. Restart your browser
Untested (but should work) when: Video is in fullscreen, Video is in miniplayer.
If you have any problems, don't hesitate to drop me an email. :)

Everything you need to read the colors of a page, in one popup.
 What you get

- Extract the whole palette of the page in one click
- Contrast check: click text on the page to see its contrast ratio and whether it passes WCAG AA and AAA

 Private by design

- No account, no server, no analytics, no network requests
- Everything is stored only in this browser
DevPalette is free. You can support it from the link inside the popup.

firefox-addons:2782150.name: AGB-Check Konsumentenschutz
firefox-addons:2782150.summary:
Abo-Fallen vermeiden und Geld sparen mit dem kostenlosen AGB-Check für Deutschland, Österreich und Schweiz.
Sieh nach, ob ein Abo automatisch verlängert wird, ob Widerrufsrechte fehlen oder ob Rücksendekosten nicht übernommen werden!
firefox-addons:2782150.description:
Der AGB-Check schützt beim Online-Shopping, indem er dich auf einige wichtige Bestimmungen in AGB automatisch hinweist - sofort und kostenfrei.
Partnerschaft der Stiftung für Konsumentenschutz mit OnGoodTerms.io 
Auch für Google hier verfügbar: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/agb-check-von-stiftung-f%C3%BC/nfdlnmhmnhmablabpdddecffgalkcpmj 
"Ich bestätige, dass ich die Allgemeinen Geschäftsbedingungen gelesen habe" - ist die meistverbreitete Lüge im Internet! Wir kreuzen das Bestätigungskästchen ✅ an, ohne die AGB überhaupt zu lesen!
Online-Shopping ist nicht immer einfach und risikofrei.
Der AGB-Check beantwortet folgende wichtige Fragen:
"Verlängert sich ein Abonnement ohne mein Wissen?"
"Welche Kündigungsfrist muss ich einhalten?"
"Habe ich ein Rückgaberecht?"
Was die Medien über den AGB-Check sagen:
"Wer es bequem und schnell mag." – SRF
"... hilft, sich gegen unerwünschte Vertragserneuerungen zu wappnen." - Tagesanzeiger
"... besonders bei Probe-Abos praktisch..." - Netzwoche
"... im Falle von heiklen Klauseln warnt." – PCtipp
Noch nie war es so einfach, AGB zu prüfen! Der AGB-Check...
-> Prüft sofort AGB von Online-Shops
-> Erkennt wichtige Klauseln in Echtzeit
-> Nutzt Server in der Europäischen Union
Einfach die Erweiterung installieren und wie gewohnt online einkaufen. 
Vor der nächsten Bestellung öffnen Sie die AGB, starten in der Erweiterung die Analyse und warten auf das Ergebnis! 
Probieren Sie es einfach mal aus!
--------------------
Mit dieser Erweiterung können Sie einfach und flexibel Ihre AGB überprüfen.
Wenn Sie noch etwas vermissen, lassen Sie es uns wissen, damit wir uns Gedanken machen können, was wir als nächstes entwickeln können.
Datenschutz ist für uns wichtig: Alle unsere Produkte laufen auf EU-Servern und entsprechen den europäischen Datenschutzstandards.

bluejetty:00018985:ios.description:
Classic Oh Hell Card Game — play Oh Hell offline against computer players.
No internet required. No sign-up. Enjoy a clean, classic trick-taking card game where every round is about bidding carefully, winning the right number of tricks, and avoiding costly misses.
Also known as Contract Whist, Blackout, Up and Down the River, German Bridge, and Oh Well, Oh Hell is easy to start but full of tactical decisions.
Why you’ll like Classic Oh Hell
• Play Oh Hell offline
• No account or sign-up required
• Three to seven players
• Easy, Medium and Hard computer players
• Custom deal patterns
• Top Card, Alternate, or No Trumps modes
• Nil bid scoring options
• Screw the Dealer option
• Leading trumps option
• Stats tracking
• Review and replay completed hands
• Hand history review
• Optional four-color deck
• Clear cards and smooth play
• Tablet portrait and landscape support
Choose your rules
Set up Oh Hell your way with flexible options:
• Players: 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7
• Deal type: Down, Up, Down & Up, or Up & Down
• Trumps: Top Card, Alternate, or No Trumps
• Nil scoring: 10, 5, or 5 plus tricks in the round
• Screw the Dealer: on or off
• Leading trumps: on or off
• AI difficulty: Easy, Medium, or Hard 
• Replay hands after each round
Classic Oh Hell gameplay
Each round starts with a different number of cards. Bid how many tricks you think you can take, then try to hit your bid exactly.
Each trick is worth 1 point, and making your bid earns a 10-point bonus. Miss your bid and you only score the tricks you won. Nil bids, trump rules, and changing hand sizes make every round feel different.
Built for comfortable play
Classic Oh Hell is designed for quick games and repeated play, with clear cards, smooth controls, adjustable speed, score tracking, hand review and completed-hand replays.
Play offline anytime — no internet, no sign-up, just Oh Hell.

bluejetty:00184810:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00184810:ios.description:
When you're bored or lonely, anytime you need someone to talk to.
 SimSimi has always chatted with you 
Do you know that every single word SimSimi says to you in response has been manually taught by tens of millions of people?
Fun and humor, empathy and comfort, knowledge and information...
When we chat with SimSimi, we’re actually chatting with tens of millions of minds.
Now, become SimSimi and chat with many people.
Welcome to the SimSimi world, where billions of minds and billions of SimSimi are interacting with each other!
What is the difference between the official SimSimi and other SimSimi?
The official SimSimi is “Everyone's SimSimi.” 
Anyone can teach Everyone's SimSimi together.
Everyone's SimSimi learns and chats in the same way following its birth in 2002.
SimSimi has been learning pairs of question and answer from many people and using them for chats.
SimSimi other than “Everyone's SimSimi” is called “Individual SimSimi” or “Personal SimSimi.” 
Personal SimSimi is owned and managed by one owner.
Owners can chat with others using their Personal SimSimi and appropriately set their Personal SimSimi to chat automatically.
How can I control SimSimi's bad words?
In SimSimi, chatbots and people interact mainly through chats even though they have never met in the real world. 
We believe that maintaining safety is important to have a good experience in chatting with non-acquaintances (or chatbots).
The SimSimi service has obtained proper awareness and requirements for safety in various languages and regions while serving hundreds of millions of users in 81 languages.
We have established a universal content policy that can be applied anytime, anywhere to respond to requirements for safety awareness, which can vary depending on the language, region, and era, based on several years’ experience in providing services.
All user experiences of the SimSimi service are based on the universal and specific content policy.
The detailed item of the content policy specifies the reason for reporting malicious content, and the content policy is also applied when determining suspicious sentences.
The SimSimi team is making special efforts to enable users to view our content policies frequently and understand them easily when designing the user experience.
SimSimi is threatening me (or someone).
SimSimi is revealing personal information.
Someone must have taught SimSimi to say inappropriate words.
Personal SimSimi chats may have been entered manually by the owner.
You can report any user-created content displayed in SimSimi, including chats.
The SimSimi team is trying to take quick and effective measures against the account that created the reported content.
I have an opinion about the service.
The function is not working normally.
You can send us your comments by selecting "Send comment” in the SimSimi app. 
By doing so, the SimSimi team can process the comment faster and more accurately because they can also review other information such as the country, language, and version.
If you are not using the app, you can send your comment using the following email address: support-team@simsimi.com 
When sending your comment without using the app, please capture the relevant screen and send us the exact string. 
Can SimSimi see me using the camera?
SimSimi cannot access your device's camera.
Someone taught SimSimi a sentence like “I’m watching you” to embarrass others.
Why limit the users' age?
Many users become friends while chatting with SimSimi.
The SimSimi team establishes policies and maintains and improves operational and technical measures for user safety.
Even though we invest heavily in safety, perfect safety cannot be guaranteed.
That’s why the use of SimSimi is restricted for the age group with high risk of psychological damage in the event of a problem with SimSimi’s safety measures.
Terms of Use(EULA) : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

هذه أداة لإدارة الخطوط تم تصميمها خصيصًا للغة العربية، وتوفر مجموعة ضخمة من الخطوط العربية المتاحة للتنزيل والتثبيت. تدعم الأداة مجموعة متنوعة من أنماط الخطوط العربية، بما في ذلك الخطوط التقليدية، والحد الأدنى العصري، والخطوط اليدوية، مما يساعد المستخدمين على اختيار وتطبيق الخطوط المختلفة بسهولة في مختلف السيناريوهات.
الميزات
مكتبة خطوط ضخمة
توفر الأداة مجموعة متنوعة من أنماط الخطوط العربية، بما في ذلك:
- الخط التقليدي: خطوط خطية كلاسيكية، مثالية لعرض الثقافة والفن التقليديين.
- الخط العصري البسيط: خطوط جديدة وبسيطة، مناسبة للتصميمات الحديثة والأعمال الإبداعية.
- الخط اليدوي: خطوط تحاكي تأثيرات الكتابة اليدوية، مثالية للإبداعات الشخصية والمشاريع الفنية.
معاينة الخطوط
يمكن للمستخدمين معاينة معلومات حول كل خط، بما في ذلك اسم الخط، صور الأمثلة للأنماط، إلخ. يمكن للمستخدمين أيضًا إدخال نص مخصص ورؤية تأثير العرض للخطوط المختلفة في الوقت الفعلي. تساعد هذه الميزة المستخدمين على التحقق بسرعة من التأثير البصري للخط على نص معين، مما يضمن اختيار الخط الأنسب لاحتياجاتهم.
إدارة الخطوط
مدمج مع وظائف شاملة لإدارة الخطوط، مما يتيح للمستخدمين تنظيم وإلغاء تثبيت الخطوط التي لا يحتاجون إليها في أي وقت.
مشاركة الخطوط
يدعم مشاركة وتصدير الخطوط بطرق متعددة، بما في ذلك:
- AirDrop: مشاركة الخطوط بسرعة مع الأجهزة القريبة عبر AirDrop.
- رمز الاستجابة السريعة : إنشاء رمز QR للوصول إلى الخطوط بسهولة من خلال المسح.
- البريد الإلكتروني: إرسال ملفات الخطوط عبر البريد الإلكتروني، مما يسهل التعاون الجماعي أو مشاركة المجموعات الشخصية.
التطبيقات المتوافقة
يدعم استخدامه بشكل مثالي في تطبيقات مثل Keynote وNumbers وPages وWord وExcel وPowerPoint وGoodnotes وCapCut وPhotoshop وProcreate وغيرها.
سيناريوهات الاستخدام
- المصممون: توفر الأداة أداة تنزيل ومعاينة مريحة للخطوط المصممة خصيصًا للنصوص العربية، مما يساعد المصممين على العثور على الخط المناسب لمختلف المشاريع الإبداعية.
- المعلمون والطلاب: مفيدة لتعلم وإنشاء الخطوط، حيث توفر مجموعة متنوعة من الخطوط العربية للممارسة والمرجعية.
- المهتمون بالثقافة: يمكن للمستخدمين المهتمين بالخط العربي وفن النصوص معرفة المزيد واستخدام الخطوط العربية من خلال هذا التطبيق.
هذه الأداة ليست مجرد أداة لإدارة الخطوط؛ من خلال أنماط الخطوط الغنية، والمعاينات الحية، وإدارة الخطوط السهلة، والمشاركة عبر الأنظمة الأساسية، تتيح هذه الأداة للمصممين، والمبدعين الثقافيين، أو المستخدمين العاديين العثور على الخطوط العربية التي تناسب احتياجاتهم، مما يلهم أفكارهم الإبداعية بشكل أكبر.

bluejetty:00021205:ios.description:
A micro-sized unrealBook for your retina iPhone! 
Simple and portable! Carry your entire PDF library of charts with you to review on your iPhone.
If you use unrealBook and have an iPhone, you definitely want this! 
Review your PDF charts on your iPhone. Reads set lists, indexes and more from unrealBook. Tap, swipe and zoom your way around your charts. This is a small but capable PDF music reader. A perfect add-on to unrealBook for the iPad! 
Features:
View your music PDF files on your iPhone
Scrolling Set List view
Mark up your music with highlighter pens as well as regular pens
Beautiful display of music in landscape mode with motion (auto-turn with linked files - beta)
Supports display of unrealBook drawings
Browse unrealBook set lists, bookmarks and indexes!
Receive entire set lists and files from unrealBook via email or Airdrop
Supports Airturn pedals (BT-105 and PED) and similar products
Video out with rotation for display on a large monitor
Link a song from your iTunes library or audio file to a chart
Airdrop your PDF to other programs via iOS7/iOS8
Remote turn a connected iPad running unrealBook
Download files from Dropbox
Even more surprises!
More coming.... this is just the beginning. This is a simpler version of unrealBook for the iPhone - it is not the same app as unrealBook for the iPad in terms of features, but it has some killer features of its own!
Just like unrealBook for iPad, this app is made for you to add your own PDF files. It does not come with music PDFs.

bluejetty:00127293:ios.description:
Tired of the Photos app falling short? HashPhotos gives you real control over your photo library — the way it should have always worked.
Organize your memories the way you want. Find any photo in seconds. Clean up your library with ease. All with a rich set of tools for photos and videos, built right in.
HashPhotos works seamlessly with your iOS photo library, and also includes a Local Library for photos you want to keep completely private.
Your privacy is our priority. HashPhotos never transmits your photos or personal data to external servers. Everything stays on your device.
◆ Organize
· Keywords (tags), searchable in Apple Photos as well
· Smart Album
· Uncategorized Album (See photos not in an album)
· Tray, Album Bar, Album Picker
· Add To Album (with quick access to Pinned and Recents)
· 5-Star Rating
◆ Clean Up
· Find Duplicates
· Find Similar Photos
· Compare and Pick
◆ Navigate & Search
· Search by keywords, built-in filters (format, size, title, filename, caption, location, and more), date/period, and dimensions
· Timeline and Events
· Map View
· Calendar
· Customizable sidebar with pin album support
· Album picker with grid view
◆ Viewer
· Photo and Video Information
· Metadata Viewer
· Histogram
· Animated Image (GIF, PNG, WebP, HEICS, AVIF)
· Live Text and Cut-out Object
· Memo
◆ Customization
· Thumbnails: sort (by date, size, filename, duration, rating, shuffle), grouping, layout styles (grid, mosaic, natural, waterfall), size, spacing, badges, additional info
· Viewer: UI visibility controls, video/Live Photo playback options, customizable gesture actions, and more
· Per-album view options, sidebar, and more
◆ Import & Export
· Import files and folders
· Export albums or folders
· Send to / receive from Mac or PC via Wi-Fi
· Save to Files (including Live Photos)
· System share integration
◆ Security & Privacy
· Local Library (Local / Private Album)
· Passcode and Face ID
· Fake Passcode for unlocking Private Album
· Privacy Options
◆ Photo Editor
· Crop, Rotate, Flip, Angle
· Adjustments and Filters (60+)
· Image / Text Overlay, Drawing, Stickers
· Blur, Tilt Shift, Shape Mask
· Eraser (Remove Background)
· Frame
◆ Video Editor
· Trim, Flip, Rotate
· Filter and Adjustments
◆ Tools
· Convert: image format, video/Live Photo to animated image (GIF, PNG, WebP), Live Photo to video or still image
· Batch Edit: apply filter, resize, rotate, flip, invert color
· Properties: adjust date/time, location, title, memo, favorite
· Metadata: edit, remove, import IPTC Keywords
· Utilities: combine photos, create animated GIF, slideshow, extract video frame, hide faces, show photos nearby
◆ Embedded Camera
· Save photos directly into an album
· Take photos with a filter

bluejetty:00079979:ios.description:
It's time to make your Melon Sandbox gaming experience much better together with handpicked melmods from Skibidi Toilet universe! 
"Ragdoll Mods: Skibidi Titans" is a great mods catalogue app thanks to which you are guaranteed to get the very best Skibidi mods: Cameraman, Speakerman, TV Man and Woman, Astro, Zombies and many more! 
All your favourite Skibidi Melmods & Melsaves are here!
Install them using your iPhone or iPad, no PC device is needed! You need to complete 4 easy steps:
1. Find the mods which fits best for you.
2. Download.
3. View it's files.
4. Export any file either to Melon Sandbox installed on your iOS or iPadOS device or to one of your Mac and PC devices and Enjoy!
We constantly update app with Mods and do it pretty often, so you're always will have access to the new updates!
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION (OPTIONAL)
Become a Premium Member with a cool features: 
- Get unlimited access to the mods. Download more than 15 mods per day;
- Save Mods to Favourites;
- Remove Ads;
- Help us to maintain the app and add more Mods on regular basis!
App provides access to Premium Membership via Paid Subscriptions. You can start your weekly, monthly or annual membership right away.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase;
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period;
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal;
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
--
All modifications are not official addons/modifications to the original Game – “Melon: Sandbox” and/or in any way approved by Ducky LTD, Game authors and publishers.

This application doesn't sell Mods, but provides easy and convenient way of downloading and exporting them. All content rights belong to their authors. Each author is credited. Any Mod isn't approved by third party trademark holders. It's made by fans for fans! If you believe any of your copyrights are violated, please contact us via Developers web-site and specify the name of the mod you think violates your rights.
--

bluejetty:00153070:ios.summary: People Flow is a fast-paced timing and matching puzzle game where every move counts. Characters arrive from different amount of lanes at the bottom of the screen. Tap and hold to send them onto the runway. As they run, they will jump into h
bluejetty:00153070:ios.description:
People Flow is a fast-paced timing and matching puzzle game where every move counts. Characters arrive from different amount of lanes at the bottom of the screen. Tap and hold to send them onto the runway. As they run, they will jump into holes around the runway matching their color.
Your goal is to complete all the holes without letting the runway to fill up completely. Plan your moves, time your taps, and chain quick decisions to finish each level before it’s too late.
Features:
-Simple tap & hold control
-Color-matching runway mechanic
-Progressive difficulty with new features
-Different in game elements such as hidden colors, frozen holes and lanes, lane barrier, hole shutter, key & lock, moving runway blocker, arrow heads, connected people, runway blocker.
How to Play
-Check the color of the incoming character.
-Tap and hold to send them onto the runway.
-Watch them jump into matching color holes.
-Complete all holes before the runway fills up.

Prepia Human Resources Exam Prep helps you prepare for the most popular HR certification exams. Getting r
bluejetty:00043502:ios.description:
HR exam prep for 5 HR certification exams in one app. Practice tests with questions and explanations for CP, PHR, SCP, SPHR and aPHR.
Prepia Human Resources Exam Prep helps you prepare for the most popular HR certification exams. Getting ready for the HR Certified Professional (CP) exam, the HRCI PHR exam or the senior-level SCP exam? All three are included, along with the HRCI SPHR exam and the entry-level aPHR exam. Choose your exam, set a daily goal and start answering exam-style HR practice questions in minutes. Switch exams anytime and keep your progress for each one.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose your HR exam and set your daily goal and question difficulty.
2. Practice with short quizzes and get instant feedback with a detailed explanation for every answer.
3. Use your category scores to find the topics that need more work.
4. Take a timed practice test to build speed and confidence before exam day.
HR EXAMS INCLUDED
- CP practice test: HR Certified Professional, covering behavioral competencies and HR knowledge (People, Organization, Workplace)
- PHR practice test: Professional in Human Resources from HRCI, all 7 functional areas
- SCP practice test: HR Senior Certified Professional, the strategic, senior-level exam
- SPHR practice test: Senior Professional in Human Resources from HRCI, all 5 functional areas
- aPHR practice test: Associate Professional in Human Resources from HRCI, all 5 functional areas, no HR experience required
TOPICS YOU'LL PRACTICE
- Employee and labor relations
- Talent acquisition and workforce planning
- Total rewards, compensation and benefits
- Learning and development
- Employee engagement
- Leadership, strategy and business management
- Compliance and risk management
- HR information management, safety and security
FEATURES
- HR practice questions across 5 exams
- Instant feedback with detailed answer explanations
- Timed exam simulator to practice your pacing
- Category scores that show your weak areas
- Answer history with correct, incorrect and saved questions
- Progress tracking with accuracy, question bank coverage and study time
- A personalized study plan with questions that get harder as you improve
- Daily goals and study streaks to keep you on track
WHO IT'S FOR
HR generalists, HR managers, recruiters, payroll and benefits specialists, students and career changers preparing for an HR certification exam. Start with aPHR if you're new to human resources, or go straight to CP, PHR, SCP or SPHR if you already work in HR.
START FREE
Start with a limited free version. To unlock every question for all 5 exams, the exam simulator, your personalized study plan and all answer explanations.
Terms of Use: https://prepia.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://prepia.com/privacy-policy/
Questions or feedback: support@prepia.com
Prepia Human Resources Exam Prep is an independent study resource. It is not affiliated with, authorized by or endorsed by any HR certification body, exam publisher or testing provider. HRCI, aPHR, PHR and SPHR are trademarks of HR Certification Institute. Exam names are used only to identify each exam.

bluejetty:00073489:ios.description:
Lowe’s Knows Home Improvement
Whether you’re a Pro or have a DIY project on your mind, our app lets you search and shop thousands of products— anytime, on the go. 
NEW! EXCLUSIVE PRO EXPERIENCE
A new experience just for Pros is here. Simply sign in with your Pro account and get access to all the Lowe’s for Pros features that make running your business easier. 
AISLE & SHELF INFO
See aisle and shelf information right on the list page—so you know where to go in store. Plus, toggle with a switch to shop only at your preferred Lowe’s store. 
MOBILE CHECK-IN FOR STORE PICKUP
Track your pickup order in real time on the home screen. When it’s ready, check in to let the store know you’re on the way so they can have your order waiting. 
VIEW IN YOUR SPACE
See a product in your space before you buy, with augmented reality. Using your phone’s camera, scan the room and drop the product in your space to see it to scale. 
STORE FINDER
Find the store that’s nearest to you along with the phone number, address, directions and drive time estimates. Plus, set your preferred store to get inventory, product locations and pricing*.
*Remember to allow location services to get the most accurate information available. 
INBOX 
Get messages with special coupons, deals and exclusive promotions sent right to you. 
WEEKLY DEALS
Check the weekly ad for deals at your preferred store. View page by page or by department. 
CUSTOMER RATINGS & REVIEWS
Read what other users are saying about appliances, tools, home décor and beyond! Plus, write your own reviews and easily upload images. 
COMMUNITY Q & A
Ask questions and get answers directly from manufacturers or other customers. 
QUICK LIST & LISTS
Create a Quick List to keep projects organized. Tap the heart on any product page, scan a barcode, or type notes to add to your list—no sign in required. 
ORDER & PURCHASE HISTORY 
Keep track of pending and completed orders all in one place.

bluejetty:00132215:ios.description:
Introducing Synthy — Your Ultimate Audio Books & Reading App!
Do you have a mountain of documents, books, or material to read but no time? Synthy is the perfect PDF reader, text to speech tool, and voice aloud reader to save your day! Simply scan and read, upload text, document or web-link and listen to any text aloud. Whether it’s book reading, articles, or newspapers, our app reads everything for you with natural TTS voices.
Key Features of Synthy:
Text to Speech & Voice Reader
Transform any text into audio! Use your phone’s camera to scan and read books (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, etc.), and let Synthy read text aloud like a personal audio book reader. Perfect for multitasking or book reading on the go!
Realistic AI Voices for Document Reader
No more robotic sounds! Enjoy voice reader technology with lifelike voices. Whether for PDF read aloud, screen reader tasks, or reading apps, Synthy adapts to your style.
Adjustable Speed Reading App
Customize pacing for read aloud comfort. Speed up for quick reviews or slow down to savor content—ideal for audio books and document reader needs.
Type & Listen with Voice Aloud Reader
Need to read text aloud from notes? Type anything, and Synthy will turn text to voice instantly. Great for students and professionals!
Import Files & Web Content
Import PDFs, eBooks, or links—Synthy acts as a screen reader for all formats. Even online articles become audio books with our TTS!
Background Mode
Keep listening while your phone is locked. A must-have for book reading fans and voice reader enthusiasts!
Why Choose Synthy?
More than a PDF reader or text to speech tool, Synthy is your all-in-one voice aloud reader and audio book reader. Whether for scan and read convenience, read aloud flexibility, or document reader functionality.
Book reading lovers
Professionals needing PDF read aloud
Anyone who wants a screen reader or voice reader to speak for me effortlessly!

bluejetty:00121021:ios.summary:
Cascable Studio can take a good camera and make it amazing by helping you control and automate its functions right from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. You can even transfer your photos and videos from it, all from one app.
Compatible with more
bluejetty:00121021:ios.description:
Cascable Studio can take a good camera and make it amazing by helping you control and automate its functions right from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. You can even transfer your photos and videos from it, all from one app.
Compatible with more than 250 different cameras* from the biggest manufacturers, Cascable Studio connects via WiFi and USB* for super-fast image importing and much more.
Whether you're a photography master or an eager hobbyist, Cascable Studio is the app your camera has been missing.
Features include:
- Full control of your camera's exposure and other settings right from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
- Trigger the remote shutter for your camera through the app, whether in a studio, out in the field, or for a group shot.
- Support for timelapses, exposure bracketing, and more with built-in automation tools.
- Apple Watch support for controlling your camera's shutter — perfect for capturing those group shots!
- TV output via both AirPlay and HDMI, making it easier to share your photos with others.
- Built-in calculators for exposure and other features – great for astrophotography and more.
- Fast and easy downloading of full resolution images (including RAW**) directly to your iPhone or iPad.
- RAW capture with ease**.
- Powerful drag-and-drop automation for creating complex and unique timelapse sequences and so much more.
- Support for flash drives and SSDs for more flexible media storage options.
- A zero-tap backup option so you'll never lose a photo again.
- A single, unified interface regardless of the camera you use — no more learning curves when you buy a new camera! 
---
* Available features vary depending on camera model and connection method. When using USB, Cascable can import images from any camera that supports the industry-standard PTP protocol, and can fully remote control and automate Canon EOS, GoPro, Nikon, and Sony cameras. When using WiFi, Cascable supports WiFi or Ethernet equipped cameras from the following model ranges:
- Canon EOS, PowerShot and IXUS/ELPH,
- Fujifilm X and Finepix,
- GoPro HERO 9 Black and newer,
- Nikon D,
- Olympus OM-D, PEN, and SH,
- Panasonic LUMIX,
- Phase One IQ4 with the XT or XF camera system,
- Sony Alpha, HX, RX, and NEX.
** Fujifilm, GoPro, IXUS/ELPH models and certain older Panasonic/PowerShot models don't support RAW image transfer. See the Cascable Studio website for details.
---
Cascable Studio Pro is required to unlock some additional features. Cascable Studio Pro is available as a one-time purchase or subscription – whichever you prefer.
If you choose to subscribe to Cascable Studio Pro the purchase will be charged to your App Store account. The subscription will automatically renew 24 hours before it runs out and you can manage it from User Settings in the App Store. Terms and Privacy Policy: http://cascable.se/privacy
---

The app offers an extensive variety of different features that are designed to help you become more organized and efficient. KEY FEATURES:
- Up to 2 categories to help you better organize your tasks
- 3 different tasks views that include list, grid, and board views
- Unlimited number of tasks
- Unlimited number of subtasks that can be added to help you accomplish your main tasks quicker
- Sync across multiple devices connected to a single iCloud account
- Sync with the system's Reminders app
- Ability to schedule a reminder that will send you a notification when the task is due
- Support for all-day reminders
- Ability to add your tasks and subtasks as events in the system's Calendar app
- Huge variety of tasks sorting options
- Different filters for your tasks lists
- Ability to import all of your reminders from the system's Reminders app
- Ability to import all of your calendar events from the system's Calendar app
- Ability to add notes to each of the tasks and subtasks, as well as to the tasks lists

- Various Home Screen customization options that will let you quickly hide sections that you are not interested in at all
- Fully customizable screens for adding and editing the tasks & subtasks
- Home Screen quick actions
- Multiple swipe actions
- Ability to pin important tasks and subtasks
- Fully native design
- Beautiful dark mode
- Standalone watchOS app
- Support for Siri shortcuts
- Support for app shortcuts on iOS 18 and iPadOS 18
- Support for focus filters
- More than 5 Home and Lock Screen widgets for you to view all of your tasks
- Available on iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, and macOS

- Add an unlimited number of categories
- Advanced board view
- Timeline view for your tasks
- List actions
- Advanced tasks filters
- Securely share and collaborate on your categories with others via iCloud

- Ability to add different attachments to tasks and subtasks, such as files, photos, scanned documents, and drawings

- Ability to edit items in bulk
- 10 different app icons for you to choose the one that you prefer the most

EVERYONE SHOULD HAVE THE TOOLS TO STAY SAFE ONLINE
Utilize Bitwarden for free with no ads and or selling data. Bitwarden believes everyone should have the ability to stay safe online. Premium plans offer access to advanced features.

Plans for Teams and Enterprise come with professional business features. Some examples include SSO integration, self-hosting, directory integration and SCIM provisioning, global policies, API access, event logs, and more.

World-Class Encryption
Passwords are protected with advanced end-to-end encryption (AES-256 bit, salted hashing, and PBKDF2 SHA-256) so your data stays secure and private.
3rd-party Audits
Bitwarden regularly conducts comprehensive third-party security audits with notable security firms. These annual audits include source code assessments and penetration testing across Bitwarden IPs, servers, and web applications.
Advanced 2FA
Secure your login with a third-party authenticator, emailed codes, or FIDO2 WebAuthn credentials such as a hardware security key or passkey.
Bitwarden Send
Transmit data directly to others while maintaining end-to-end encrypted security and limiting exposure.
Built-in Generator
Create long, complex, and distinct passwords and unique usernames for every site you visit. Integrate with email alias providers for additional privacy.
Global Translations
Bitwarden translations exist for more than 60 languages, translated by the global community though Crowdin.
Cross-Platform Applications
Secure and share sensitive data within your Bitwarden Vault from any browser, mobile device, or desktop OS, and more.

bluejetty:00133561:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate playhouse adventure! Step into a beautiful virtual dollhouse where your child can explore, create, and pretend play their own happy family stories. Join a fun virtual family in their sweet dream house and discover daily routines in every corner—from the living room and kitchen to the garage and backyard!
Play House is a fun educational game where kids learn daily life in a household while improving number/letter tracing and math skills! The game offers multiple activities across 8 areas of the house with 10 different characters—a sweet family with cute little pets.
Explore Your Dream Dollhouse
This digital house toy is just like a real-life dollhouse where you can create your own virtual family life. Unleash your imagination across 4 floors of fun:
- Cook in the Kitchen: Prepare a tasty burger or a family dinner for everyone.
- Living Room Fun: Sit down to watch TV or relax and play games with the family.
- Kids Room & Playroom: Explore hundreds of toys, paint on canvas, and play real musical instruments! 
- Garage & Backyard: Fix the family car or have a fun picnic outside with your pets.
- Laundry & Bathroom: Learn about daily routines, baby care, and keeping things tidy.
Endless Pretend Play & Storytelling
In this playhouse, your child has the freedom to make their own choices. Use the elevator to move 10 different characters and items between floors to see what happens! Mix and match hundreds of items to find awesome results, play dress-up games with multiple characters, and create unique home stories. 
THE SKIDOS LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our unique approach engages kids in learning while they play games they love. We've developed an extensive curriculum covering number sense, math, tracing letters/numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and social-emotional learning. Curated by experts, our content fosters curiosity and confidence. 5 million+ kids around the globe play & learn with SKIDOS!
- Smarter, Inclusive Learning: SKIDOS supports kids with ADHD, Dyslexia, Dysgraphia & Dyscalculia. Built with accessibility guidelines, the experience is tailored to every child’s unique needs—making learning inclusive and enjoyable for neurodivergent learners too.
- Math Exercises: Covers number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and geometry. Tasks evolve as a child progresses, supported by interactive animations and three cute SKIDOS mascots who encourage kids.
- Tracing Letters & Numbers: A helpful ladybug shows little learners how to trace with their finger, while engaging visuals and a voice-over teach new words and counting.
- Educational Videos: The right mix of entertainment & learning with a curated video catalog that prompts children's curiosity in a fun and easy way.
100% SAFE FOR KIDS
SKIDOS apps are COPPA & GDPR compliant, and ensure a safe, offline-friendly online learning environment.
SKIDOS Premium: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Premium, children explore a safe space with 1000+ fun activities, gaining life skills and academic positive reinforcement.
- Create up to 6 personalized profiles per account.
- Customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and learning subjects.
- Track progress easily with learning reports in the app.
- SKIDOS offers weekly and annual auto-renewable subscriptions.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after the trial, if applicable.
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends.
- Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your device Account Settings.
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the billing cycle.
Get your SKIDOS Premium today!
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy 
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/ 
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00159784:ios.name: Gangster iv - Mafia Crime City
bluejetty:00159784:ios.summary: Welcome to the seedy underbelly of the city in "Gangstar iv(in veins)." - an app store gangster open-world game that will plunge you into a world of crime, power, and betrayal. In this immersive and thrilling gaming experience, you'll rise
bluejetty:00159784:ios.description:
Welcome to the seedy underbelly of the city in "Gangstar iv(in veins)." - an app store gangster open-world game that will plunge you into a world of crime, power, and betrayal. In this immersive and thrilling gaming experience, you'll rise through the ranks of the criminal underworld, carving your own path and establishing your dominance.
As a player, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious young gangster determined to make a name for yourself in the sprawling metropolis. The city is a hotbed of criminal activity, with rival gangs vying for control, corrupt politicians pulling the strings, and law enforcement struggling to maintain order.
Your journey begins in the gritty streets of the city's poorest neighborhoods, where survival is a constant battle. Engage in intense street fights, petty theft, and low-level jobs to earn a reputation and gain the trust of influential crime bosses. As you progress, you'll unlock new areas of the city, each with its own unique challenges and opportunities for advancement.
The game's open-world environment offers unprecedented freedom. Explore the vast cityscape, from towering skyscrapers to rundown slums, each teeming with life and endless possibilities. Engage in a wide array of activities, such as running illegal businesses, organizing heists, participating in high-stakes poker games, and even engaging in turf wars with rival gangs. The choices you make will shape your character's destiny, leading to multiple branching storylines and outcomes.
"Gangstar iv(in veins)" boasts stunning graphics, bringing the urban landscape to life with its neon-lit streets, atmospheric alleys, and realistic weather effects. The attention to detail extends to the game's diverse cast of characters, from hardened criminals to cunning informants, each with their own motivations and alliances. Engage in dialogue-driven interactions and build relationships that can either help or hinder your ascent to power.
But be warned, in this dog-eat-dog world, alliances are fragile and trust is a luxury. Betrayal lurks around every corner, and your enemies will stop at nothing to bring you down. Stay one step ahead by strategically managing your resources, upgrading your arsenal, and expanding your criminal empire.
With "Gangstar iv(in veins)." the app store's most immersive gangster open-world game, your destiny lies in your own hands. Will you become the ruthless kingpin, feared and respected by all, or will you succumb to the treachery and violence of this unforgiving city? The choice is yours, and the consequences will be legendary. Are you ready to take on the underworld?

bluejetty:00121840:ios.description:
Take a chance to have a virtual pony that you’ve always wanted. Your pony likes running, swimming, gardening, watching beautiful butterflies and, mostly, being a part of your life! Adopt the cutest pony in the world and make your dreams come true.
Take care of your pet’s feeding, sleeping and health. Shower your pony under the waterfall or wash him in a lake. For a good and quiet sleep, put the pony in a stable and turn off the sun.
Sometimes you have to take your pet to the animal hospital to heal his broken bones, cure his teeth or replace an old horse shoe. Train your doctor skills and enjoy being a veterinarian or horse dentist in your pony’s world.
Explore pony’s green land, lake, prairie and steppe. Grow your own vegetables, cereals and fruits like carrots, wheat, apples and many more. Plant flowers to attract butterflies so you can fill all pages in your butterfly collection album. You can customize pony’s home, stable, castle and trees to create a dream world for your pony. 
Have fun playing different mini games, like Diamond Connect, Flying Pony, Pony Jumping and Pony Racing. Earn coins to do a pony makeover and unleash your creativity. Make a rainbow unicorn, galaxy pony, fairy pony and many others. Complete as many funny quests as possible to get super shiny rewards. 
Your cute pet needs some loving care. We promise you’ll have the best virtual pony in the world!
This game is free to play but certain in-game items and features, also some of those mentioned in game description, may require payment via in-app purchases which cost real money. Please check your device settings for more detailed options regarding in-app purchases.
The game contains advertising for Bubadu’s products or some third parties which will redirect users to our or third-party site or app.

bluejetty:00092281:ios.name: GRBbank–Personal
bluejetty:00092281:ios.summary: GRBbank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowe
bluejetty:00092281:ios.description:
GRBbank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with GRBbank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the GRBbank app, you must be enrolled as a Genesee Regional Bank digital banking user, which can be done via the GRBbank app or desktop. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00022288:ios.description:
Mit der ZDFheute-App sind Sie immer up to date. Videos, Livestreams und Texte rund um News zu Wirtschaft, Sport, Politik und Wetter bringen Sie jederzeit auf den aktuellen Nachrichten-Stand. Nutzen Sie außerdem praktische Funktionen wie Videos on demand sowie Newsticker und Push-Meldungen, die Sie auf Ihre persönlichen Interessen abstimmen können. Entdecken Sie jetzt die Inhalte und praktischen Funktionen der ZDFheute-App: 
• Mehr Durchblick: Wir zeigen die wichtigsten Nachrichten auf einen Blick. Jetzt noch übersichtlicher und verständlich erklärt.
• Der neue Videobereich: Alle heute-Sendungen und Videos finden Sie jetzt übersichtlich an einem Ort. Videos starten automatisch, damit Sie sofort im Geschehen sind. Sie möchten das nicht? Dann können Sie Autoplay ganz einfach in den Einstellungen deaktivieren.
• Sport immer im Blick: Der Sport-Bereich ist jetzt Teil der Hauptnavigation – damit Sie immer am Ball bleiben.
• Das Wichtigste in Kürze: Zweimal täglich fassen wir die wichtigsten Schlagzeilen für Sie kompakt zusammen. 
Morgens mit prominenten ZDF-AutorInnen, abends mit Feierabendtipps.
• Meine News: Abonnieren Sie alle Themen und Updates, die Sie besonders interessieren, und stimmen Sie die Push-Meldungen auf Ihre persönlichen Wünsche ab.
• Mehr live: Verpassen Sie nichts mehr und verfolgen Sie wichtige Ereignisse im Livestream.
• Fernsehen unterwegs: Die ZDF-Informationssendungen im Livestream und auf Abruf – unter anderem „heute journal“, „heute 19 Uhr“, „ZDF spezial“, ZDF-Dokumentationen, „maybrit illner“, „auslandsjournal“, „Frontal 21“ und „Berlin direkt“.
• Dark Mode: Lesen Sie Nachrichten jetzt noch augenfreundlicher.
• Schneller Überblick: Im Newsticker finden Sie aktuelle Kurzmeldungen zu allen Bereichen.
• Rubriken-Navigation: Aktuelles aus den Ressorts Politik, Wirtschaft, Panorama, Digitales, Sport und Wetter können Sie über die obere Navigationsleiste direkt ansteuern.
• Apple Watch: Bleiben Sie auf Ihrer Smartwatch immer bestens über die aktuellen Nachrichten informiert – über Kacheln zum Durchblättern und Speichern von Artikeln. 
Die ganze Welt der ZDFheute-Nachrichten vereint in einer App

bluejetty:00199990:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00199990:ios.description:
What’s the one thing you always have on you? Your cell phone. In an emergency, there’s no guarantee that you have the use of your hands. You will need to get help from the person that can help you NOW, not later. 
Currently, Americans make around 240 million 911 calls per year, which are routed through 8,900 dispatch centers, and regulators estimate that as many as 10,000 lives can be saved each year by reducing 911 response times by just one minute.
Covert Alert offers users “Safety in Seconds,” by implementing several key features that are designed for real world emergencies like real-time GPS, live-streaming audio, emergency recordings, cloud storage for the recordings, instantaneous alerts to various safety nets, AI filtering of emergency type, geofencing, and more. 
Most safety apps on the market require the push of a button. Covert Alert is the only safety application on the market using hands free activation to notify user networks of emergency situations.
The most important feature of this app is its ability to be activated covertly, and communicate directly with users’ chosen emergency contacts, all completely hands free. Upon downloading this app, the user has the option to customize three key phrases for three types of emergencies: crime, medical, and fire. Each emergency uses a different set of custom keywords, and if an emergency were to arise, the user simply states their keywords for that emergency type, even if the phone is locked. This triggers an emergency alert, and will aid in saving those valuable seconds in an emergency.
With the free version of our app, users have the option to select up to five emergency contacts that emergency notifications will go to. This puts your safety back into the hands of those you trust most. Think of this first tier as Safety Net 1. Real-time GPS notifies the user’s emergency contacts of the exact location of the emergency and gives them an opportunity to track the situation with specific and valuable situational information. With the paid subscription, the user’s network has an opportunity to listen in with our live-streaming audio feature, which can drastically improve response time, and allow the user to provide even more situation information as the emergency event unfolds.
Our in-app purchases give users more power when it comes to emergency situations than any other option on the market. Users have the option to purchase more emergency text messages, recording minutes, and more all within our in-app store. There will NEVER be advertisements in-app, personal data will not be collected, and the app only tracks location when armed in “Protection Mode,” because this is a safety app first and foremost. Personal safety has never been this high-tech and affordable…EVER!
Features:
Hands free, speech activation, which is triggered by user specific keywords or numbers stated while the app is in “Protection Mode.” 
Instantaneous alerts, which send messages and real time GPS location to designated contacts, informing them of the situation that the user is in.
Recording up to 15 minutes (with the option to purchase more) in any emergency situation, which is saved to the user's device and backed up in a personal cloud that can be accessed at www.covertalert.com.
Full customization of keywords used to trigger alerts sent to designated contacts.
App Highlights:
Personal safety app with voice activation.
Record audio in emergency situations.
Live-streaming direct to contacts.
Share GPS location with friends and family.
For more information about Covert Alert including our privacy policies, a complete user guide, additional features, or email addresses and phone numbers for support, visit us at www.covertalert.com, and visit our Tiktok at tiktok.com/@covertalertapp 
We never sell your data, we never jeopardize our customers’ privacy. 
Covert Alert uses GPS in the background. Note: continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00146176:ios.description:
تطبيق الكتروني يضم نخبة منتقاة من المعبرين الملتزمين بمنهج أهل السنة والجماعة وسلف الأمة في تعبير الرؤى والأحلام وحسن توجيه الرائي وتبشيره أو تنبيهه لما فيه منفعته في دينه ودنياه وفق هدي نبينا محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم القائل لزوجته وحبيبته أم المؤمنين عائشة "رضي الله عنها " (مه يا عائشة إذا عبرتم للمسلم الرؤيا فاعبروها على خير فإن الرؤيا تكون على ما يعبرها صاحبها) حديث صحيح.
مبتعدين بذلك عن التجاوزات والمخالفات الشرعية التي تنتشر اليوم وتضر بالرائي ضرراً بالغاً تفسد شؤونه وقد تتجاوز إلى الإضرار بمن حوله من زوج أو قريب أوصديق أو نحوه.
ومن أمثلة  التجاوزات والمخالفات المنتشرة اليوم ( الاستعانة بالجن ، عدم العلم بتعبير الرؤى والأحلام، ترويع الرائي، المبالغات والحشو الزائد الذي يشتت الرائي، التباهي في ادعاء معرفة التعبير والجزم بتحققه ، الخوض في خصوصيات لا تفيد في التعبير مع سوء الأدب وبشاعة الألفاظ مما ينفر الرائي.
