bluejetty:00123123:ios.description:
Take control of your banking. Our app makes your day-to-day banking easy, quick and secure.
Why the Royal Bank of Scotland app?
Manage your money easily and securely:
• Apply for current, savings, child, teen, Premier, and student accounts quickly. Eligibility criteria apply. 
• See all your bank accounts straight from your Home screen.
• Freeze and unfreeze your card at any time (Mastercard only).
• Use pots to set money aside from your main account for everyday needs and to stay in control of your spending.
• Set up fingerprint, voice or facial recognition for better security and to send high value payments in-app, amend payment limits and more. Fingerprint, voice or facial recognition are only available on selected devices.
Send, receive and access money quickly:
• Request money via a QR code or link.
• Send money faster with a personalised list of favourite payees.
• Split a bill up to £500 by sharing a payment request link with multiple people at once. (Eligible current accounts only. Payment requests can be sent to anyone with an eligible account with a participating UK bank and uses online or mobile banking. Paying bank criteria and limits may apply.)
• iPhone only: Get Cash in emergencies with a unique code without using your card. You can withdraw up to £130 every 24 hours at our branded ATMs. You must have at least £10 available in your account and an active debit card (locked or unlocked).
Stay on top of your spending and saving:
• Keep track of payments all in one place.
• Save your spare change with Round Ups if you have an eligible current account and instant access savings account. Round Ups can only be made on debit card and contactless payments in Sterling.
• Budget easily by managing your monthly spending and set categories.
• Turn on push notifications to get alerted when money reaches or leaves your account.
Get support for every life event:
• Spend abroad in Euros and US Dollars without fees or charges by applying for a Travel account. You must have enough money in your travel account. To apply for a Travel account, you need an eligible sole current account and to be over 18. Other terms and fees may apply.
• Get updates on your credit score and insight on how to improve it. Your credit score data is provided by TransUnion and is only available to customers over 18, with a UK address.
• Discover our additional products and services, including mortgages, home and life insurance and loans, in one place.
• Fast track your money goals with the help of our handy plans, tools and tips.
Important info:
Please note, the app contains images when logging in that may cause a reaction in individuals who are photosensitive. You can switch these off for your device by visiting the settings menu and the accessibility menu, where you will be able to find motion and visual control settings within the menu (note that this is not within our app, but in the settings of your device itself).
Our app is available to customers aged 11+ with a UK or international mobile number in specific countries. Be aware that some features and products have age restrictions and are only available if you’re over 16 or 18.
By downloading this app, you’re accepting our Terms and Conditions, which can be viewed at rbs.co.uk/mobileterms.
Please save or print a copy along with the Privacy Policy for your record.

bluejetty:00160865:ios.description:
You're not crazy. You're just anxious-attached. And it's 2:47am.
Soul is the AI therapy partner that actually figures you out. Not just listens. It reads your chats for patterns, names what's running you, and tells you what your therapist would say if they were available at 3am for $0.
WHAT SOUL ACTUALLY DOES
- Listens like a real one. No scripts, no "and how does that make you feel"
- Spots your patterns: anxious attachment, avoidant pulls, the anxious-avoidant chase, all of it
- Names your love style, your top toxic tendency, your growth edge
- Hands you a real take in 10 seconds. At 3am, on the train, mid-spiral
BUILT FOR THE PEOPLE WHO
- Reread texts 14 times before sending
- Date avoidants and then write a 9-paragraph essay about why
- Lie awake running the same conversation back on loop
- Wanted therapy, but the waitlist is 6 weeks and $200 a session
INSIGHTS, NOT JUST CHATS
Most AI bots reflect your words back at you. Soul does the opposite. It turns your conversations into named outputs. Your attachment style. Your top three patterns. Your next move. Save them. Screenshot them. Send them to the friend who needs to see this too.
24/7. PRIVATE. FREE TO START.
No appointment. No copay. No therapist who only has Tuesdays at 11am. Open the app, start typing, get a real answer.
COMING FROM WOEBOT?
Welcome home. Soul is what Woebot would've been if it kept going, but with actual personality and pattern recognition, not a CBT worksheet on a loop.
WHAT PEOPLE SAY
"Diagnosed my relationship pattern in 3 messages. I'm not okay."
"Finally an AI that doesn't just reflect my words back."
"Saved me one therapy session a week. Math the savings."
YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Encrypted. Soul doesn't train on your conversations. Delete anything, anytime.
WHAT IT COSTS
Free forever for the basics. Soul Pro unlocks deeper insights, pattern history, and unlimited chat. For less than one therapy session a year.
Soul is not a replacement for licensed therapy or a crisis service. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 (US) or your local emergency line.
Made with humans, for humans.
- Human Singularity
Please check out the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://getsoul.ai/privacy
https://getsoul.ai/terms

bluejetty:00120160:ios.description:
"KMF Question Bank for GRE® Test" is a powerful tool specifically developed for GRE preparation by Xueersi, a prestigious and authoritative training institution in the GRE field. As an official partner of ETS (the organization responsible for the GRE), we have created this ultimate tool for practicing GRE questions. It supports authoritative practice questions for GRE Verbal (Text Completion and Reading Comprehension) and Quantitative sections. Additionally, expert-led open classes are available to help you quickly master the GRE!
01 Authoritative GRE Question Bank: Get Started Quickly
All GRE questions come from reputable sources, including the ETS-authorized TAL Prep for the GRE® Test, as well as renowned international GRE prep institutions like Princeton Review, Kaplan, Barron’s, and Magoosh. You can practice questions anytime, anywhere, check detailed explanations, and participate in discussions about each question!
02 Intelligent Practice Records: Enhance Efficiency
Our tool supports timed practice sessions and features such as error logs, favorites, study records, and progress tracking. You can monitor your preparation stage and practice incorrect questions until they are all correct. We provide multi-dimensional data analysis on the number of questions practiced, time spent, accuracy changes, and more—helping you understand your preparation path better than ever!
03 Expert-Led Open Classes: Guidance to Success
Want to improve your accuracy in GRE Text Completion? Looking to master strategies for GRE Reading Comprehension? Need quick tips to refine your GRE writing skills? We offer a variety of expert-led open classes that teach you problem-solving techniques and comprehensive knowledge systems, guiding you to conquer the GRE!
If you encounter any issues while using our tool, please contact us. Every piece of feedback helps us improve!
Developed by Xueersi—Quality Guaranteed
You can always trust Xueersi for your GRE preparation needs!

bluejetty:00041369:ios.description:
Zoom from a planet's surface out to distant galaxies, then reshape the whole system with your own hands.
Solar System Sim is a real-time gravity sandbox built on Newton's laws and real astronomical data. Every body you add, move or destroy recalculates the orbits of everything else, live.
• Smash worlds together: impact craters carve into the surface, firestorms sweep the globe, and glowing debris rains back down.
• Build your own universe: add planets, moons, asteroids and comets with their own size, mass and looks, or customise the ones already there.
• Land anywhere: drop to a first-person view on any planet's surface and experience its environment.
• Sculpt rings: add particle rings and watch gravity shape them in real time.
• Witness real eclipses: solar and lunar, with real-world astronomical precision.
• Follow comets: watch them streak past and interact with the bodies they meet.
• Leave the Solar System: travel to remarkable nearby stars and find them within the Milky Way.
• Feel the scale: see the true vastness of space, from a pebble-sized moon to the nearest galaxies.
Whether you're here to learn how gravity really works or just to break planets with it, explore at your own pace.
Start your cosmic adventure with Solar System Sim.

bluejetty:00137674:ios.description:
Explore the world of Fortias Saga at your fingertips! This idle RPG offers an immersive experience that blends the excitement of exploration with the convenience of effortless progression.
SUMMON LEGENDARY HEROES:
Assemble a formidable team of over 90 unique heroes, each possessing distinct abilities and skills. Every hero plays a crucial role in your quest for glory, from valiant warriors to cunning mages. Strategically combine their strengths to overcome formidable foes and conquer challenging dungeons.
IDLE PROGESSION, ENDLESS REWARDS:
Experience the true meaning of idle gaming as your heroes continue to battle and level up even when you're offline. Reap the rewards of their efforts with regular check-ins, earning valuable loot, powerful equipment, and summon tickets. Enjoy the freedom to play at your own pace while your heroes tirelessly work towards your ultimate victory.
BUILD YOUR SQUAD, CONQUER TOGETHER:
Create and grow your ultimate squad by carefully selecting and combining heroes from your collection. Strategize your team composition based on their unique abilities and synergies, ensuring you're prepared for any challenge that comes your way. Work together with your squad to overcome formidable bosses, conquer challenging dungeons, and claim victory in thrilling multiplayer battles.
DAILY REWARDS, MONTHLY SUPRISES:
Stay engaged and rewarded with a generous array of daily and monthly bonuses. Log in every day to receive free summon tickets, valuable resources, and other delightful surprises. With over 300 summon tickets available each month, you'll have ample opportunities to expand your hero roster and assemble the ultimate dream team.
BUILD UP YOUR TOWN:
Beyond the thrilling battles and heroic quests, Fortias Saga offers a world to explore and develop. Gather resources and upgrade your town to enhance your heroes' abilities and unlock new features. Watch your town flourish as you invest time and effort into its growth.
DIFFERENT MODES! DIFFERENT GAMEPLAY!
With a variety of game modes and countless adventures, Fortias Saga provides endless entertainment. Engage in thrilling PvP battles, test your skills in challenging arenas, and explore hidden dungeons filled with treasures and mythical creatures. Discover new quests, uncover hidden secrets, and immerse yourself in a world of endless possibilities.
NOSTALGIC ANIME ART STYLE:
Step into a world inspired by classic anime with Fortias Saga's captivating art style. From vibrant characters to stunning environments, every detail is brought to life with meticulous attention. Experience the nostalgia and charm of a bygone era as you embark on your heroic adventure.
Download Fortias Saga Now and Begin Your Epic Journey!

bluejetty:00116613:ios.description:
Transform your daily drive with Car Sync Play Connect: AI Data — the intelligent assistant that puts control, entertainment, and insights at your fingertips. Whether you're commuting, road-tripping, or managing a fleet, this app brings together the best of voice technology, smart data syncing, and media integration to redefine your on-the-road experience.
Designed with safety, personalization, and convenience in mind, Car Sync Play Connect enables a smoother, smarter, and more connected journey every time you hit the road.
KEY FEATURES:
Note: Some features are available only with paid subscription.
• AI Voice Control:
Hands-free operation allows you to control navigation, music, messages, calls, and more using natural voice commands. Focus on the road while your virtual co-pilot handles the rest.
• Smart Media Integration:
Play your favorite music, podcasts, and audiobooks effortlessly. The app organizes and syncs your content across devices, delivering a rich entertainment experience tailored to your preferences.
• Real-Time Vehicle Insights:
Monitor important vehicle data, driving behavior, and trip history. Stay informed with fuel efficiency stats, maintenance alerts, and diagnostic insights — all powered by real-time data analytics.

Clover Pit is a demonic rogue-lite that traps players in a hell of their own creation. Locked in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, you must pay off y
bluejetty:00151852:ios.description:
A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a debt simulator!
Clover Pit is a demonic rogue-lite that traps players in a hell of their own creation. Locked in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, you must pay off your debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin – literally!
Manipulate the slot machine to earn extra coins. Turn the odds in your favor with various prizes and charms that trigger big big combos, snowballing into a dazzling lucky run. Bend the rules, break the game, and pay off your captor long enough to earn a shot at freedom.
Features:
- A gripping rogue-lite where every round could be your last!
- Meta-progression, multiple endings and unlockable power-ups!
- Push your score to new heights in Endless Mode!
- A hellish escape room atmosphere!
- 150 + items and synergies to boost your luck!
- A sinister tale of addiction and escape!
Note on Save Data: This game currently stores progress locally on your device. Please be aware that uninstalling the app (or clearing app data) will delete your save file. Cloud Save & Cross-Device Sync are in development for a future update.
P.S. IS THIS GAMBLING?
No! CloverPit is a rogue-lite horror game, and not a slot machine simulator. Our slot machine is designed to be broken and ultimately overcome, and will never ask you for real money!

bluejetty:00042135:ios.description:
Savvy Citizen is a community notification system to keep you better informed of local events and alerts. Local community information is added by your participating municipality or county with the goal of keeping you informed. Choose any combination of push notification, text or email as your method of notification then go about your day. Simply download the app, select your community, and start receiving notifications. It’s free. Become a more Savvy Citizen today.
App features include:
• A community calendar of events with dates, times and details, even updates and changes.
• Local alerts which may include road closures, water main breaks, school closings, etc.
• The capability for local governments to update in real time happenings that impact your day.
• The option to customize and edit how you receive notifications.
• The ability to manage communities you would like to receive events and alerts from.

bluejetty:00023099:ios.summary: How many negative thoughts have been repeating in your mind? Your brain notices more than you think, so put positive affirmations where you'll see them. Daily affirmations help rewire your thoughts, build self-esteem, and change negative th
bluejetty:00023099:ios.description:
How many negative thoughts have been repeating in your mind? Your brain notices more than you think, so put positive affirmations where you'll see them. Daily affirmations help rewire your thoughts, build self-esteem, and change negative thought patterns. Empower yourself by verbally affirming your dreams and ambitions. Choose from many daily intentions and set reminders to be delivered throughout the day.
Positive affirmations help make major shifts in your mindset, and they also serve as prompts and daily reminders about what you’re truly capable of, ensuring every day is an amazing day
An affirmation is a simple but powerful statement that helps to strengthen the connection between your conscious and unconscious mind. The more you strengthen this connection, the more resilient you’ll be when you experience difficult or challenging circumstances.
As Buddha wisely said: you become what you believe. And the best way to strengthen your resilience is to practice affirmations every single day.
There are many benefits to using affirmations as part of your daily morning routine:
- They help increase your awareness of your thoughts and words, making it easier to recognize the negative and self-doubting thought patterns holding you back.
- Affirmations define your focus. When you focus your energy on the things you want, like achieving your goals, the positive, uplifting, and good, you’re creating an abundance mindset and strengthening your resolve to make it happen.
- They open you up to possibility. Too often we get stuck in the ‘impossible’ mindset, but affirmations flip this on its head. When you begin to positively affirm what is actually possible, a whole world of opportunity opens up to you.
To get access to the I am Premium content and functionality, you can choose between a lifetime, monthly, and yearly auto-renewable subscription. This is a recurring transaction that will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of your subscription. Renewals will be charged at the same cost within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Find tons of inspiring content on our blog: https://blog.theiam.app/
Privacy Policy: https://monkeytaps.net/privacy
Terms of use: https://monkeytaps.net/terms

bluejetty:00070020:ios.summary:
Will you be able to manage a penitentiary facility and become a prison tycoon?
Take control of the business and become rich by reforming citizens around the world.
Start running a small low-security facility and work hard to make your rep
bluejetty:00070020:ios.description:
Will you be able to manage a penitentiary facility and become a prison tycoon?
Take control of the business and become rich by reforming citizens around the world.
Start running a small low-security facility and work hard to make your reputation grow. Improve every detail and turn your modest establishment into a state-of-the-art center with the most challenging residents under control.
Deal with the needs of your facilities and take the proper decisions to expand your business with no internal issues. Enlarge the yard, customize the administration department, provide better equipment to the staff, or even improve the ventilation. Every single choice will have an impact on your institution. Invest your idle money intelligently.
MEET THE RESIDENTS' BASIC NEEDS:
Residents have indicators of personal qualities that you should administer to avoid unrest and security breaches. Upgrade their living quarters, add better beds, and increase their comfort; buy bookshelves, build a basketball court, or install telephone booths to keep them entertained. Spend your profits on a better kitchen and quality meals so you will have well-nourished individuals; keep the facilities clean and get new showers to maintain good hygiene.
MANAGE YOUR STAFF:
Your facility will need an efficient working team. Study the situation and hire workers depending on your workflow and your growth strategy. Employ kitchen personnel, doctors, builders, janitors, or security staff, as well as office workers. Each department will cover basic needs in your business, and you should manage your team wisely to make your center profitable.
INVEST IN YOUR FACILITIES:

bluejetty:00023957:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00023957:ios.description:
Keep daily notes and diary entries together on one page. Turn pages like a book and revisit your past entries.
Search, iCloud sync, and a passcode lock help you organize and access your notes. Core features are free; ad removal is a one-time purchase.
■ Your day on one page
See the notes and diary entries you write each day together on one page. Swipe or tap to turn pages and look back on everyday moments and memories.
■ Find past entries
Use the contents list or search to find a note you want to revisit. Change a note's date to record plans or past events.
■ Make reading and writing comfortable
Adjust the text size or use Dark Mode. Copy, print, or share your notes.
■ Protect access with a passcode
Lock access to your diary with a passcode. Face ID / Touch ID is available on supported devices.
■ Sync between devices with iCloud
With iCloud sync enabled, notes synchronize automatically between devices using the same Apple Account. iCloud sync is enabled by default for new installations. iCloud Drive and Notebook's iCloud access must be enabled, with available storage and a network connection. Synchronization may take time.
iCloud sync and device backups are separate features. Check your sync status and backups before changing devices.
■ Recover deleted notes
Recover notes within 30 days of deletion from Recently Deleted in Settings.
■ Remove ads with a one-time purchase
Core features are free. Premium removes ads with a one-time purchase, not a subscription. After changing devices, use Restore Purchases with the Apple Account used for your purchase.
Over 2 million downloads worldwide. Rated 4.7 out of 5 from over 21,000 ratings across all countries and regions (October 2026).
Capture your everyday moments, one page at a time.

bluejetty:00037371:ios.description:
Planning a trip? Looking to travel at the fairest price without compromising on comfort and quality? Discover the new B&B HOTELS app for a unique experience, whether it's a business trip, a weekend getaway, a vacation, or a last-minute stay.
B&B HOTELS offers more than 700 hotels in Europe and Brazil. Our hotels provide a generous breakfast buffet, the comfort of a good bed, the security of reliable Wi-Fi, parking, and much more!
With the B&B HOTELS mobile app:
• Save time and enjoy your room immediately with online check-in.
• Benefit from the new free loyalty program, B&me, and enjoy a generous and free breakfast on your second stay, a night for €50 in all our latest hotels, or a free Sunday check-out until 2 PM!
Remote Check-In:
Save time by booking and accessing your room as a member of our loyalty program through our app or website – it's quick and free! A few hours before your arrival at the hotel, you will receive your room number and access code. This way, there's no need to go to the reception. All that's left is to reach your bed and enjoy your stay.
Your B&B HOTELS Account:
Simply log in to your account from the app, access your customer benefits, and be rewarded for your loyalty! With B&me, you can enjoy a generous and free breakfast on your second stay, a night for €50 in all our latest hotels, or a free Sunday check-out until 2 PM! With your B&B Clubs program, you can accumulate points and exchange them for vouchers offering free breakfasts and nights*. Easily keep track of your different reservations and personal information all in one place.

bluejetty:00088414:ios.summary:
Dive into the ultimate ocean adventure and become the hero our seas desperately need in Idle Eco Miner: Ocean Cleanup! 
In this 3D idle tycoon game, take command of your boat and embark on a mission to clean up the toxic oil spills plaguin
bluejetty:00088414:ios.description:
Dive into the ultimate ocean adventure and become the hero our seas desperately need in Idle Eco Miner: Ocean Cleanup! 
In this 3D idle tycoon game, take command of your boat and embark on a mission to clean up the toxic oil spills plaguing our beautiful oceans. Save planet Earth by catching & rescuing adorable sea creatures, from fish to octopus, trapped in the pollution!
Build your oil empire as you extract valuable resources from the depths of the sea. Turn the black goo into gold: watch the cash flow with every click! Use the money to buy upgrades for your fleet! Transform a small fishing boat into the ultimate eco-friendly cleaner ship! 
Upgrade your boat's equipment to boost efficiency and increase your earnings. From advanced vacuum systems to green engines, every upgrade brings you closer to becoming the ultimate ocean tycoon! Move faster, expand your trunk's capacity, and hire small boats to help you out. The more, the merrier
Explore new areas and unlock exotic locations as you expand your cleanup operation across the globe. From tropical paradises to icy Arctic waters, no corner of the ocean is too remote for your eco-friendly endeavors. Beat levels to discover new types of waste and pollution. From black oil spills to sparkling toxic waste. How can something so dangerous be this pretty?
Encounter rare and cute sea creatures along your journey, each offering unique bonuses to aid in your cleanup efforts. Can you find them all? Watch closely as you clean every corner of the level. Remember, you get extra bonuses if you suck it all! Catch and release fish! Your new friends will reward you with valuable resource – each encounter brings a sense of wonder to your oceanic adventure.
Game Features:
Stunning Graphics: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning 3D world filled with vibrant marine life and breathtaking ocean vistas.
Idle Tycoon Gameplay: Relax and watch your empire grow as you automate your cleanup operation and collect the rewards. Control cash flow with one click!
Unique Upgrades: Customize your boat with a variety of upgrades to suit your playstyle and maximize your profits.
Exotic Locations: Explore diverse environments, from bustling coral reefs to mysterious underwater caverns, as you expand your reach across the globe.
Relax & de-stress: Take a break from everyday worries and listen to ASMR sounds while cleaning! Make your own perfect asmr experience and boost your mood!
With stunning graphics and a stress-relieving atmosphere, Idle Eco Miner: Ocean Cleanup is not just about business—it's about saving our planet, one click at a time. So what are you waiting for? Download now and start saving the planet!

bluejetty:00026637:ios.name: Japan Travel - Smart Transit
bluejetty:00026637:ios.summary: Japan Travel by NAVITIME is a Japan transit and trip-planning app that helps international visitors navigate Japan stress-free — by train, shinkansen, bus, taxi, ferry and on foot. Pass-aware route search (incl. the JR Pass), 100% bus route
bluejetty:00026637:ios.description:
Japan Travel by NAVITIME is a Japan transit and trip-planning app that helps international visitors navigate Japan stress-free — by train, shinkansen, bus, taxi, ferry and on foot. Pass-aware route search (incl. the JR Pass), 100% bus route coverage including rural areas, travel guides, itineraries that auto-calculate travel times, and shinkansen ticket booking — all in one app, trusted for over 10 years.
Key Features
[Route Search]
Find the best route anywhere in Japan in seconds — shinkansen, JR, subways, local trains, buses, taxis, ferries and flights. Choose from 50+ rail and unlimited-ride passes such as the Japan Rail Pass, JR TOKYO Wide Pass and Tokyo Subway Ticket, and see which legs your pass covers, which cost extra, and what you actually pay. See which car to board and which platform, whether to board a bus at the front or rear and pay when boarding or getting off, a 6-level crowding forecast per leg, and less crowded trains just before or after. Searches factor in real-time train and shinkansen delays and show detours around them. You can also set a slower walking speed for large luggage, or search for routes with fewer stairs, staying dry in the rain, or step-free access.
Hold your IC card (Suica, PASMO and more) to your phone to check its balance, and find luggage storage along your route.
[AI Camera Guide "Check & Ride"]
Not sure the train or bus in front of you is the right one? Photograph the platform departure board or bus destination sign. AI reads the Japanese display instantly and tells you whether it matches the route you searched — no Japanese language skills needed.
[Travel Guides & Itineraries]
Articles on Tokyo, shinkansen tips, Japan wifi, food and culture by international writers living in Japan — save every spot mentioned with one tap. Pick an itinerary from NAVITIME or other app users, or build your own day-by-day plan by placing spots on the map. Whenever you add or reorder spots, transport, travel and waiting times update automatically, with a running total cost. Invite companions to edit with you. Available in 13 languages, with map labels in 5.
[Local Support & Booking]
Where or when trains don't run, book a taxi from the map or route details. Check the fare estimate and license plate, and send your driver a preset message — no Japanese needed. Pay in the app and see the amount in your home currency. Get earthquake, tsunami, weather and volcano alerts with shelter search, and buy shinkansen tickets and the NAVITIME eSIM in-app. Hotels, passes and activities are bookable too.
[Who It's For]
- First-time visitors and solo travelers unsure about Japanese station signs and transfers
- Pass holders wanting full value from their rail pass
- Travelers with heavy luggage, avoiding stairs, or using a wheelchair
- Anyone planning a multi-city or rural trip by train, bus and subway
[What You Get]
- One photo of a departure board confirms you're on the right train — no Japanese reading needed
- 100% bus route coverage reaches rural Japan where trains don't go
- Know what your pass covers and what costs extra before you board
- Which car, which platform, how crowded — stress-free travel days
- Find stations, Japan wifi spots, ATMs, currency exchange and rail maps offline
- After the last train, call a taxi and identify it by its license plate
[Premium] Upgrade via in-app purchase.
- Alternative routes during delays
- Voice navigation
- Timetables and stop lists
- Real-time bus location
In short: Japan Travel by NAVITIME is a public transport navigation and trip planning app for visitors to Japan, available in 13 languages. Its AI camera feature, Check & Ride, reads a photo of a platform departure board or bus destination sign and tells you whether the train or bus matches your searched route. Free to download, with an optional premium upgrade.

bluejetty:00090739:ios.description:
The RXNT Mobile App allows healthcare providers to prescribe medications, schedule patient appointments, and capture charges on the go. Efficiently manage your practice and have more time for quality patient care.
E-PRESCRIBING
Safely prescribe medications faster and more reliably from anywhere, with features including: 
• Cloud-based access 24/7
• Real-time patient prescription history 
• EPCS certification for prescribing controlled substances
• Queueing prescriptions for physician approval
• Creating custom sigs for frequently prescribed medicines
• Integration with the patient's Electronic Health Record
• Connection to all US retail and mail-order pharmacies
• Designating favorite and preferred pharmacies
• Linking to national drug databases
• Checking for drug and allergy interactions
• Connecting with national pharmacy benefit managers
• Handling prescription renewals
SCHEDULING
Easily view and manage your practice's schedule to maximize efficiency and reduce downtime. Features include: 
• Cloud-based access 24/7
• Coordinating appointments across multiple locations
• Coordinating availability across multiple locations 
• Viewing open and booked appointment times
• Run and view reports 
CHARGE CAPTURE
Get paid faster by quickly and accurately documenting a patient's visit before they've even left the office. Features include:
• Cloud-based access 24/7
• Searching and selecting date of service, place of service, and super bill
• Searching and selecting procedure, diagnosis, and modifier codes
• Accessing customized procedure macros and CPT codes
• Accessing ICD-10 drill-down technology
• Integrating with billing systems
• Run and view reports 
WHY RXNT?
Since 1999, RXNT has offered award-winning healthcare software, including E-Prescribing, Electronic Health Records, Practice Management with Medical Billing, and an integrated Full Suite system.
Our innovative software comes with easy set-up, dedicated onboarding coaches, full staff training, premium US-based support, regular system upgrades, and a suite of mobile applications, all at no extra cost.
FOLLOW US - https://linkedin.com/company/rxnt
LIKE US - https://facebook.com/rxntehealth
SUBSCRIPTION DETAIL
Available at no extra cost to customers who subscribe to one of RXNT’s solutions.
TERMS AND PRIVACY
Read the terms and conditions: https://www.rxnt.com/customer-agreement/
Read our privacy policy: https://www.rxnt.com/client-services-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00097102:android.summary: Welcome to Tile Match Crush—a vibrant and colorful match-3 adventure that invites you into a mesmerizing world of beauty and challenge! Here, you will not only enjoy a visually stunning tile-matching game but also engage in intimate interac
bluejetty:00097102:android.description:
Welcome to Tile Match Crush—a vibrant and colorful match-3 adventure that invites you into a mesmerizing world of beauty and challenge! Here, you will not only enjoy a visually stunning tile-matching game but also engage in intimate interactions with the coolest beauty streamers, experiencing a feast for both the eyes and the heart.
In the game, you will eliminate various sparkling beauty diamonds to send generous gifts to the streamer, boosting her affection for you. Every match you make adds to her charm, making her shine even brighter in the live stream! But be careful—if you fail to increase your affection quickly enough, you might miss the perfect opportunity for a close interaction with her!
To assist you on your quest, the game features four mysterious power-ups that will help you tackle various challenges and enhance the fun and strategy of each match. By cleverly using these power-ups, you'll be able to turn the tide in critical moments and secure your victory!
As your affection for the streamer grows, unique photos of her will be unlocked, allowing you to appreciate her captivating beauty in different scenarios. Each photo tells a story, waiting for you to explore and share. Even more exciting, you can spend coins to upgrade the level of your gifts, enhancing your power and becoming the most dazzling presence in the streamer’s heart!
In the dazzling world of Tile Match Crush, you will experience the perfect blend of passion and strategy, challenge yourself, improve your skills, and win the affection of the streamer. Every level presents a new adventure, and every match is filled with surprises. Join us and embark on a journey to create beautiful memories with your favorite streamer! Let’s together craft your legendary story in this enchanting game world!

Drink water reminder is an application with main function is to help us keep water tracker we need to re
bluejetty:00127984:ios.description:
If you're too busy to remember having to drink enough and regularly, don't worry, there's "drink water" to help you solve that problem.
Drink water reminder is an application with main function is to help us keep water tracker we need to replenish and water drinking reminder in time. Users only need to select a gender and enter a weight number, it will help you calculate how much water should you drink per day. You can also tracker water history, reach your daily goal to open the respective achievements, and many other useful functions, ... Water drinking reminder will help you build a good habit with healthy body.
* Main features :
- Easy to use, beautiful interface.
- Based on gender, weight will let you know how much water should drink a day.
- Human body graphics to drinking water tracker
- Diverse menu of nearly 20 different drinks.
- Can choose the amount of water each time.
- Smart reminder: time mode go to bed so you don't get drink water reminder.
- Water tracker by week, month and year in the chart
- Can adjust the amount of drinking water in the past.
- Can option interval time receive drink water reminder message
- Achievements to encourage you to accomplish your daily goal.
- Apple Health app integration: the app uses HealthKit to record your drink history to the Nutrition section of the Apple Health app.
With many benefits of drinking water such as weight loss, healthy skin, reduced fatigue and preventing many diseases, ... a drink water reminder application is extremely useful and necessary. So, "drink water" is like a companion to your health. Use now to your water tracker.
If you want to keep healthy, drink enough. Want to drink enough, install water drinking reminder ! If you feel this water drinking reminder application is useful, share it with your friends and family. Above all, we are excited and hope to receive your feedback or ideas for we can complete and develop this app in the next version.Any feedback please send to contact@medilab.tohsoft.com.
To view the EULA and Privacy Policy, please visit:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
https://medilab.tohsoft.com/ios-application/drink-water-drinking-reminder/policy

Become a fighting legend and defeat all challengers, enjoy the epic fighting game
The story of our kungfu hero begins in a small, remote, peaceful village. Under the guidance of a sage, a master of magic. Every day, he gained a greater skill in ancient kungfu martial arts.
Disaster struck, without warning, a group of thugs have descended on his small village. They plunder, loot and burn. Determined to save the village, the old master fought with all his might. In the end, he was able to chase away the bandits. But in his efforts, he paid a heavy price, sacrificing his life.
Our kungfu hero has promised. he will avenge his master and accept a burden of responsibility, keeping the village safe and secure. Our story begins!
*** Features of the game. ***
- Facing countless attacks and melee from opponents, you have to fight them with all kinds of weapons and skills. In addition to simple techniques, the hero is able to perform effective combinations, combined with spells.
- Play the game and learn how to fight barefoot, with punches and kicks with your own awesome skills.
- High-quality attack effects and graphics.
- Experience countless battles and become a super hero.
- World of fantasy and high quality martial arts.
- Awesome HD super master graphics and stunts.
- The most satisfying gaming experience.
- Beautiful action design.
- Interesting sound effects.

bluejetty:00119434:ios.description:
ONLYOFFICE Documents - Your mobile office for iOS
ONLYOFFICE Docs for iOS is a free office app allowing you to create and edit documents, spreadsheets, presentations, forms, and PDFs on your iPhone or iPad. Work locally or connect the app to your favourite cloud: ONLYOFFICE, Dropbox, Box, iCloud, Nextcloud, ownCloud, or kDrive.
ONLYOFFICE Documents for iOS offers wide format compatibility from MS Office formats (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) to Apple files (Pages, Numbers, Keynote), Hangul Word Processor formats (HWP, HWPX), ODG drawings, Markdown files, and even media files.
Connect to your cloud to collaborate with your teammates in real time. Leave comments, track changes, manage versions, and assign flexible permissions for viewing, commenting, or editing. You can also share documents with external collaborators via link, accept or reject their changes, and fill out role-based forms in secure Virtual Data Rooms (VDRs).
Work faster with AI: use the AI assistant, generate documents and presentations, fill out forms automatically, and use on-device voice input in AI chats and AI assistants.
Scan paper documents with your camera, extract text, and convert them into editable files.
With powerful collaboration features and superb format compatibility, ONLYOFFICE Documents helps you stay connected and efficient on the go.
Key features for better produсtivity
Real-time collaboration
• Comment, track and review changes
• Fill out role-based forms in VDR
• Control access with read, review, or full rights
• Easy sharing, even with external collaborators
Document Editor
• Insert tables, autoshapes, images, charts
• Recognize handwritten text to create notes
• Add graphic annotations and markup
• Insert footnotes, endnotes, page numbers, section breaks
• Set font type, size, and colour
• Change text wrapping
• Protect documents with a password
Spreadsheet Editor
• Select, cut, copy, paste data
• Set font type, size, and colour
• Apply cell style, add cell borders, align data in cells
• Wrap text in a cell 
• Insert tables, autoshapes, images, charts, formulas
• Resize, move, rotate objects, reshape autoshapes
• Add annotations and free-hand drawings
• Protect spreadsheets with a password
• Sort and filter data
• Work collaboratively on spreadsheets
Presentation Editor
• Mobile presentation viewer
• Select, cut, copy, paste text and objects
• Change slide layout, background, parameters, theme
• Apply transitions
• Insert tables, autoshapes, images, charts
• Add annotations and free-hand drawings
• Create lists
• Discuss slides in real-time
• Protect presentations with a password
• Download and print presentations
PDF form filler
• Open and fill out forms stored on your device
• Use ready templates from the template library
• Protect forms with a password
• Export ready forms in DOCX or PDF
Why Choose ONLYOFFICE Documents?
• No need to install additional apps for editing docs
• Clear, user-friendly interface
• Work anywhere, anytime
• Robust collaboration tools
• Support for all key document formats
• Absolutely free
• No ads or in-app purchases
Enjoy smooth editing and seamless document collaboration with ONLYOFFICE Documents.
Your mobile office is just one tap away—download it today!

bluejetty:00175912:ios.description:
Backgammon Online - The Ultimate Backgammon Experience!
Embark on the most thrilling backgammon journey on mobile with Backgammon Online! With the finest design, intuitive interface, and electrifying gameplay, this online multiplayer backgammon game is more than just a game - it's a community.
Play, Connect, Compete and Win!
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER FUN

MAKE FRIENDS & CHAT
Meet like-minded backgammon enthusiasts and make new friends. Our friendly chat interface allows you to connect, strategize, or just have a fun conversation with your opponents and friends.
DETAILED STATISTICS
Track your performance with comprehensive statistics. Analyze your gameplay, discover your strengths and weaknesses, and take your backgammon game to the next level.

FRIENDS' SCORES & LEADERBOARDS
Battle your friends, keep an eye on their scores, and compete to be the backgammon king or queen among your circle. The bragging rights are all yours!
FEATURES:
Engaging Online Multiplayer Mode
In-Game Chat with Friends
Advanced Statistics and Insights
Regional and Global Leaderboards
Daily Rewards and Bonuses
Customizable Game Boards and Themes
Backgammon Online takes online multiplayer backgammon to unprecedented heights. With rich features, vibrant graphics, and a community that's ready to welcome you, there's no better place to roll the dice.
What are you waiting for? Download Backgammon Online today and join the world's most dynamic backgammon community!

bluejetty:00080988:ios.description:
“Shareshot does things that a shortcut can’t, and the results it produces look fantastic.”
- MacStories
“The first app that’s taken a spot on my main Control Center screen is Shareshot.”
— Stephen Robles
“One of the things I liked most about Shareshot is that it’s very intuitive.”
— 9to5Mac
~~ Winner of MacStories Selects "Best Design" 2024 ~~
~~ Upgradies 2024 Runner-up: Best Newcomer iOS App ~~
Create beautiful images for sharing screenshots, social posts, text, source code, podcasts and more so quickly it seems unreal.
UNLIMITED FREE USE WITH NO WATERMARKS on single framed screenshots.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
* Add a perfectly fitted device frame to screenshots from iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and more. Perfect for sharing lock & home screen setups, promoting apps or adding device images to web content. Use batch mode to process many images instantly with consistent results.
* Hide or blur personal information like names, faces and bank details with a single tap.
* Instantly create images from social post links for reposting or adding to presentation slides, with option to include original links and QR Codes. (Supports X, BlueSky, Mastodon)
* Add text or Markdown to post online as images using the supplied themes for announcements or promotions.
* Paste source code fragments to get syntax-highlighted images for sharing online or in presentations.
* Import links to automatically create attractive "card" images for sharing.
All standard device bezels are included for free, always.
A Pro subscription removes restrictions on more advanced features including: batch mode, custom background images, custom frame images, and Shortcuts.
BACKGROUNDS
* Add a pretty background — with thousands of gradient variations, striped patterns, and LGBTQ+ and solidarity flags to show off your screenshot.
* Highlight your image with the light position control for shadow and lighting effects in the background.
* Use any custom image as a background. (*)
MAGIC IMPORT
* Paste, Drop, Open or directly type in text that is automatically rendered as an attractive image.
* Text and Markdown is converted to an image using themes provided.
* Source Code is drawn with syntax highlighting.
* Links to Social Posts produce social "cards" without having to crop a screenshot (X, BlueSky and Mastodon).
* Apple Music, Apple Maps, App Store, YouTube and podcast links all create shareable card images.
BATCH MODE (*)
* Import many images in batch mode, apply the same style settings to all and
see the changes instantly with automatic file naming.
* Customize per-image settings like device frame, corner radius and privacy redactions.
* Create framed or text-based image carousels by dropping/importing multiple files and drag out the resulting images directly into another app to post them.
PRIVACY
* Automatic detection of Identification, Financial information and Faces.
* Always automatically hides Financial information.
* Tap a button to hide a piece of information or show it.
* Multiple redaction styles.
THE PERFECT FRAME
* Device frames always fit the resolution of the screenshot, no janky stretched or cropped images.
* Add your own custom frame with a clear area where the screenshot should be — frame any images!
* Use any image if no frame is required, or choose "No frame" if you prefer to go without.
SHORTCUTS & SIRI
* Automate batch processing with powerful Shortcuts actions to frame each screenshot in the input.
* Many powerful Shortcut Intents: "Frame last screenshot", "Open Shareshot with most recent screenshot", "Frame Screenshots", "Frame Screenshots with a custom background", "Create Image from Text", "Create Image from Links" and "Create Image from Source Code".
* Siri "App Shortcut" support for saying "New Shareshot" to frame the last screenshot, opens the app ready for you to tweak the background.
 (*) - Requires Pro
For Terms of Use see: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00121353:ios.description:
Stream your favorite FYI TV shows! 
Barrett-Jackson LIVE Auction, Sell This House!, Ultimate Rides, to name a few. 
Watch your favorites and discover your next binge from FYI’s trove of shows that inspire the ‘enthusiast’ in us all by highlighting those who live life to the fullest and pursue their passions and interests. 
With the newly re-designed FYI app, you can: 
> Watch full episodes and clips 
> Catch up on entire seasons of new and classic shows 
> See exclusive clips and deleted scenes, never shown before on television 
> Create a profile with FYI so you can continue watching episodes whenever you want, on any device 
HOME.MADE 
HOME.MADE. is the hub of all things DIY, home improvement, decor and food. From household tips and projects you can try yourself to the stories and experiences of experts, inspiration truly has a home in HOME.MADE. 
Shows include: 
Rachael Ray’s Italian Dream Home 
Sell This House 
Tiny House Nation 
Zombie House Flipping 
Vacation Rental Potential 
Working the Room 
Million Dollar House Hunters 
DRIVE 
DRIVE immerses you in all things that get you from A to B. From cars to trucks, from bikes to boats, DRIVE allows you to follow your passion and experience it all when the rubber hits the road — all from the comfort of your living room. 
Shows include: 
Barrett-Jackson LIVE 
The Ride That Got Away 
Barrett-Jackson REVVED UP 
Car Issues 
United We Drive 
OUTDOORS 
OUTDOORS gives you all the inspiration and resources you need to follow your passion for getting out there and experiencing everything the outdoors has to offer, even when you’re doing it from the comfort of your living room! 
Shows include: 
Hard Truths of Conservation 
From Scratch 
Mountain Men 
COLLECTIBLES 
For the passionate collector in you, and the love of things big and small – everyday items with hidden value, unusual rarities and found treasures – and what they tell us about the world we live in. 
Shows include: 
Storage Wars 
The Liquidator 
HERO 
From today’s active-duty military to veterans who fought long ago for this country, HERO celebrates acts of courage both at home and on foreign soil. A deep library of courageous stories told against the backdrop of the country’s most important moments make it a compelling viewing destination for viewers. 
Shows include: 
Rise of the Superbombs 
Hitler’s Secret Tunnels 
Vie

bluejetty:00178283:ios.description:
RadioMail provides access to the Winlink amateur radio email system. Compose, read, and reply to messages from anywhere. A valid amateur radio license is required to use this app.
NETWORK ACCESS
Send and receive messages via telnet using the main Winlink server or through the Amateur Radio Emergency Data Network (AREDN).
RADIO ACCESS
Pair your device with a VARA or KISS TNC modems using WiFi or Bluetooth. Packet mode on VHF/UHF supports the following radios and devices:
Radios with Built-in TNCs (Auto-sets and restores frequency on those radios)
 · BTECH UV-PRO, UV-50PRO
 · VERO VR-N76, VR-N7600
 · RADIODITY GA-5WB, DB50-B 
 · Kenwood TH-D74*, TH-D75*
 · PicoAPRS V4
*Requires B.B. Link Bluetooth adapter
Portable KISS TNCs
 · Mobilinkd TNC3, TNC4
 · LiNK500 TNC
 · DigiPi
 · Dire Wolf Software TNC
For Robust Packet Mode on HF:
・LiNK500 TNC
Configuration of up to two digipeaters is possible for packet or VARA FM mode connections. Note for VARA: An operational version of the VARA modem must be available on a separate computer.
BUILT-IN PACKET MODEM
Connect to packet stations via the internal 1200 baud AFSK modem using compatible audio interfaces:
・Digirig Lite
・Digirig VOX cable
・AIOC (All-In-One Cable)
STATION DIRECTORY
Automatic retrieval of station details from Winlink, organized by proximity to your current location. Custom stations can be added for peer-to-peer connections. Note: Peer-to-peer connections are only outbound.
FAVORITES LIST
Save stations to your favorites list for quick access by modes and bands during connection initiation.
PHOTO ATTACHMENTS
Sharing photos is easy with RadioMail. Access your device's camera directly or attach photos from your library. The app optimizes images to reduce transmission time. Preview and annotate received attachments, save to local folders or iCloud, or share via other apps.
FORMS
Compose and view 100+ standard Winlink forms. Forms are kept current with automatic updates. GPS coordinates are pre-filled according to user location. Received forms can be shared or printed as PDFs. Custom specialized forms can be installed by importing a zip file. Note: Form access is an optional premium feature requiring an in-app subscription.
POSITION REPORT
Utilize your phone's internal GPS for accurate location data in position reports, which are posted to the Automatic Packet Reporting System (APR

bluejetty:00175683:ios.description:
Polar Club is the window to your members’ effort in real- time. Engage and motivate your members with Polar Club real-time effort tracking that is based on scientifically validated and accurate Polar heart rate zones. Plan and schedule classes, train with live heart rate, guide your members as a group or as individuals, and create a gamified premium experience with fun individual and group rewards.
If you're looking for a wearable technology designed for gyms, studios and fitness and health clubs, Polar Club group fitness and gym heart rate app is the perfect solution to drive results and retention.
PLAN, SCHEDULE, TRAIN & ENGAGE. All with one app.
1. Easy class planning and individual guidance
» Create repeating classes with class templates.
» Manage your instructors through instructor invites.
» Set real-time class targets as visual group goals to your class and guide members individually to achieve their best.
» Plan your group exercise classes in detail according to the individual heart rate zones with phased workouts.
2. Real-time performance data*
» Track and display your class' effort in real time with a class view for up to 90+ participants and guide them to reach their goals with performance data, such as heart rate, intensity and calories burned.
» Motivate exercisers with visually engaging rewards, such as zone time or calorie trophies.
» Keep track of your member’s progress and help them reach their goals with individual rewards, post class summary and automated summary emails.
3. Reach your members with Polar Flow
»Keep your members accountable with Polar fitness trackers or free Polar Beat app. The Polar Club app is compatible with several Polar heart rate sensors and fitness trackers.*
» In Polar Flow your club members can easily check their personal training data and follow their progress as well as share and comment on their own and their friends’ achievements.
» Your member's can also share their training data with their PT with the free Polar Flow for Coach service.
» Polar Flow is connected with other fitness platforms such as Strava, MyFitnessPal, Endomondo, Nike+ Run Club and Apple HealthKit
*Works with Polar H10 and OH1 heart rate sensor or any other compatible Polar heart rate sensor and fitness tracker: https://support.polar.com/en/support/compatible-devices
POLAR CLUB. The most rewarding fitness choice – for your club, for your class, for your heart.
Get Polar Club for your club today! Discover more: polar.com/club

bluejetty:00146969:ios.name: Mem – Your Personal AI Agent
bluejetty:00146969:ios.summary: Mem is your personal AI agent—a chief of staff that builds a living picture of your tasks, projects, and goals, then helps you follow through. Capture notes, meetings, ideas, research, and links without stopping to organize. Mem Agent uses
bluejetty:00146969:ios.description:
Mem is your personal AI agent—a chief of staff that builds a living picture of your tasks, projects, and goals, then helps you follow through. Capture notes, meetings, ideas, research, and links without stopping to organize. Mem Agent uses that context to answer questions, recall details, plan, draft, summarize, and move work forward.
YOUR WORKSPACE, KEPT FOR YOU
Write it down, say it out loud, record a meeting, or save it from another app. Mem keeps everything connected, searchable, and ready when you need it.
ASK ANYTIME. SKIP THE BRIEFING.
Mem Agent knows the context you have saved, so you can ask what matters now instead of rebuilding the backstory. Recall a detail, summarize a week of meetings, connect related ideas, draft a message, or plan the next step.
PROACTIVE WORK THAT SCALES
Mem automatically detects and tracks tasks and projects from the notes you create or edit. With Mem Pro, add custom routines that prepare briefings, do research, organize notes, and send scheduled reminders. Connect tools like Gmail, Slack, and Todoist so Mem can use more of your work as context.
VOICE NOTES THAT STAY USEFUL
Record a thought, meeting, or reminder. Mem keeps the audio and transcript together and helps turn rough input into clear, structured notes.
FIND ANYTHING YOU’VE SAVED
Search by topic, person, project, or a vague memory. Mem helps retrieve information even when you do not remember the exact wording.
CAPTURE FROM ANYWHERE
Use Share to Mem to save text, links, webpages, files, and more from other apps. Capture quickly, then return to the work in front of you.
AVAILABLE ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
Use Mem on iPhone, Mac, Windows, and the web. Work offline on iPhone, then sync when you are connected again.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your notes start private. Share them only when you choose.
Every plan includes Mem Agent; usage limits vary by plan. Custom routines and connections require Mem Pro or higher. Trial eligibility and pricing are shown in the app.
Privacy Policy: https://get.mem.ai/pages/privacy
Terms of Service: https://get.mem.ai/pages/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00116553:ios.description:
Protect Your Phone from Thieves and Snoops
Dont Touch My Phone: Gotcha is your smart security companion that allows you catch anyone who touches your phone. Whether it's a thief, a nosy friend, a stranger, or even your partner — Gotcha alerts you so you're always in control.
Features
▶ Movement alarm: trigger an alarm when your phone is picked up or moved.
▶ Out of pocket/bag alarm: get alerted when your phone is removed from your pocket or bag.
▶ Charging cable unplug alarm: trigger an alarm you if someone unplugs the charging cable from your device.
▶ Headphones unplug alarm: get alerted when someone disconnects the headphones from your device.
▶ Unlock selfie: take a front-facing photo when your device is unlocked.
Use Cases
▶ At cafés or restaurants: get alerted instantly if someone tries to pick up or move your phone from the table.
▶ In transit: catch sneaky hands trying to steal your phone while you're walking, commuting, or distracted.
▶ In shared spaces: stay protected from cable tampering or theft with the charging cable unplug alarm.
Why Choose Dont Touch My Phone: Gotcha?
▶ Multiple alarm modes: movement, pocket/bag, charging cable unplug and headphones unplug.
▶ Customizable alarm settings: tune delays and personalize sound/flashlight/vibrations to your need.
▶ Simple & intuitive design: no learning curve, just tap and go.
▶ Fast & efficient: light on battery, quick to react.
Protect your phone without complexity — Dont Touch My Phone: Gotcha makes security seamless.

bluejetty:00041425:ios.description:
chilli is a creator-powered climate action app. Activists launch coordinated campaigns, their communities take action together, and supporters directly fund the work. You can join instantly or start your own campaign around an issue you care about.
Inside the app, actions are strategically designed to target corporations, regulators, and lawmakers. You can send personalized emails directly to named decision-makers, submit coordinated public comments during active regulatory consultations, and join collective waves of visible pressure that make it clear an issue will not be ignored. Social media spreads awareness but chilli turns audiences into organized movements.
Traditional petition platforms collect signatures. chilli connects creators and communities to deliver synchronized, decision-maker-facing action. When thousands act at the same time, inboxes fill, public comment portals surge and offices respond.
More than 500,000 actions have already been taken through chilli, including 8,000+ actions sent directly to bank CEOs and insurance executives pressuring them to cut financing for Arctic oil drilling, making it the most targeted anti-drilling financial pressure campaign on any platform.
Campaigns are live right now, spanning global climate fights and local community wins. From stopping new fossil fuel projects and protecting forests, to pushing for composting programs, bike lanes, clean energy investment, or climate education in your city.
chilli is free to join. You can also support activists through direct contributions inside the app, helping frontline organizers and independent campaigners sustain long-term work because movements don’t just run on engagement, they also need resources.

bluejetty:00186653:ios.description:
Do your best work.
Focus helps you concentrate with timed focus sessions built on the Pomodoro technique, track your tasks and projects, and see real progress — across all your Apple devices. A calm, proven rhythm: plan, work, break, review.
“[…] a tool that can genuinely make people more productive” – MacStories.net
“[…] a must-have for anyone who finds themselves easily getting distracted or forgetting to take occasional breaks.” – iDownloadBlog.com
I always use Focus when…
… I need to start a deep-work session
… I want to stop procrastinating and finally begin
… I want to break a big project into focused sprints
… I’m studying and need to concentrate
… I want to protect my time from distractions
… I want to build a daily focus habit
… I want to see what I actually got done today
… I want structure without a heavy, complicated system
Benefits
* Start focusing in seconds: pick a task, start a session, get to work
* The proven Pomodoro rhythm — plan → work → break → review — that gives your attention somewhere to go
* Sessions and tasks together: a focus timer plus real task, project, and time tracking (most apps split these into two)
* See your progress: daily and weekly activity and goals make focus feel earned, never nagged
* Restful breaks that are part of the rhythm, not slacking
* Calm and encouraging — momentum, never hustle, grind, or guilt
Features
* Timed focus sessions with flexible session and break lengths
* Tasks, projects, and time tracking
* Daily and weekly activity and goals
* In-app Learning: short, friendly guides you can apply as you read
* Widgets, Live Activities, and Dynamic Island
* Siri, Shortcuts, and Spotlight via App Intents
* Seamless iCloud sync
* Built-in accessibility
* Privacy first: your data stays on your devices and in your own iCloud
* Available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro
* Handcrafted by real humans :-)
Focus is free to start. Focus Pro unlocks everything with a 7-day free trial.
Thanks for doing your best work with us!
We’re always improving Focus. If you have feedback or an idea, we’d love to hear it.
About us
Focus is made by Jan & Kerstin, two independent app developers based in Germany. We built Focus for our own workdays — to concentrate, make real progress, and still keep things calm. Our goal: a productivity app that’s a joy to use every day.
We built this tool for ourselves — and now we’d love to share it with you!
Questions?
We offer friendly support. Just drop us a note at support@meaningful-things.com and we’ll get back to you as quickly as we can.
Privacy & Terms

https://meaningful-things.com/terms

With the Garden Communities app, everything in your community is at your fingertips. You can pay rent, communicate with staff, reserve amenities, manage service requests, package management (at select communities), and more – anytime, anywhere.

Find all your community’s important information and receive messages and alerts from management on events and specials via text, voice, or email.

With all its convenient features, the Garden Communities app can make living in your rental residence more seamless and enjoyable.

KEY FEATURES
• Pay rent right from the app with your credit card, debit card, or e-check and set up scheduled payments to avoid late fees.
• Submit maintenance requests with photos and videos and automatically receive status updates.
• Sign up for events, and reserve amenities (where applicable).
• Receive package delivery notifications in-app, through email or via text (where applicable)

bluejetty:00060991:ios.name: Central Bank - Mobile
bluejetty:00060991:ios.summary:
Easily manage your accounts on the go with Mobile Banking*. Track spending, pay bills, deposit checks, transfer funds, send money, and find nearby ATMs or branches.
Early Direct Deposit
 - Access your direct deposit funds sooner with Ear
bluejetty:00060991:ios.description:
Easily manage your accounts on the go with Mobile Banking*. Track spending, pay bills, deposit checks, transfer funds, send money, and find nearby ATMs or branches.
Early Direct Deposit
 - Access your direct deposit funds sooner with Early Direct Deposit for eligible checking accounts**.
Save
 - Turn on Round-Up to automatically save by rounding up your debit card purchases, with daily transfers of the difference to your savings account.
 - Use Money Manager, a free tool available within Mobile Banking that provides personalized insights to help you save, budget, and track expenses.
Send
 - Send and receive money with Zelle®, a fast and easy way to pay friends, family, and people you trust.
 - Transfer money to and from your accounts at other banks.
 - Pay bills by scheduling payments, setting up recurring payments, and managing payees.
Manage
 - View account activity, statements, and tax documents; transfer money, make loan payments, and more.
 - Deposit checks by taking a photo with your smartphone using Mobile Check Deposit.
 - Request a replacement card, verify your details, and place your order—all within Mobile Banking.
Customize Your Experience
 - Add nicknames and customize the order of your accounts.
 - Add a profile picture to help confirm you’re signing into the correct account.
 - Use Quick Balance by swiping down on the Central Bank logo on the app login screen to view account balances and recent activity.
 - Use your smartwatch to check balances, view recent transactions, and lock your card.
Security
 - Enable biometrics to log in using fingerprint authentication or face unlock (Pixel devices).
 - Use multi-factor authentication for an added layer of security when logging in from new or unknown devices.
 - Receive push, text, or email alerts for balances, transactions, cards, and payments.
For an optimal experience, our app works best on devices with IOS 14 and up. If you are using an older version, you may not receive all new features. If you are having issues, navigate to our mobile-friendly website through your device browser.
Member FDIC. *Mobile Banking is free, but data and text rates from your mobile carrier may apply. Terms and conditions apply. Zelle® is intended for sending money to family, friends, and people you know. We recommend that you do not use Zelle® to send money to anyone you do not know. Zelle® and the Zelle® related marks are wholly owned by Early Warning Services, LLC, and are used herein under license.
**Early availability is not guaranteed and may vary between deposits and may depend on instructions sent by the payer or any limitations we set. Not all direct deposits qualify. Available for eligible accounts: MaxMoney, MyChoice, World, World Elite, and Preferred Interest. Enrollment is required. See our Early Direct Deposit Agreement for more details.

bluejetty:00119965:ios.description:
Pass your CDL written exam with confidence. CDL Test gives you 800 practice questions across all 8 topic areas, plus the field calculators, reference cards, and compliance tools working drivers actually use on the road.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• 800 multi-choice practice questions
• 8 endorsement and core topic areas
• Mock tests that mirror the real DMV exam
• Flash cards for fast topic review
• Detailed score breakdowns you can email yourself
• Random question and answer order to prevent memorization
• Latest test scores saved automatically
• Voice-over for hands-free study
• iCloud sync across iPhone and iPad
TOPICS COVERED
• General Knowledge — rules of the road, safe driving
• Air Brakes
• Combination Vehicles
• Doubles and Triples
• Hazardous Materials (H endorsement)
• Passenger Vehicles (P endorsement)
• Tank Vehicles (N endorsement)
• Pre-trip Inspection
QUICK REFERENCE
Look up the answer in seconds:
• Hours of Service — 11/14/60/70 hour rules, sleeper berth splits
• Weights and Limits — federal GVW, axle, and bridge formula
• Braking and Coupling — fifth wheel, low air warning, slack adjuster
• Emergency and Safety — warning triangle placement, hazard signals
• Endorsements — H, N, P, S, T, X requirements
FIELD TOOLS
Built-in calculators for owner-operators and company drivers:
• Pre-Trip Checklist — full FMCSA 11-point inspection with PDF export
• HOS Quick Check — see hours remaining at a glance
• Per Diem — daily meal deduction tracker
• Load Profitability — rate per mile after costs
• Cost Per Mile — owner-operator break-even
• IFTA Quarterly — per-state fuel tax owed
MY CDL DASHBOARD
Stay road-ready and audit-ready:
• Compliance status — see what needs your attention today
• Study streak — track current streak, best streak, and daily questions
• Document wallet — store CDL, medical card, insurance, and registration photos
• Renewal reminders — never miss a license, medical, or registration deadline
EVERY STATE
Aligned with the FMCSA standards used by all 50 state DMVs and the District of Columbia.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
The free version includes core practice and limited Field Tools entries. Upgrade to unlock all 800 questions, every endorsement, full mock tests, the complete Quick Reference, and unlimited Field Tools.

The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service.
* Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.

bluejetty:00177074:ios.name: Affinity Photo 2 for iPad
bluejetty:00177074:ios.summary: The next generation of the iPad App of the Year, Affinity Photo 2 for iPad is a genuine desktop-grade, professional photo editor used by photographers, graphic designers, illustrators, artists, and other creators around the world. Wielding
bluejetty:00177074:ios.description:
The next generation of the iPad App of the Year, Affinity Photo 2 for iPad is a genuine desktop-grade, professional photo editor used by photographers, graphic designers, illustrators, artists, and other creators around the world. Wielding tons of incredible new features, hundreds of enhancements and a completely redesigned UI, the award-winning photo editing app has everything you need to edit images, retouch photos, create multi-layered art, beautiful raster paintings, designs, and so much more – no matter where you are.
OPTIMIZED FOR IPAD
• Fully integrated and optimized iPad gesture controls to speed up your workflow
• iOS16 ready, including optimization for virtual memory swap, dramatically increasing performance on large documents
• Sensitive to pressure, tilt, and angle, the app harnesses the full power and precision of Apple Pencil
• Command controller hosting on-screen modifiers
• Quick Menu for context-sensitive access to commands
• Full iCloud drive integration for seamless file management, storage, and sharing
• External display support with separate configuration options
POWERFUL TOOLS & FUNCTIONALITY
• Non-destructive RAW development of linked/embedded RAW images
• Non-destructive Live Mesh Warp filter and other live effect layers
• Luminosity, hue range, and band pass live masks
• Compound masks
• Multiple shadow, outline, and overlay layer effects per object
• Normals adjustment for editing normal maps from material and texturing workflows
• JPEG XL file import and export
• OCIO v2 support – particularly useful for video editors, VFX, film, and 3D artists
PERFORMANCE & POWER
• Massive image support (100+ Megapixels)
• Pan and zoom at maximum refresh rate
• Open, edit, and save Adobe Photoshop ® PSD/PSB files
• RGB, CMYK, Greyscale and LAB color spaces
• Full 16-bit and linear unbounded 32-bit per channel editing
• Work with all standard formats like PNG, TIFF, JPG, JPEG XL, GIF, SVG, EPS, EXR, HDR, and PDF
UNSURPASSED PRODUCTIVITY
• Full support for unlimited layers, layer groups, adjustment layers, filter layers, and masks
• Edit live filters, adjustments, effects, blend modes, and masks non-destructively
• Remove objects or erase backgrounds with magic eraser tool, blur photos, add filters for pictures, cut, crop, and more with ease
• Savable history with alternate futures
• Customizable shortcuts with attached keyboard or new quick menu
• Isolate, edit, and duplicate spare channels with a simple touch
• Link layers to edit simultaneously
• Stitch picture-perfect panoramas on location
PROFESSIONAL IMAGE PROCESSING
• Open RAW in a dedicated 16-bit development workspace and edit straight from your camera
• Adjust exposure, blackpoint, clarity, vibrance, white balance, shadows, highlights, etc.
• Advanced lens corrections including chromatic aberration, defringe, vignette, and noise reduction
• Paint areas or use fully customizable gradients to mask adjustments
• View histograms, blown highlights, shadows, and tones as well as detailed EXIF information
• Focus Merge, HDR Merge, and Tone Mapping for advanced image processing
QUALITY RETOUCHING & CORRECTION TOOLS
• Intuitive selection brush and refinement for precise selections like strands of hair
• Dodge, burn, clone, patch, blemish, red eye, advanced inpainting, and object removal
• Smooth and retouch skin with built-in frequency separation
• Dedicated Liquify persona gives freehand control over warps, twirls, pinch, punch, and turbulence
ADVANCED BRUSH ENGINE
• Huge library of painting, drawing, textures, and professional DAUB® Brushes included
• Create custom brushes and nozzles with full control over advanced dynamics
FAST, CUSTOMIZABLE EFFECTS
• Massive collection of effects available, including blurs, distortions, tilt-shift, shadows, glows, lighting, and many more
• Swipe-able split or mirrored screen always available for before and after views
• Path text capabilities

bluejetty:00163927:ios.name: High Blood Pressure Tracker
bluejetty:00163927:ios.summary:
Cardilog is a blood pressure tracker that helps adults with high blood pressure keep an accurate home log, understand what affects their readings, stay on top of their medication and keep a clear record of it all.
It is built for people li
bluejetty:00163927:ios.description:
Cardilog is a blood pressure tracker that helps adults with high blood pressure keep an accurate home log, understand what affects their readings, stay on top of their medication and keep a clear record of it all.
It is built for people living with high blood pressure (hypertension), people taking blood pressure medication, and anyone who wants to keep track of their blood pressure at home.
KEEP A HOME BLOOD PRESSURE LOG
- Type in systolic, diastolic and pulse, or sync readings from any cuff that saves to Apple Health, so every reading is in one place.
- Import your history from a CSV file, a PDF report or photos of a paper log, so your trends start from day one.
- Tag readings, for example after exercise or when you feel stressed, to see which moments push your numbers up.
ESTIMATE WITH A CAMERA SCAN (FACE SCAN)
- Between cuff readings, Face Scan (Cardilog Pro) estimates your pulse and blood pressure from a short scan of your face with the front camera. Each result is saved as a scan estimate and marked as one. Your cuff is still the measurement.
UNDERSTAND WHAT AFFECTS YOUR READINGS
- Compare morning with evening, weekdays with weekends, and your overnight dip to learn when your blood pressure runs highest.
- Ask Cardilog Intelligence, the built-in AI assistant, about your own readings. It looks at them alongside your sleep, steps and heart rate variability (HRV) from Apple Health, and you can send it a photo of a meal or a lab result.
- Check a daily stress score built from HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, activity and blood pressure, with tips for the days it runs high.
- Set targets for systolic, diastolic and heart rate, and follow a personalized daily plan toward them.
STAY ON TOP OF YOUR MEDICATION
- Add each medication with its dose and the times you take it, and get a reminder at each of those times so doses aren’t missed.
- Tick off doses as you take them and add a note about the day, so your readings sit next to what you actually took.
KEEP A CLEAR RECORD YOU CAN SHARE
- Create a PDF Blood Pressure Report for the dates you choose, with morning and evening averages, systolic and diastolic distribution, the full reading log, doses taken and your daily notes, all in one file you can keep or share.
- Export your blood pressure readings as a CSV file at any time.
COMMON QUESTIONS
Does Cardilog measure blood pressure?
A blood pressure cuff is the measurement. Cardilog records and charts cuff readings you type in or sync through Apple Health. Face Scan adds a camera estimate between cuff readings; it is marked as an estimate, not a measurement.
Which blood pressure monitors work with Cardilog?
Any monitor whose app saves readings to Apple Health, including models from Omron, Withings, iHealth, Qardio and A&D. Readings from any other cuff can be typed in.
Can I share my readings with someone else?
Yes. Send the PDF report by email or any app on your phone, or export your readings as a CSV file.
Can Cardilog remind me to take my blood pressure medication?
Yes. Set the times for each medication and Cardilog reminds you, then keeps a record of every dose taken.
Cardilog is a personal tracking app. It is not a medical device and is not a substitute for medical diagnosis or treatment. Always follow your clinician’s advice.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: https://cardilog.app/privacy-policy/
