bluejetty:00027668:ios.name: Outlaw Cowboy
bluejetty:00027668:ios.summary: Welcome to Outlaw Cowboy, a thrilling simulation and strategy game that immerses you in the treacherous world of the American West. Set during the pioneering days of the Wild West, where the feverish gold rush attracted hordes of settlers,
bluejetty:00027668:ios.description:
Welcome to Outlaw Cowboy, a thrilling simulation and strategy game that immerses you in the treacherous world of the American West. Set during the pioneering days of the Wild West, where the feverish gold rush attracted hordes of settlers, you will assume the role of a fearless bounty hunter. Your mission: conquer all that this lawless land has to offer.
With your sights set on fertile lands, you must stake claim to them by any means necessary. Form powerful gangs that instill fear in the hearts of outlaws, fight valiantly against those who stand in your way, recruit a formidable army, and transform a humble town into a thriving settlement, echoing the spirit of the West.
Key Features:
Capture Fugitives to Claim Bounties: Become the ultimate bounty hunter by tracking down and capturing fugitives. From notorious outlaws and cunning mafia members to shrewd capitalists and relentless enforcers, each fugitive presents an opportunity for lucrative rewards and reputation growth.
Recreate Classic Western Elements: Experience the nostalgia of the Wild West as you embark on a quest to reclaim your town's land. Take up arms, claim bounties, and rebuild your settlement from the ground up, creating a vibrant and prosperous community amidst the vast wilderness.
Liberty City Building: Exercise your creativity with open-ended construction options as you shape your town according to your preferences. Will you opt for luxurious grandeur or streamlined efficiency? Marvel at the changing seasons and adapt to the challenges presented by day and night cycles. Interact with a diverse range of dynamic non-player characters, bringing life and authenticity to your bustling town.
The Lawless West: Indulge in the thrilling activities that define the lawless West. Test your luck at high-stakes Black Jack tables, try your hand at exciting slots, and engage in gripping western showdowns. With a vast array of equipment, horses, and loyal companions to recruit, you can forge your own destiny as an outlaw or a wise detective, braving the treacherous journey across the border.
Alliances & Social Interaction: Forge alliances with like-minded individuals and harness the power of collaboration. Utilize embedded translation functions and alliance chat features to communicate effectively with your allies. Take charge and establish your own extrajudicial gang, paving the way for a new order in the Wild West. Unite against powerful enemies, conquer alliance strongholds, and solidify your dominance over the untamed frontier.
Outlaw Cowboy offers an unparalleled gaming experience that captures the essence of the American West. Prepare yourself for an immersive adventure where you can establish your reign, build alliances, and shape the destiny of this lawless land. Are you ready to ride into the sunset and carve your name into the annals of history?

bluejetty:00119666:ios.description:
Textastic is a comprehensive and versatile text and code editor for iPad and iPhone. It supports syntax highlighting for more than 80 programming and markup languages. Connect to SFTP, FTP, and WebDAV servers or to your Dropbox account. Use the built-in SSH terminal to work directly on your server.
Features:
- Syntax highlighting for more than 80 languages, including HTML, JavaScript, CSS, C++, Swift, Objective-C, Rust, XML, Markdown, PHP, Perl, Python, Ruby, Lua, YAML, JSON, SQL, shell scripts, and many more (full list available on the website)
- Compatible with Sublime Text 3 and TextMate 1 syntax definitions and themes
- Code completion for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, C, Objective-C, and PHP
- SFTP (SSH), FTP, FTPS (FTP over SSL), WebDAV, and Dropbox clients
- SSH terminal connections
- Code formatter for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON
- Git repositories from the Git client app Working Copy can be opened as external folders in Textastic
- Emmet support
- JavaScript console
- iCloud Drive file synchronization
- WebDAV server for easy file transfer between Textastic and your Mac or PC over Wi-Fi
- Symbol list for quick navigation within a file
- Full support for external keyboards, trackpads, and mice
- Configurable keyboard shortcuts
- Additional keys above the virtual keyboard for frequently used programming characters
- Cursor navigation wheel for easy text selection
- Move the cursor using swipe gestures
- Split View and Slide Over multitasking on iPad
- Open multiple files in tabs
- Multiple windows on iPadOS
- Dark Mode support
- Support for common text encodings such as UTF-8, UTF-16, and ISO-8859-1
- Support for different tab widths and soft tabs (spaces instead of tabs)
- Custom fonts
- Find and Replace, including regular expression search
- Find in multiple files
- File information such as character and word counts
- Local and remote web preview for HTML and Markdown files
Pricing:
Textastic requires a monthly or yearly subscription or a one-time purchase. Each subscription includes a 7-day free trial with full access to all features.
Privacy Policy: https://www.textasticapp.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00036683:ios.summary:
Help Clara and the Nutcracker save Christmas from the wicked witch.

Will you manage to solve the mystery of Christmas Stories 13: Clara and the Guiding Star?
bluejetty:00036683:ios.description:
Help Clara and the Nutcracker save Christmas from the wicked witch.
Play the hidden object game, solve mysteries and enjoy the spirit of Christmas! 
Will you manage to solve the mystery of Christmas Stories 13: Clara and the Guiding Star? 
Test yourself in solving engaging puzzles, explore unusual locations and learn all secrets of The Nutcracker Kingdom. 
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden objects game.
You can get the full version by means of an in-app purchase.
Prince Arthur turns into the Nutcracker and gets into our world because of the villain Mousrinks. Clara finds a damaged Nutcracker toy and fixes it, after which it comes to life. 
Together with the Nutcracker, they learn about a magic amulet that Mouserinks wants to get in order to plunge the worlds into darkness.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO PRINCE ARTHUR AND HIS KINGDOM
Travel through the Nutcracker’s Kingdom and Clara's world, solve puzzles and explore hidden object scenes to find out what happened to Prince Arthur and why Christmas may never come. The exciting fairy tale story will appeal to all lovers of hidden object games.
HELP CLARA AND THE NUTCRACKER SAVE CHRISTMAS
Dive into the past of the Nutcracker Kingdom and find out how to save Christmas and defeat the evil Muzzerinx! Solve mysteries and find missing items, artifacts and hidden objects! 
Enjoy exciting locations and complete mini-games in this Christmas puzzle adventure!
SAVE CATSTOWN FROM A NEW THREAT
Play as young inventor Clara Stahlbaum. Immerse yourself in a magical Christmas adventure that takes you to the town of cats. Many discoveries and a fateful decision await you!
Christmas Stories 13: Clara and the Guiding Star is a mystery adventure with clues where you, as a detective, need to search and find all the hidden objects and solve mysteries. 
Go on a Christmas adventure through the Nutcracker’s Kingdom, Clara's world and Catstown! Explore unusual locations and find out what trials await Clara and if she can save Christmas!
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!
Zoom in on the scenes to help find all hidden objects, and use clues if you get stuck.

bluejetty:00132308:ios.description:
Oto is an app for people living with tinnitus, the ringing or buzzing you hear in your ears. You get it through a participating audiology clinic, and your audiologist stays involved while you use it.
At the center of the app is a library of calming sounds you can listen to any time, day or night. Around the sounds sit short guided sessions and lessons about tinnitus.
What's in the app
 • Calming sounds: white, pink and brown noise, nature and environmental sounds, and layered soundscapes you can mix yourself
 • Volume control and an optional sleep timer, so you can leave sounds running overnight
 • Short guided sessions of about 5 to 10 minutes, drawing on cognitive behavioral techniques. They sit alongside the sounds, as part of the plan your clinic sets up
 • Short lessons about tinnitus, so you understand what is going on and why
 • Optional reminders, private notes, and simple progress tracking you and your audiologist can look at together
How you use it
 1. Your audiologist sets up your account and shows you where to start
 2. Listen to the sounds when you want them, and work through the sessions at the pace you agree together
 3. Your audiologist reviews how you are getting on and adjusts your plan
How do I get Oto?
Oto comes as part of a tinnitus care plan from a participating audiology clinic. There is no separate app subscription to buy.
If your audiologist or ENT has not mentioned Oto, ask them about it. You can also find a participating clinic here:
https://joinoto.com/providers
What does it cost?
Your clinic sets the price of the care plan, and the Oto app is included. Your clinic also sets how long you keep access: most give around 12 months, and some give lifetime access. Full detail here:
https://joinoto.com/pricing
Important information
Oto provides self-guided wellbeing content. It is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, cure, mitigate, treat, or prevent tinnitus or any disease or condition. Oto does not replace professional care. In an emergency, call 911 (or your local emergency number).
Privacy
We use appropriate technical and organizational safeguards and do not sell personal data. See our Privacy Policy at https://joinoto.com/privacy and our Terms of Use at https://joinoto.com/terms.

bluejetty:00098568:ios.description:
Welcome to Candyville - a world filled with sweetness, fantasy and surprises! 
Open "Candyville: Avatar City" and explore and enjoy this fun and cute world with your friends. Unlock different locations one by one, dress up each unique character, and interact with various items and furniture! Step into this wonderful world and write your own unique legendary story!
[Joyful Town Tour]
Come on! This is a bustling and charming town! Here is a fun amusement park where you can catch dolls and ride roller coasters to your heart's content; there is a cozy bakery where you can make cakes by yourself or just sit down and have a cup of coffee; there is an interesting arcade where you can have an exciting racing game or dance freely on the dance machine!
Not only that, but there are also supermarkets, hospitals, clothing stores, etc. What fun things are there in these scenes? Wait for you to explore!
In Candy Dream Town, you can do whatever you want and enjoy the rich and interesting adventure journey!
[Making Your Character Special Just for You]
 We have wonderful ways to make your character special. You can create any favorite character you like! Carefully select from hundreds of faces, costumes, hairstyles, shoes, bags, and jewelry to create a unique character that belongs to you! They can be elegant and magnificent, cute and mischievous, handsome and dashing, or quirky. It's all up to you! Hurry up to dress up and makeover!
 Of course, the characters you create can also participate in all activities in Candy Dream Town! They can interact with all items like everyone else in the town and go wherever they want!
[Endless Exploration Journey]
You can create your own interactive story, arrange where the characters go and what they do according to your script, etc. - a series of wonderful stories are waiting for you to write!
You can play with all the items, explore all the hidden plots and surprise Easter eggs. How did the strawberry seeds come from? How to make your favorite dress by yourself? Hurry to find out in the game!
Items that can be held in your hand can be taken to other scenes! Go shopping, plant, pack delicious pastries, and buy fresh ingredients at the supermarket!
Gold coins are scattered everywhere in the scene! Collect them to exchange for beautiful dresses!
What else is unique? You need to enter Candy Dream Town to discover it yourself!
"Candyville: Avatar City" is a charming game carefully designed for boys and girls. Different from traditional dress up games or doll games, players can acquire key life skills such as creation, exploration, imagination, and design in this colorful virtual world and cultivate their creativity and problem-solving ability.
Download "Candyville: Avatar City" now, unlock your imagination, create your own story, and the adventure never stops!

bluejetty:00079859:ios.description:
BRAZIL LOTTERIES
Results of lottery games managed by Caixa Econômica Federal (Brazil).
This app allows you to check the results of all official Brazilian lotteries: Mega-Sena, Quina, Lotofácil, Dupla Sena, Lotomania, Dia de Sorte, Loteca, Timemania, Lotogol, and Loteria Federal.
In addition to results, you will find information on how to play, betting price tables, draw schedules, and all rules and details for each game.
Results are published shortly after each draw, and you can check data from any date — meaning all past results are available from the beginning of each lottery.
You can also select your preferred lottery retailer (“Lotérica”), personalizing your experience. Soon, your selected retailer will be able to communicate with you, sharing promotions and group betting (“bolões”) opportunities so you don’t miss any chance to play.
Note: This app is independently developed and has no official affiliation with Caixa Econômica Federal.
All lottery results and product information are obtained from the official Caixa Econômica Federal website and reproduced in the app.
Important: This app does not allow placing bets. It is intended for checking results only.
Coming soon: New features and services will be added.
For bugs, suggestions, or feedback, please contact: admin@lftek.com.br

bluejetty:00146920:ios.description:
Enter highland dancing events - anywhere, any time.
The HD Comps app makes entering yourself or your dancers simple and hassle free. Conveniently pay your entry fees via debit or credit card and the organizer will receive instant email notification of your entry and payment.
Download now and you'll have your entry completed in just a few minutes!
Features
* Enter multiple dancers
* Find and enter local and international competitions 
* Quick access to competition information and rules
* Securely pay entry fees using both debit and credit cards (VISA, MasterCard or American Express)
* Stores you and your dancer's key details for future competition entries
* View the details of all your previous entries
*** Testimonials from Competition Organizers ***
“We all have such busy lives that we want things to be as hassle free and as time efficient as possible. This system delivers this and more.
As a dancing mom: No more printing entry forms, no more continually rewriting all my details, no more stamps to buy and then remembering to actually post it off in time.
As a competition/championship organiser: Our secretary and treasurer actually have nothing to do while entries are coming in!
It couldn’t be easier and more user friendly. I highly recommend you give it a go.” - Catherine Bourke, Hobart Highland Dancers Competition Association, (HHDCA)
“We first used the Highland Dancing Online Entry System for our August 2016 competition as a trial for the SA State Committee. The feedback was overwhelmingly positive from the dancers and their families about the ease and convenience of the website and app for entering the competition.
From an organizer’s point of view, the system saved so much administration time, smoothly handled all payments and provided a detailed payment summary. All of which meant that time which was usually put into competition organization book work could be instead focused directly on the actual event for the dancer’s enjoyment.
It is an excellent system and I highly recommend it be used for any highland dancing competition." - Lisa Barker, South Australia State Committee of Highland Dancing Inc (SASCHDI)
“We used this system for the first time at our August 2016 Competition in a trial capacity but were very impressed with how easy it is to enter and also the information displayed in the Administration area that we decided to use it for all our competitions. The Administrators were extremely helpful in the set up process and we would have no hesitation in recommending this system to any Competition Organization.” - Gaye Anderson, Secretary, Tasmanian National Dancing Association (TNDA)
*** Testimonials from Parents ***
“I liked the app a lot. Much easier than printing off an entry form, writing it out by hand, addressing an envelope, making a direct deposit and then finding a stamp and letter box.” - Jan Gartlan
“Used the new app for my daughter’s entry to the March comp. It’s brilliant! So efficient - it would be so great if all comps were this easy to enter!” - Julia Jago
“The app is brilliant! As a working mum of two girl’s who are very passionate about their dancing, this app saves me heaps of time. It is completed in a matter of minutes and immediately a confirmation email is received, so no more stamps and envelopes!
Customer service is very fast and friendly - when an error was made on my part, within 24 hours it was resolved and the funds were back in my account. Here’s hoping it can be used for all competitions!” - Susie Sefton

bluejetty:00153653:ios.description:
Flock up and get ready for a thrilling new adventure with Red, Chuck, Bomb, and the rest of the gang in a strategic, skill-based game that promises hours of fun! Angry Birds Bounce combines the classic charm of Angry Birds with an innovative arcade brick-breaker twist.
When the pigs kick the birds from their islands, Red and his pals must fight to get ’em back. Players will collect their favorite Angry Birds, combine them into powerful flocks, and launch them bouncing to defeat an army of piggies, adding a fresh spin to the beloved gameplay. The game’s rogue-lite elements ensure each level is a new challenge, offering an exciting new power-up after each level! Combine your birds carefully as strategic planning and skillful execution results in astonishing and powerful combos!
CLASSIC CHARACTERS. NEW CHALLENGES.
Red, Chuck, Bomb, and the rest of the iconic flock are ready for action in a game that blends familiar faces with innovative gameplay mechanics.
STRATEGIC COMBINATIONS

ENGAGING GAMEPLAY
Enjoy satisfying, skill-based gameplay that challenges you to perfect your strategy and execution. Bounce, break, and complete each level with the highest score!
ROGUE-LITE ELEMENTS
After each level you can pick a new power up ensuring that no two games are the same! Build your flock powers differently each time and enjoy infinite replayability of the classic Angry Birds fun.
BEST VISUALS TO DATE
Angry Birds has never looked so charming and exciting! Ultimate versions of character animations and visuals will make you fall in love with the flock all over again!
Get ready to bounce, break, and flock up with your favorite birds in Angry Birds Bounce, exclusively on Apple Arcade!

bluejetty:00180047:ios.name: Psychoanalysis (psychology)
bluejetty:00180047:ios.summary: The Free Association method is a psychoanalytic procedure for exploring the unconscious, during which an individual freely speaks about anything that comes to mind. This method is actively used in psychoanalysis, psychology, sociology, psyc
bluejetty:00180047:ios.description:
The Free Association method is a psychoanalytic procedure for exploring the unconscious, during which an individual freely speaks about anything that comes to mind. This method is actively used in psychoanalysis, psychology, sociology, psychiatry, social work, and psycholinguistics.
Sigmund Freud and his followers believed that uncontrolled associations are projections of internal, often unconscious, content of the mind. This allows for the identification and description of affective complexes, making the associative experiment an important tool in psychoanalysis.
Sir Francis Galton was the first to conduct an associative experiment in 1879. He selected 75 words, wrote each of them on a separate card, then looked at each card and recorded the thoughts that arose. However, he chose not to publish the results, explaining that "they reveal the essence of human thought with such startling clarity that it is unlikely that it could be preserved if published."
Carl Jung used the Free Association method as a tool for detecting deception, as it helped uncover the motivations behind a person’s actions. This technique helps an individual become aware of what troubles them and begin working on resolving their psychological issues.
Now, this universal method of exploring the unconscious is available on your mobile device! The method can be used for self-psychoanalysis as well as for analyzing others. In our app, this method is enhanced with modern AI analysis, which helps to understand associations and behavioral patterns more deeply.
What the app provides:
- Awareness of influences on perception. Even if you don’t work on the word immediately, after 3-6 months, repeating the test will yield a completely different result as the associations and thoughts begin to be analyzed on an unconscious level.
- Transformational effect. With conscious perception, the individual changes their attitude. The more associations you attach to the key word, the more the chain of memories and emotions associated with it will change. The emotions that arise during associations affect the emotional coloring of future associations.
- A roadmap for further self-work. By understanding what needs to change in your perception, you can use strengths as a resource and work on areas that need improvement.
The AI analysis of your results will help you understand your associations more deeply, uncover hidden emotional responses, and receive personalized recommendations. The artificial intelligence will analyze your answers, speeding up the process of self-development and increasing your self-awareness.
We recommend combining the Free Association method with meditation to achieve maximum results.
*****
The app can be used for free in trial mode.
Upon purchase confirmation, payment will be charged to your iTunes account. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The subscription will be renewed automatically within 24 hours before the end of the current period for the same duration as the previous one. Subscription management and auto-renewal can be turned off in the Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: http://tiny.cc/Psychoanalysis_PP
Terms: https://goo.gl/91kR5f

bluejetty:00043186:ios.description:
THE MOST SUCCESSFUL SHARED MOBILITY OPERATIONS ARE BUILT ON SKURTT TECHNOLOGY.
At Skurtt, we’re not just providing an e-scooter shared system – we’re looking to change our cities and our world for the better by bringing people together with a safe, convenient, affordable, and easily accessible transportation solution.
Founded on a simple idea that green technology and electric-powered vehicles using small, compact, and convenient e-scooters are the way of the future as our cities will be more conducive to greater populations, increased mobility, and globalization.
HOW IT WORKS
• Download the app
• Quick sign-up 
• Review safety instructions
• View nearby e-scooters
• Scan the QR code
• Lock up safely when finished
SAFETY
The safety of our riders and the wider community is our priority.
Follow these simple safety instructions when you ride.
• Always wear a helmet
• Obey all local traffic rules
• Do a pre-ride safety check
• Be careful of road obstructions
• Don’t block sidewalks, parking bays or entrances
• Park properly near bike racks and designated
COMMUNITY PARTNERS
Skurtt works with cities, business owners and universities across the globe to provide an eco-friendly e-scooter shared system. We intend to completely transform the ways in which the people make it from point A to point B by bringing an innovative mobility model and paving the way towards a cleaner, brighter, and greener future for cities and its inhabitants.

Make money with Skurtt! Set your own hours and get paid for task you complete.
• YOUR OWN SCHEDULE
There are no set hours; pick up and charge Skurtts at your convenience.
• GET PAID EASILY

• JOIN THE COMMUNITY
Be part of the micro mobility revolution by joining our ever-growing network.
Download the app and join the skurtt charger community.

• How to ride instruction

• Ride plans options

bluejetty:00083785:ios.description:
Unleash the Power of Your Coin Collection with Coin Wise: Value Identifier
Do you have a curious coin collection gathering dust, or a mysterious coin you just found? Unlock the secrets of your numismatic treasures with Coin Wise: Value Identifier, the ultimate app for coin enthusiasts of all levels!
Effortless Identification with a Snap:
Gone are the days of scouring dusty reference books. Coin Wise utilizes cutting-edge image recognition technology. Simply take a clear picture of your coin, or upload one from your gallery, and our intelligent system will instantly search its vast database. In seconds, you'll have a detailed identification, including:
Coin Type: Discover the exact name and Limit of your coin.
Year of Issue: Uncover the historical significance of your find.
Country of Mintage: Explore the rich tapestry of global coinage.
Beyond Identification: Dive Deeper into the World of Coins
Coin Wise isn't just about identifying coins – it's about enriching your collecting experience. With our app, you can:
Explore Estimated Value: Gain valuable insights into your coin's potential worth, based on current market trends and condition.
Build Your Digital Collection: Catalog your coins with ease, creating a visual record of your numismatic journey.
Identify Rare Gems: Uncover the hidden treasures within your collection – Coin Wise can help you spot potentially valuable coins.
Constantly Evolving:
Our comprehensive database is constantly expanding, ensuring you have access to the most up-to-date information.
More Than Just an App – A Community
Join a vibrant community of coin enthusiasts with Coin Wise. Share your finds, discuss collecting strategies, and learn from fellow collectors.
Download Coin Wise today and:
Scan and identify coins instantly
Explore the rich history and value of your collection
Build a comprehensive digital record of your coins
Connect with a passionate community of coin lovers
Whether you're a seasoned collector or just starting your numismatic adventure, Coin Wise: Value Identifier is your one-stop shop for exploration, identification, and building a valuable collection.
Terms and Conditions: https://static.coinwiseapp.co/terms-en
Privacy Policy: https://static.coinwiseapp.co/privacy-en
Community Guidelines: https://static.coinwiseapp.co/community-en

Take command of any European army and lead it to victory in World War 2 w
bluejetty:00022379:ios.description:
Dive into the battlefield of World War 2! Commander, give us an order! 
World War 2 has begun, and you will join the important historical battles from 1939 to 1945.
Take command of any European army and lead it to victory in World War 2 with our military games. You can lead allied forces to storm the beaches of Normandy; you can also command the Axis and defend the Atlantic Wall...Everything is possible in this WW2 turn-based war strategy game.
More than 100 famous historical World War 2 figures such as Guderian, Manstein, Rommel, Button, Zhukov, MacArthur, Montgomery, and Eisenhower, will be on the stage in turn. Take advantage of the generals, find out the enemy's weaknesses, and defeat them to win the final victory.
WW2, sandbox, strategy, tactics, and war games! Military games time!
Make your own history with your actions and tactics in WW2 turn-based war strategy games!
>>New engine production allows to experience real and rich terrain on the battlefield!
The right war strategy is the key to the ultimate victory! 3D terrain brings a richer strategy. Plan your attacks and conquer or destroy connecting bridges, bunkers, and roadblocks, to get yourself a tactical advantage! Every tactic you make will determine the outcome of the WW2.
>>Total World War 2! Real historical battles are waiting for you to reinterpret.
30+ historical WW2 campaigns (3 difficulty levels) and 270 military tasks. Experience these real historical battles from the Axis and Allies in this war strategy game.
- Campaign for Germany: battle of Dunkirk, Operation Barbarossa, Romel corps, the siege of Tobruk, the battle for Britain.
- Campaign for the Allies: Battle of Britain, Invasion of Italy, Normandy Landings, D-Day, Battle for France.
You will accept different missions: capture the target, rescue friendly forces, stand out from the siege, hold on to your position, annihilate the enemy, etc.
>>Variety of WW2 units of special functions such as air defense, airborne, and building.
German Tiger tank, Soviet Katyusha rocket, Spitfire Fighter, aircraft carriers, Battleships, flamethrowers, submarines, command paratroopers, bomber squadrons, and other special operations forces!
More units, more strategy!
More strategy games advantages:
- More free rewards
- WW2 turn-based tactics war games
- Destructible and fixable bridges
- Radar technology to detect enemy forces
- Wide range of military vehicles like trucks
- Variety of battlefields and missions
- 3D game graphics and epic sounds
- Continuous updates, more campaigns
If you're looking for more World War 2 strategy games, and have any questions or suggestions:
Please follow us:
Facebook: www.facebook.com/JoyNowSG/
Instagram: www.instagram.com/joynowsggame/

Young Pizza Makers, Let’s Cook and Bake Pizza
Kido Pizza is a fun and interactive pizza cooking game made especially for kids.
Children can mix dough, add toppings, bake pizzas, and create delicious meals in a safe, ad-free environment designed for young players.
Kido Pizza is part of Kido+, a subscription service that gives families access to a growing collection of creative and educational games for kids.
A Complete Pizza Cooking Experience
Kids take part in every step of the process:
• Kneading dough
• Adding sauces and toppings
• Baking and slicing pizzas
Simple actions and colorful visuals make the game easy and enjoyable for toddlers, preschoolers, and young kids.
Endless Creativity
Choose from a wide variety of ingredients and combinations:
• Different crusts and sauces
• Fun toppings and creative recipes
• Freedom to experiment with no rules or pressure
Every pizza is a new way to explore imagination.
Made for Young Chefs
• Intuitive controls designed for kids
• Calm, playful pacing
• Encourages creativity and independent play
Safe, Ad-Free Play
Kido Pizza contains no ads and no external distractions.
The game is fully COPPA compliant, providing a private and secure space for children to play and learn.
About Kido Games
At Kido Games, we create safe, high-quality digital experiences that help kids explore creativity through play. Our games are always designed with children’s safety and enjoyment in mind.

bluejetty:00127741:ios.description:
Solve the riddle of Olympus, the forgotten kingdom.
Explore Olympus to find the legendary god's gem.
Receive the god's blessing and overcome various trials.
Now is the time to go on an adventure to unveil the mysteries of Olympus.
Conquer Olympus and become a legendary match 3 puzzle master!
Discover the secrets of the kingdom with the Olympian goddess at your side.
Enjoy the greatest of adventures on Olympus!
[How to Play]
Collect the jewels scattered throughout the levels.
Match 3 jewels of the same color to make them disappear.
If you match 4 or more of a kind, a special item appears! You can clear loads of jewels with it.
Don't worry if you can't beat a level, there are rescue items to give you a helping hand!
Conquer tough puzzles to unlock new stages!
Play as many times as you want - without stamina limitations!
A match 3 puzzle game you can enjoy anywhere, anytime
Supports data saving and loading via the Settings menu
Use the Settings menu to turn notifications on or off!

If you don't save the game in the settings menu, you won't be able to restore your game data if you delete the app.
If the game is deleted, the data will be reset. Save your game before you delete the app.
If you change phones, your data will be reset. Save your game before changing phones.
This game includes interstitial, banner, and reward advertisements.
[Features]
You can play offline without network connection 
Numerous stages
Easy and fun puzzle game

Wingmate: Your Personalized Growth Partner!
Achieve your full potential with Wingmate, the ultimate app for personal development. Whether you’re looking to strengthen relationships, master new skills, build better habits, or improve your finances, Wingmate is here to guide you every step of the way.
Why Wingmate?
Wingmate isn’t just a tool – it’s your personal growth companion. Wingmate tailors its guidance to your specific goals and needs, offering a truly personalized experience.
What Sets Wingmate Apart?
- Personalized Advice: Share your preferences with Wingmate to receive responses tailored just for you.
- Motivational Features: Earn streaks, celebrate achievements, and stay on track with gamified growth tools.
- Comprehensive Support: From health and relationships to money and skills, Wingmate helps you thrive in all areas of life.
How Wingmate Works:
- Connect with Your Wingmate: Explore areas like Health & Wellness, Skills, Money, and Relationships.
- Take Action Daily: Build habits and achieve goals with personalized guidance and feedback.
- Track Your Progress: Celebrate wins with streaks and achievements to stay motivated.
- Personalize Your Growth: Wingmate adapts to what you share, making every interaction meaningful and relevant.
Your Growth, Simplified:
- Learn new skills with tailored support.
- Build lasting habits with guidance that fits your life.
- Manage stress, improve communication, and tackle challenges confidently.
- Your journey to a better you starts now – download Wingmate and begin today!
Subscription Terms: 
Wingmate offers a 7-day free trial for new users, after which the subscription will automatically renew at $19.99 per month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase and at the start of each renewal period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account Settings. Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited if a subscription is purchased during the trial. For more details, please refer to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
Terms and Conditions here: https://www.wingmate.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.wingmate.com/privacy-policy/
Contact Us: https://www.wingmate.com/contact-us/

bluejetty:00138468:ios.description:
Bass Booster & Sound Equalizer is an advanced audio tool that lets you precisely control your sound output. It offers features such as bass enhancement, sound equalization, volume amplification, and various customizable audio effects, designed to improve the playback quality of music and audio on your iPhone.
Core Features:
--- Volume Amplifier ---
Increase volume beyond the system default. The app’s amplifier boosts audio levels from 10% to 1000% and beyond, useful for low-volume tracks or environments with background noise.
--- Equalizer Controls ---
Fine-tune your sound using a multi-band equalizer. Adjust frequencies manually or select from a range of audio presets tailored to rock, pop, classical, or jazz.
--- Bass Booster ---
Boost low frequencies to add depth and power to your audio. Especially effective for music with heavy bass, enhancing playback through headphones, car stereos, or portable speakers.
--- Audio Effects Suite ---
Customize your audio experience with additional tools:
- 3D Sound: Create spatial audio for a more immersive experience
- Reverb: Simulate different room environments and acoustics
- Pitch and Tempo: Adjust speed and tone independently
- Sound Field Expansion: Widen stereo playback for a more open sound
--- Music File Integration ---
Import and enhance personal music files directly in the app. Save and favorite enhanced tracks for easy access later.
--- Simple Interface ---
The app features a straightforward, user-friendly interface. Real-time sliders, waveform displays, and presets ensure quick access to all features without technical complexity.
Device Compatibility
Works with wired and wireless headphones, car audio systems, Bluetooth speakers, and AirPlay devices. Ideal for enhancing music during workouts, travel, home use, or professional playback environments.
Subscription Details:
Payment is charged to your Apple ID upon confirmation
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
Renewal charges are applied within 24 hours of the end of the current period
You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your iTunes Account Settings
Pricing may vary by region and is converted to your local currency
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/soundequalizerios/privacy 
Terms & Conditions: https://zipoapps.com/soundequalizerios/terms

bluejetty:00159276:ios.description:
Wondering what's really in your food, skincare and cleaning products? EWG's Healthy Living gives you instant, science-backed safety ratings. Scan any product for free. 
Built on 30+ years of independent research from EWG scientists, our app is the only one that covers more than 200,000 rated products across cosmetics, food and household cleaners.
Why get the Healthy Living App?
- Scan & Search Instantly: Barcode-scan any product or search by name to get a simple 1–10 safety score (1 = best).
- Science-Backed Ratings: Built on EWG's independent research — not algorithms alone.
- All-in-One: Combines our most trusted resources in one app: Skin Deep® for cosmetics, our Guides to Sunscreens and Healthy Cleaning, and our Food Scores database.
- Find Safer Alternatives: Compare products and discover better-rated options for your family and pets.
- Built on Trust: Independent and nonprofit. 
EWG's Skin Deep, Food Scores and Guide to Sunscreens have set the standard for ingredient transparency for over three decades. Now it's all in your pocket.
Download now and start making safer choices for your family.
For the most accurate data, please update to the latest version.
Terms of Use: https://www.ewg.org/eula

bluejetty:00033466:ios.name: Mystical Riddles: The Ship
bluejetty:00033466:ios.summary:
DIVE INTO THE EERIE WORLD of "Mystical Riddles: Ship from Beyond," a captivating adventure in the genre of mystery hidden object games. Unravel the secrets of a haunted ship and prevent a dark fate in the quiet port town of Quietcape!
ENGA
bluejetty:00033466:ios.description:
DIVE INTO THE EERIE WORLD of "Mystical Riddles: Ship from Beyond," a captivating adventure in the genre of mystery hidden object games. Unravel the secrets of a haunted ship and prevent a dark fate in the quiet port town of Quietcape!
ENGAGE IN DETECTIVE GAMES as you uncover clues and solve the criminal case of a haunted ship and possessed lighthouse keeper. Navigate through an oily fog that blankets the waterfront, a setting perfect for fans of point and click adventure games!
The sea harbors many mysteries not meant for human eyes. At the call of the people of a seaside town, we investigate an ancient ship that does not show up on any radar, only to have the captain's ghost possess the local lighthouse keeper. To save the ignorant townsfolk from the impending doom of becoming fuel for the ship, we must find the lone surviving ancestor of the sea creatures that once dwelt on this island. Get a chance to break the curse before the evil captain finds them first!
THRILLING DETECTIVE GAME FEATURES:
SOLVE INTRICATE PUZZLES: Engage in brain teasers and puzzles that challenge your detective skills. Perfect for enthusiasts of puzzles and hidden object games!
MEET THE SUPERNATURAL: Encounter the captain's ghost and other undying souls as you solve this criminal case, making it a must-play for fans of mystery hidden object games and supernatural detective games!
INTERACTIVE GAMEPLAY: Experience point-and-click adventure games mechanics as you find hidden objects and uncover clues to solve the mystery!
EARN ACHIEVEMENTS: Play relaxing mini-games and challenging puzzles to collect a variety of achievements, appealing to fans of brain teasers and puzzles in detective games!
UNLOCK A BONUS CHAPTER: Complete the main criminal case to access a special bonus chapter where you summon an ancient creature. Ideal for lovers of hidden object games and extended play mysteries!
IMPACTFUL DECISIONS: Your choices shape the course of the investigation, a feature that resonates with players who enjoy finding object games that influence the plot!
Prepare yourself for a haunting adventure with "Mystical Riddles: Ship from Beyond," where each clue and puzzle brings you closer to unveiling the mystery and saving the townsfolk from a spectral doom!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

Backgammon Galaxy - Play and Learn Online!
Master the classic game of skill & strategy! Whether you call it Backgammon, Tavla, Narde, Tawula, ששבש (Shesh Besh), Tric Trac, or Takhteh Nard… join a passionate global community on Backgammon G
bluejetty:00037410:ios.description:
Backgammon Galaxy - Play and Learn Online!
Master the classic game of skill & strategy! Whether you call it Backgammon, Tavla, Narde, Tawula, ששבש (Shesh Besh), Tric Trac, or Takhteh Nard… join a passionate global community on Backgammon Galaxy, the ultimate place to play, learn, and conquer.
Enjoy unlimited free backgammon games, elevate your strategy with world-class AI analysis, challenge yourself with unique themed quizzes, and test your skills against powerful computer opponents. Start your journey to backgammon mastery today!
ONLINE BACKGAMMON ACTION:
* Global Matchmaking 24/7: Instantly find opponents at your skill level.
* Challenge Friends: Easily invite friends for private matches or connect with new players.
* Thrilling Real-Time Games: From fast-paced matches to thoughtful strategic duels.
* Official Tournaments (Coming Soon!): Compete for glory in Backgammon Galaxy tournaments.
* Galaxy Rating & Leaderboards: Earn your official rating and climb the ranks.
* Connect & Strategize: Chat with opponents post-game.
* Quick Play with Guest Mode (Coming Soon!): Jump straight into action, no registration needed.
ANALYZE & ELEVATE YOUR GAME:
* World-Class AI Analysis: Dissect every move with our formidable xG-based AI engine – trusted by Grandmasters!
* Your Personal Blunder Log: Automatically track & review critical errors to rapidly improve.
* Deep Performance Stats: Monitor dice rolls, performance rating, progress & detailed match insights.
* Thematic Tactical Quizzes: Sharpen your decision-making with our extensive, unique quiz database.
* Master Every Decision: Pinpoint blunders, uncover optimal plays & refine your strategic thinking.
LEARN FROM THE BEST (Expanding Soon!):
* Interactive AI Tutor (Coming Soon!): Personalized feedback & guidance to simplify complex backgammon concepts.
* Grandmaster Insights: Access strategy videos from top backgammon experts & GMs on Backgammon Galaxy.
PRACTICE AGAINST THE AI:
* Versatile Computer Opponents: Choose your challenge, from beginner to Grandmaster-level AI.
* Strategy Sandbox: Experiment with new openings & tactics, pressure-free.
THE BACKGAMMON GALAXY UNIVERSE:
* Passionate Global Community: Connect with dedicated backgammon players worldwide.
* Where Champions Play: Battle World #1 Masayuki "Mochy" Mochizuki & other elite Grandmasters.
* Official Sponsor: Backgammon World Championship (BGWC). We support the global backgammon scene.
* Community Forums (Future): Share games, discuss tactics & engage.
... AND SO MUCH MORE:
* Gorgeous Boards & Themes: Personalize your game with stunning designs.
* Competitive Coin Games: Test your skills & win virtual coins in exciting matches.
* Stay Informed: Push notifications for game invites, tournaments, friend requests & updates.
* Premium Star Memberships: Unlock exclusive features with flexible one-time payment options.
* Commitment to Fair Play: Robust systems ensure a balanced, fair competitive environment.
* Constantly Evolving: Regular updates with new features, content & improvements.
Mastering backgammon online has never been more accessible or engaging!
Backgammon Galaxy is the premier destination for all backgammon enthusiasts – from newcomers learning the ropes to seasoned pros chasing Grandmaster status. Crafted by Grandmasters, for the love of the game!
We value your feedback! Please share suggestions and comments. Our support team is here to help. 
ABOUT BACKGAMMON GALAXY:
Founded by Grandmaster Marc Olsen, Backgammon Galaxy offers the world's leading online backgammon experience. Proud official sponsor of the Backgammon World Championship.

Privacy Policy: https://www.backgammongalaxy.com/privacy-policy
Connect with us:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/BackgammonGalaxy
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/backgammongalaxy
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/BackgammonGalaxy

bluejetty:00163917:ios.description:
Meet, Jalra - Carnatic Mridangam, an app to make your device to play mridangam for Indian classical music, dance or bhajans.
This app is musician's best friend. Every student and professional will need it. The purpose of the app is to accompany the musician with the sound of Indian percussion instruments called Jalra and Mridangam. Once you spend few days with this app, figuring out how to configure and use it, the app will become the best solution for music or dance practice and performances. You can also use it for Bhajans.
The app is very simple to use. It has many advanced features like playlist and beat editor. The design is very intuitive and needs no training to use it.
If you are a student, show this app to your teacher, who should be able to tell you how to use it properly for your practice. It will help you get a hold on the rhythm of your music. If you are a teacher, teach the app to your students, for helping them to improve their rhythmic skills.
Detailed Help
A very detailed help is available at this link: https://jalra-app.web.app
Features
-> Tambura for all pitchs
-> Mridangam for all pitchs - paid feature
-> Morsing for all pitchs - paid feature
-> All Talam/Tala supported (count of 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8)
-> Carnatic Music's Saptha (7) Alankara Talams are avaialble (you can create your custom talam also)
-> Set any tempo you like for the beats
-> TAP twice to guess/judge the tempo
-> No need to keep screen on while playing, runs in the background.
-> Create Playlist - paid feature, combine more than 1 style to create a new longer loop
-> Create and Tweak Beats in the Beat Editor - paid feature
-> Option to Stop displaying Ads - paid feature
Fill Button
While the app is playing a style, hit the Fill button to play a static fill variation once. 
End Button
When playing any variation, hit the End button to wait for the app to finish the active playing the active sound and then stop. 
Show / Hide Playlist
You can show or hide the playlist with a toggle button. With the playlist hidden you will get the classic screen simple screen to configure the app.
Beat Editor – InApp Purchase
Press and Hold any one style to open its beat editor. Every beat is divided into 4 parts, with a on/off button for each part. Touch them to swith each part on or off to tweak the beat. When you try to use it for the first time, a prompt will be shown to buy the feature. Once you have bought the feature, you can design / tweak the sound on the beat editor.
Play List – InApp Purchase
You can add a style into the playlist. When you add a style into playlist, the tempo and count that is active will be used for that item.
There is option to Save playlist to save them as local file. They are internal to the Jalra app. These files will not be visible in File Explorer app. Careful, these files will get deleted when you uninstall the app!
Upload Style and Playlist to cloud (internet)
Playlist and new Styles are stored in app's internal files. These files will get lost if you uninstall or reset phone. So there is a feature available to upload them to google cloud. This can also be used to share the new Styles or Playlist you build. It can be downloaded by anybody on the internet.
Hide Ads – Paid Feature
The app shows banner ads. If you want to hide it, you can buy NoAds feature by click on "Show or Hide Ads" menu option.
Demo Videos
https://youtu.be/M_HwpViSnJg
https://youtu.be/S0UO2l8rEbY - Mora

bluejetty:00131014:ios.description:
Bring your photos to life with Artimind - AI Video Generator. Turn any photo into a warm, natural video in seconds, animate still pictures, restore old photos, and gather your favorite moments into a living album you can keep and share.
Generate AI Videos/ Animate Photos
Making your precious photo move has never been easier with Artimind. Whether it’s a decades-old family memory or a photo taken just yesterday, this AI video generator helps you breathe life into still images in seconds — from waving, smiling, showing affection, to blowing birthday candles. Every motion feels warm, natural, and full of emotion.
Restore/ Revive Old Photo
Have faded, black-and-white, or worn family photos you wish you could revive? Artimind restores every precious detail — repairing scratches, enhancing clarity, and coloring black and white pictures to bring each memory back to its original warmth. 
Living Album 
With Living Album, Artimind gently animates each of your fav photos into its own short clip, then weaves them all into one beautiful, cinematic memory film. Watch a smile widen, a hand reach out, a shared moment come softly back to life — every still image flowing into a living album you can return to whenever your heart needs it.
Tons of Heartfelt Family Video Templates
Artimind’s AI templates are designed dedicatedly for photo animation of:
Recreate warm family moments: shared meals, cooking together, learning to ride a bike
Enjoy seasonal templates for Christmas, New Year, Thanksgiving, winter themes, and more
Celebrate life events with templates for birthdays, graduations, weddings, and special occasions
Hashtag-Ready Sharing
Share heartfelt videos of you and your loved ones, complete with hashtags. Post in high-quality, optimized formats and let meaningful moments reach the people who matter most.
Why Do Users Love Artimind?
- Preserve family bonding moments you wish you had captured.
- Celebrate milestones, traditions, everyday life 
- Restore, colorize photo, animate images to video effortlessly
- Simple, intuitive design with vertical or full-screen viewing.

- Any unused portion of a free trial, if available, will be forfeited once subscribed.

bluejetty:00152188:ios.description:
Struggling to make reading time meaningful or just get your child excited about books? WunderKind turns storytime into the highlight of your child’s day by making them the star of the adventure.
This isn't just another story app. It's a personalized, confidence-building experience designed to help families reconnect, calm bedtime chaos, and grow a true love of reading. With each beautifully illustrated tale, your child’s imagination comes alive, boosting literacy, emotional growth, and self-esteem along the way. Because when your child sees themselves as the hero, they believe they can be one in real life too.
Your Child, the Star
With WunderKind’s unique personalization feature, your child can appear in every story thanks to secure AI-generated artwork based on their photo. Watch their eyes light up as they become Cinderella, Jack climbing the beanstalk, or a brave astronaut on a lost planet.
A Reading Coach for Every Stage
Practice reading with Spark, a playful star reading coach. Depending on their age, children can follow narrated words, tap for syllable breakdowns, read aloud with pronunciation support, or practice independently. Age-specific reports range from words explored and reading level to reading accuracy, speed, and words to practice.
Gentle Audio Narration
Every story can be enjoyed with warm, expressive narration that brings the adventure to life. Perfect for winding down before sleep and helping children follow along with every word.
WunderKind adapts to your child's age:
Under 3: Simple language and shorter stories, with narrated words to explore and follow along
Ages 3–5: Playful, easy-to-follow tales with guided reading, pronunciation support, and syllable breakdowns on tap
Ages 6+: Richer language and more layered narratives for independent reading, with detailed insights into accuracy, reading speed, & words to practice
What Makes WunderKind a Must-Have for Modern Families:
- Ad-free, age-appropriate, and safe
- Helps children read, practice, and progress at every stage
- Supports vocabulary and language development
- Soothing audio storytelling for screen-free bedtime 
- Word-by-word highlighting as the story is narrated
- Encourages emotional learning and imagination
- Beautiful illustrations in a variety of styles
Privacy First
We respect your family’s privacy. Photos are used only to create your child’s personalized story and are promptly deleted from our secure servers. They are never stored or used to train AI models.
Storytime Reimagined
Whether it's Little Red Riding Hood, The Jungle Book, or original tales like The Fire of Kindness and The Mood Garage, WunderKind offers timeless stories with modern meaning. Each story teaches values like kindness, honesty, courage, gratitude, and self-respect in a way kids truly connect with.
Start your storytelling adventure today with WunderKind, where every child is the hero, and every bedtime is a journey worth remembering.
Unlock WunderKind Premium:
- Personalized stories featuring your child’s name and photo
- Age-adapted reading practice with pronunciation help and progress insights
- Soothing audio narration
- Word-by-word read-along
- Revisit all your stories anytime
When you confirm your purchase, your App Store account will be charged for the subscription cost. Remember, your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew or cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription period ends.
Switching from a free trial to a paid plan? Just a heads-up that any unused trial time will be forfeited. Renewal costs will follow your chosen subscription plan. You can manage your subscription and auto-renew settings anytime in your Account Settings. And if you need any help, our Customer Support team is happy to assist!

bluejetty:00078823:ios.description:
Welcome to the Blood Pressure Level Checker! Stress is an important indicator of health, so paying attention to your blood pressure data is crucial for understanding your body's health status. This app provides you with functions such as blood pressure data and tracking. Users can easily record their health data anytime, anywhere, and also synchronize Apple's health data, making it easier for users to better manage their health status.
The application interface design is simple and easy to operate!
Function:
1. Blood pressure recording and chart tracking:
Easily record your blood pressure data, including high and low pressure.
Understand your blood pressure trends through intuitive chart tracking.
No paper or pen required, easy to operate
2. Heart rate measurement and chart tracking:
Use the built-in heart rate measurement function to detect your heart rate.
Visualize your heart rate data to help you understand your heart health.
Explore the trend of heart rate fluctuations and take timely action.
3. Blood glucose recording and chart tracking:
For patients with diabetes, it is easy to record your blood sugar level.
Visualize blood glucose data to help you manage diet and medication treatment.
Track blood sugar fluctuations and improve quality of life.
4. Personalized alarm reminder:
Don't worry about missing important health tasks anymore! Our personalized alarm reminder will be customized according to your health needs.
Set reminders such as medication administration, blood pressure measurement, heart rate measurement, and exercise to fully adapt to your lifestyle.
Reminders can be customized based on your schedule and health goals, ensuring that you maintain a healthy lifestyle at all times.
5. Exclusive Health Tracking Assistant:
The Blood Pressure Level Checker will become your health tracking assistant, providing personalized advice based on your data and needs.
Over time, the application will learn about your health habits and provide more accurate advice to help you achieve better health outcomes.
6. Export your health data:
Click the export button to export your blood pressure, heart rate, and blood glucose data as a CSV file.
Easily share your health data with doctors or family.
Customize the export time range to meet your needs.
7. More comprehensive data management:
Use the exported CSV file for further data analysis and tracking on the computer.
Ensure that your data is permanently saved and keep track of health trends at all times.
Apple Health: The APP is integrated with HealthKit to synchronize Apple Health's blood pressure and heart rate data.
Disclaimer
The information and estimates in this application are for informational purposes only and are not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Functions such as heart rate measurement rely on specific algorithms whose accuracy may be affected by factors such as the device, environment, user status, etc., so the displayed data should not be used as a basis for medical decisions. For health problems, especially those that require medical intervention, always consult a medical professional and follow your doctor's advice. The app developer is not responsible for health problems arising from the use of its information. By using this app, you understand and accept these conditions, and please treat the information therein with caution.

bluejetty:00123576:ios.summary:
Manage. Organize. Scale. Personalize. Keep all your personal recipes on all your iPads.
Scale recipes by serving size to number of dinner guests–something your ordinary cookbook can't do! 
Personalize your collection with custom recipe card
bluejetty:00123576:ios.description:
Manage. Organize. Scale. Personalize. Keep all your personal recipes on all your iPads.
Scale recipes by serving size to number of dinner guests–something your ordinary cookbook can't do! 
Personalize your collection with custom recipe card designs. 
Enter recipes 5 ways: web import, dictation, type, copy/paste, picklist, plus auto email import from other users of this app
**Voted Best Cooking App in Best App Ever awards**
5 star reviews:
-“WOW! Really, really like this! Where have you been all my life! Love the colors and want to get the decorated ones, too. Really good and worth the money!”-C.songwriter 
-”This is THE BEST recipe organizer ever!...I love the sizer part of this app.”-Rick R.
-“Great app for those who love to cook...The genius is that you can then change the serving size and the app recalculates the ingredient proportions”-Peggywilkins 
Featured by Apple: 
~ In the Spotlight, Holiday Cooking, Party Planner, & Summertime 
BestAppEver Awards: 
~ Best Cooking App, Best Parenting App
+ Organize all YOUR recipe cards, handwritten family recipes, recipe clippings, pins & web finds
+ Personalize with recipe card designs 
+ Change the serving size & recipe is resized to number of guests coming for dinner! Customize recipes for families, couples, large or small groups – UNIQUE to Recipe Manager with Serving Sizer™. 
+ Scales using SmartScaling™ – optimizes results in real world measurements and minimum steps. We never convert 1 T to 17 T – our app knows it's actually 1 cup + 1 T!
EASY, QUICK RECIPE INPUT
● Import directly from websites
● Use dictation
● Type freehand
● Easy copy/paste
● Or use our ingredient picklists and quick pick sliders for volumes, weights, & items (for "eggs" or "cans of tomato paste") No need to type manually! 
● Import directly from email sent from other Recipe Manager with Serving Sizer users
● Landscape & Portrait support 
ORGANIZE and FIND RECIPES 
● Search by Ingredient or Recipe Name or flip thru the Alphabetical Index 
● Search & tag by multiple Categories. Edit/add your own. 
PERSONALIZE 
● Personalize your collection with beautiful designer recipe card designs.
● Basic packs included, purchase more in-app. (More packs on the way!)
FOCUSED on COOKING 
● Scale recipes BY SERVING SIZE using SmartScaling™. No more kitchen math. 
● COOKING MODE. Easy-to-read, full screen for cooking. Adjust Font Sizes to read easier. Always ON screen. *No need to touch your iPad with messy hands while cooking!*
● Don't want to cook with your iPad? PRINT out recipes. 
PEACE of MIND 
Multiple backup solutions to secure your valuable data: 
● Recipes are auto-saved locally to your iPad, as entering 
● Data is BACKED UP during iCloud backup or iTunes Backup 
● Make additional EXTRA BACKUPS using iTunes File Sharing
SHARE 
● EMAIL converted recipes to friends & family, import directly into our app
● PRINT recipes
● Use iTunes File Sharing to copy recipe database to other devices, including iPhone
ADDITIONAL FEATURES: 
● Add Photos 
● International: convert between US & Metric
● Double, triple, & halve buttons, or custom scale by serving sizes 
● Include mini-instructions in ingredient names: “2 eggs, separated” or long names like four “14.5 oz cans" 
● No subscription pricing--your app and data are yours to keep!
● No logins or website accounts required 
● No internet connection required--all recipes saved locally on device
● Elegant, beautiful, & useful simulated recipe box and cards interface 
APPLICATIONS 
● Great for holiday cooking, parties, & BBQ's
● Resize meals to family size 
● Meals for one or two 
● Catering for crowds
● Convert between European-based recipes and US-based 
Designed & used daily by a developer parent who cooks—we're always looking for ways to improve & add features. 
Please contact us at support(at)creativealgorithms.com. We strive for exceptional customer service.

bluejetty:00153180:ios.description:
This app is a powerful tool for managing your social media presence, with a focus on tracking followers and unfollowers. Once logged in, you’ll see a clean, easy-to-use dashboard that displays your profile details, including your name, photo, bio, and basic stats like the number of posts, followers, and followings.
The main features allow you to track who has followed you, who has unfollowed you, and who has followed you back. You can quickly see mutual followers, fans who haven’t followed you back, and inactive users you might want to unfollow. It’s the perfect way to monitor your audience.
Wrapped is your personalized Instagram recap that reveals your top friends, most viewed stories, most liked posts, and everything that defined your year.
In addition to tracking followers, the app offers analytics on posts and stories, including likes, comments, saves, and engagement rates, which helps you understand what content is performing best. You can manage multiple accounts at once and easily switch between them. An AI assistant helps you write captions, and a built-in post scheduler lets you schedule future posts, add photos, set reminders, and choose popular hashtags with just a few taps. Notifications help you stay on track by reminding you when to post and making it easy to post directly to your favorite platform.
Stay informed. Stay organized. Take full control of your social media publishing journey.
This application contains in-app purchases auto-renewable subscriptions:
Weekly - $6.99
Monthly - $12.99
Yearly - $39.99
Lifetime - $59.99
A subscription is required to unlock all features. You can cancel anytime through your device’s subscription settings.
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_z0Y8L0CtD9-NTPitsY70MM8GzV132D-qpLEXpAlQEw/edit?usp=sharing

bluejetty:00185404:ios.name: Hidden Objects: Twilight Town
bluejetty:00185404:ios.summary: Are you brave enough to uncover the dark secret of Twilight Town and stop the villains before it's too late? Get ready to discover the truth in this stunning mix of hidden objects and city building games full of twists and turns! Along the
bluejetty:00185404:ios.description:
Are you brave enough to uncover the dark secret of Twilight Town and stop the villains before it's too late? Get ready to discover the truth in this stunning mix of hidden objects and city building games full of twists and turns! Along the way of your own detective investigation you'll be solving tons of clever puzzles and special mini-games.
The last in your line, you have been summoned to Twilight Town to become the Judge of the Others. It’s up to you to investigate the mysterious death or your predecessor. Constantine was down on something, but was removed from the board before exposing the culprit. As you look into the entanglement of clues, you soon learn there’s more to this town than meets the eye. 
Everyone seems to have double life, and you’d better trust no one playing Hidden Objects: Twilight Town. The time has come to unravel the web of intrigues, choose your side in the eternal war between vampires and werewolves and protect people from the evil. The Others need their Judge!
- Display your city building strategy skills
- Explore richly detailed hidden object scenes
- Complete 100+ magic collections
- Fight the evil with might and magic
- Run your own investigation to track down the villain
- Manage goods supply, care about the citizens and improve your reputation
- Meet a colorful cast of characters, each in two guises
- This adventure will turn your world upside down.
This unique detective quest combines the features of a city builder and finding games.That implies solving ordinary time management problems: taking care of cargoes, shipping and production in the town, keeping the citizens entertained and happy with their scale of living… and protect them from wicked sorcerers, bloodthirsty vampires and vicious werewolves. However, you won’t be able to display your strategy talents and build up your town unless you make a fortune. Explore beautifully drawn and richly colored hidden object scenes to earn some cash, find enchanted collectibles and proceed through the story!
Don’t forget that Twilight Town is the cradle of the powerful creatures, so be ready for constant scheming, natural disasters and secret affairs. A handsome guy from the pub over the corner could very well be a werewolf, an emotional actress threatens to get the world frozen because of a broken heart, and dark rumours about ancient ruins and a misty mountain in the uptown spread along. So, watch you back, and search for the clues in 25+ seek-and-find locations. Run your own crime investigations and restore law and order in your new estate.
Hidden Object: Twilight Town is a rare find for all mystic games fans as it puts a hidden object adventure in the eerie setting, featuring outwardly creatures and ancient mysteries.

bluejetty:00158398:ios.description:
DON’T LET ANXIETY SILENTLY HOLD YOU BACK
Stateshift is designed to help you overcome your anxiety for good. The app rewires anxiety with a unique root-cause approach: instead of managing symptoms, you retrain the nervous system patterns underneath them.
It’s based on science-backed practices, over 20 years experience, and 10,000+ hours research.
It works for all anxiety: health, social, relationships, work and more.
It’s also designed to work for many anxiety types:
• General Anxiety 
• Health Anxiety 
• Social Anxiety 
• Performance Anxiety 
• Relationship Anxiety 
• Work Anxiety
MOST APPROACHES GET IT BACKWARDS
Most approaches try to fight anxiety symptoms with short-term band-aids. Stateshift helps you enter into a dialogue with anxiety, and skilfully engage with it to resolve the root cause.
ALL THE TOOLS YOU NEED
Stateshift has everything you need to overcome your anxieties.
• Custom Anxiety Journey 
• Daily Anxiety Lessons 
• Unlimited Anxiety Reflections 
• Recommendations to Overcome Anxiety 
• Bite-Sized Learnings on Anxiety 
• And More!
ALL THE PRACTICES YOU NEED
Alongside our tools, we also have many nervous system practices designed to help you move from anxiety to focus, relaxation, and more.
• Physiological Sighs 
• NSDR (Non-Sleep Deep Rest) 
• Extended NSDR (Yoga Nidra) 
• Cadence Breathing 
• Belly Breathing 
• Breath of Fire 
• Exhale Retentions 
• Full Body Shaking 
• Alertness Tapping 
• Five by Five Breathing 
• And more!
THE REWIRING ANXIETY JOURNEY
A multi-week guided journey of short daily lessons and somatic practices. Learn the operating manual for your nervous system, discover your anxiety's somatic markers, and build a toolkit that holds up under pressure.
RECENTER IN THE MOMENT
25+ guided practices for the moments anxiety spikes: physiological sighs, orienting, NSDR, vagus nerve stimulation and more. Filter by how you want to feel, save your favorites, and reach a grounding practice in one tap when you need it most.
NEUROACOUSTIC SOUNDSCAPES
Practices are layered with neuroacoustic music engineered to downshift your state, including music-only soundscapes for falling asleep.
START FREE
Your first journey session and daily check-in practices are free. Stateshift Premium unlocks the full journey and practice library as a quarterly or yearly subscription. Cancel anytime.
WHAT OUR USERS ARE SAYING

— Dimitris K.

— Philip F.

listings.name: Stateshift: Overcome Anxiety
listings.description:
DON’T LET ANXIETY SILENTLY HOLD YOU BACK

Stateshift is designed to help you overcome your anxiety for good. The app rewires anxiety with a unique root-cause approach: instead of managing symptoms, you retrain the nervous system patterns underneath them.

It’s based on science-backed practices, over 20 years experience, and 10,000+ hours research.

It works for all anxiety: health, social, relationships, work and more.

It’s also designed to work for many anxiety types:

• General Anxiety  
• Health Anxiety  
• Social Anxiety  
• Performance Anxiety  
• Relationship Anxiety  
• Work Anxiety

MOST APPROACHES GET IT BACKWARDS

Most approaches try to fight anxiety symptoms with short-term band-aids. Stateshift helps you enter into a dialogue with anxiety, and skilfully engage with it to resolve the root cause.

ALL THE TOOLS YOU NEED

Stateshift has everything you need to overcome your anxieties.

• Custom Anxiety Journey  
• Daily Anxiety Lessons  
• Unlimited Anxiety Reflections  
• Recommendations to Overcome Anxiety  
• Bite-Sized Learnings on Anxiety  
• And More!

ALL THE PRACTICES YOU NEED

Alongside our tools, we also have many nervous system practices designed to help you move from anxiety to focus, relaxation, and more.

• Physiological Sighs  
• NSDR (Non-Sleep Deep Rest)  
• Extended NSDR (Yoga Nidra)  
• Cadence Breathing  
• Belly Breathing  
• Breath of Fire  
• Exhale Retentions  
• Full Body Shaking  
• Alertness Tapping  
• Five by Five Breathing  
• And more!

THE REWIRING ANXIETY JOURNEY
A multi-week guided journey of short daily lessons and somatic practices. Learn the operating manual for your nervous system, discover your anxiety's somatic markers, and build a toolkit that holds up under pressure.

RECENTER IN THE MOMENT
25+ guided practices for the moments anxiety spikes: physiological sighs, orienting, NSDR, vagus nerve stimulation and more. Filter by how you want to feel, save your favorites, and reach a grounding practice in one tap when you need it most.

NEUROACOUSTIC SOUNDSCAPES
Practices are layered with neuroacoustic music engineered to downshift your state, including music-only soundscapes for falling asleep.

START FREE
Your first journey session and daily check-in practices are free. Stateshift Premium unlocks the full journey and practice library as a quarterly or yearly subscription. Cancel anytime.

WHAT OUR USERS ARE SAYING

“Perfection. Working in a busy mental health job, this is a perfect way to top up self-care and sustain compassionate practice."

— Izzymonkey123

“Wow love this app. Beautifully designed calming and effective. I love when tech can help us reconnect to others and our bodies more meaningfully—this is a perfect example

— Dimitris K.

“These practices felt like discovering the missing piece of the puzzle. I remember thinking this is ridiculously effective.”

— Philip F.

bluejetty:00149366:ios.description:
Welcome to the EstateSales.NET dedicated sale finder app! You can use our app to quickly and easily locate and keep up-to-date on estate/tag sales, auctions, moving sales, and other types of estate liquidations in your area while out and about.
Speed up your search!
Quickly access thousands of sales nationwide each month with our dedicated app.
Simply search using your location or with your zip code and immediately see sales in your area.
Jump straight to GPS-located driving directions from your city’s sale map to route any ongoing sale!
 Personalize your sale list using custom filtering options and our “Favorite Sales” feature!
Even though our app is new, EstateSales.NET has been around in a nationwide capacity since 2002. Our site became mobile friendly in 2013, but due to the growing demand for a faster, more scaled-down user experience, we’ve developed the first version of our dedicated app. We’re thoroughly committed to making your estate sale hunt the most enjoyable it can possibly be, so please let us know what you think about our app! Contact our support team at support@estatesales.net to provide feedback or to ask for new features.

bluejetty:00186831:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00186831:ios.description:
Cardflow+ is the full version of Cardflow: index cards on a big, free-form board, with the tools to connect, style, and share them.
Write or sketch on a card with Apple Pencil, flip it over like the real thing, and arrange as many as you need. No rigid structure up front. Lay things out however makes sense to you.
WE LOVE INDEX CARDS. We use them a lot. 
They are a versatile and surprisingly powerful tool for all kinds of tasks. From brainstorming to storyboards, to planning entire projects, they have a place in your workflow.
Cardflow captures the ease and flexibility of paper index cards and brings that experience to the iPad.
Rather than impose a rigid structure up front, Cardflow allows you to lay things out however you like, and organize them in the way that makes sense to you.
Jot down ideas or sketch diagrams on cards and arrange them on a large board. Write and draw using the buttery smooth Inkflow vector ink system, or type in a variety of fonts. You can even snap photos of actual cards to use as a background.
Turbocharge your workflow today! Whether you are drafting story boards for a movie, laying out the plot and characters for your novel, or learning a new language, Cardflow has a place in your toolbox. Have all the fun of using index cards, without the forest-pulping guilt of paper.
EDUCATORS: Cardflow+ qualifies for Apple's Volume Purchase Program. Purchase it in quantities of 20 or more at a discount from Apple's VPP site.
HOW TO TRANSFER FILES FROM CARDFLOW
Cardflow+ is installed as a separate App. To transfer a file from Cardflow to Cardflow+:
1. Tap on the file name in the Cardflow Gallery.
2. Tap "Transfer" in the context menu.
3. Select Cardflow+ from the list of Apps.
Cardflow is perfect for:
+ Storyboards for videos or movies
+ Studying for an exam
+ Learning a new language
+ Writing the plot for a novel or book
+ Organizing weddings, parties, and other events
+ Corporate training
+ Project management
+ Agile, Scrum, and other methodologies
+ Group brainstorming
+ Writing your daily goals and to-dos
+ And much more!
CREATIVE TOOLS FOR THE ULTIMATE CREATIVITY DEVICE
We strongly believe that the iPad is not just a consumption device; It's a creativity device. Thanks for supporting us in our journey of building Creative Apps like Cardflow. We hope you enjoy using it!
-- The App Makers @ Qrayon

bluejetty:00018547:ios.description:
Meet the new Al Ameed Coffee App! A redesigned experience bringing Al Ameed Coffee, 73 by Al Ameed, and Al Ameed Experience together in one place.
Order your favorites, explore coffee products, earn points, complete missions, unlock loyalty tiers, and enjoy exclusive rewards along the way.
Everything you love, all in one app:
Switch between brands: browse Al Ameed Coffee, 73 by Al Ameed, and Al Ameed Experience from one app with dedicated sections for each brand.
Order your way: choose delivery, pickup, or curbside pickup for your favorite coffee, café items, and premium coffee products.
Create your perfect coffee blend: choose from our pre-packed coffee selection or customize your own blend with your preferred roast and grind.
Find your nearest branch: easily discover nearby Al Ameed Coffee branches and select the most convenient location for your order.
Scan & collect points: scan the QR code on the app after every eligible purchase to collect loyalty points.
Earn & redeem rewards: earn points across all three brands and redeem them for exclusive rewards or use them toward eligible food and beverage purchases.
Pay with your points: use your points to pay for eligible food and beverage purchases.
Unlock loyalty tiers: every point you earn moves you closer to the next tier. Each tier comes with its own benefits, and the higher you go, the more you unlock, from exclusive rewards to special perks and surprises. 
Complete missions: earn bonus points by taking on fun missions like completing your profile, trying new products, visiting new branches, and more.
Save your favorites: save your favorite orders and delivery addresses for a faster, smoother ordering experience.
Sign-up gift: enjoy a special welcome gift when you join the Al Ameed Coffee App.
Celebrate your birthday: enjoy a special birthday surprise from Al Ameed Coffee.
Whether you are ordering your daily coffee, discovering new products, or collecting rewards, the Al Ameed Coffee App makes every coffee moment more rewarding.
Download the Al Ameed Coffee App today and discover what's new!
