bluejetty:00077418:ios.name: WeDevote Bible 微读圣经经典版
bluejetty:00077418:ios.summary: Believing in fine design and having licensed content, we provide you a new version of WeDevote Bible App with more Bible versions, quality devotional content and a pleasant reading experience. This is a platform for you to read and meditate
bluejetty:00077418:ios.description:
Believing in fine design and having licensed content, we provide you a new version of WeDevote Bible App with more Bible versions, quality devotional content and a pleasant reading experience. This is a platform for you to read and meditate God’s Word anytime anywhere.
There are nine new Bible versions in this APP, including Preacher's Outline & Sermon Bible. We also updated the Lexicon and present more audio Bibles and devotional records for you to study the Word with more references. While reading, you can always highlight and take notes for a certain verse or paragraphs. Furthermore, these can be all synced across your devices when you sign up and log in the APP.
Features of WeDevote Bible app:
1. Delicate Design
We present you a simple and clear layout to read the Bible on your phone as if you are reading a printed copy. We keep the underline to Names and Places, Style in Poetry and Subtitles, etc.
2. Copyright Protection
We respect copyrights. While providing high-quality content, we protect the rights of the authors and publishers. All the content in the app has been authorized by the copyright owners.
3. Bible Versions
There are 42 Bible versions in the app including English, Chinese, Spanish, Japanese, Korean and etc. We will keep adding new versions.
4. Audio Bible
We also provide Audio Bibles of different languages including Mandarin, Cantonese, English, Hebrew, Greek and etc. You can download the records to your phone and listen to them without wifi or data plan.
5. Daily Devotionals
You can subscribe to the Daily Devotionals and get the new content every day. The Devotionals include Streams in the Desert, Bible in One Year, Preaches from Time Keller (Chinese) and etc.
6. Reading Plan
Plans help you keep reading the Bible with various perspectives and arrangements. You can also customize your own reading plan.
7. Lexicon Tools
You can study the Bible and understand God's words with lexicons and morphological and lexical analysis. The tool is based on AI and machine learning technology.
8. Cloud Storage
Free to sign up. We keep all your data under your account. Notes, highlights, reading plans are all synced among multiple devices.
9. Verse Image
Make a beautiful verse image card and share it to Facebook, Instagram, WeChat, etc.

Stop guessing which breaker controls what.
Whether you're a homeowner mapping a single panel or an electrician documenting multiple buildings, Breaker Box gives you a complete directory for every circuit — and lets you print a professional
bluejetty:00087901:ios.description:
Stop guessing which breaker controls what.
Whether you're a homeowner mapping a single panel or an electrician documenting multiple buildings, Breaker Box gives you a complete directory for every circuit — and lets you print a professional legend to match.
LABEL EVERY CIRCUIT
Assign notes, rooms, and fixtures to each breaker. Tandem splits, multi-pole circuits, GFCI outlets, and HACR systems all supported. Track wire gauge and size. Use custom phase colors for 1-, 2-, and 3-phase panels.
ORGANIZE BY ROOM
Link circuits to the rooms and fixtures they control — so you always know which breaker to flip, in seconds.
PDF LEGENDS
Export to PDF, sized to fit a panel sleeve or tape to the door. Adjust font scale per label for a professional result.
MULTI-PANEL SUPPORT
Manage multiple panels across one or more properties. Link breakers to sub-panels.
PRO FEATURES
• Unlimited panels
• PDF export with custom print sizes
• Cloud sync across all your devices
• Custom fixture types and unlimited rooms
• Import and export for client handoffs and device transfers
BACKUP & RESTORE
Automatic backups and cloud management keep your data safe.
Every circuit, documented.

bluejetty:00061768:ios.description:
TOTVS Meu RH is the exclusive corporate solution that transforms your Human Resources department, making it more digital, agile, and productive. With a modern and intuitive interface, the application delivers mobility so employees and managers can perform HR routines anytime and anywhere.
Designed to eliminate bureaucracy, the app enables your team to focus on what truly matters: more efficient and human-centered management.
Why choose the Meu RH App?
Agile Implementation: Simplified installation and native integration with TOTVS HR systems (Protheus, RM, and Datasul lines).
Intuitive Interface: User-friendly design that ensures high employee adoption without the need for complex training.
True Autonomy: Freedom for employees to manage their own information, reducing the operational workload of HR.
Legal Compliance: Mobile electronic time tracking with geolocation technology, fully compliant with current regulations.
Main Features for Employees:
Digital Time Tracking: Remote clock-in registration with geolocation and real-time access to time records.
Payments at Your Fingertips: View and download payroll statements (pay slips) and income reports.
Self-Service: Request vacations, leave adjustments, medical certificates, and track salary history directly from the smartphone.
Transparency: Quick access to time bank balances (positive and negative).
Main Features for Managers:
Team Management: Centralized view of all approved and pending team requests.
Agile Approvals: Authorize vacations and time adjustments individually or in batches, respecting the company hierarchy.
Management Dashboards: Monitor vacation indicators, employee birthdays, and workplace climate management.
Workforce Changes: Initiate replacement, termination, and hiring processes with just a few clicks.
Exclusive Benefits:
SAVINGS: Significant reduction in printing costs and manual processing time.
AGILITY: Paperless approval flows and real-time processes.
EASY CREDIT ACCESS: Integration with TOTVS Consignado to provide access to credit directly through the app.
Digitize your HR operations. Make your company more productive with the TOTVS Meu RH App.

bluejetty:00066289:ios.name: Sky: Children of the Light
bluejetty:00066289:ios.summary: In Sky, a fellow adventurer takes your hand and leads you somewhere you'd never have found on your own. That's the heart of it: real people quietly looking after each other across a beautiful, forgotten kingdom. A small gesture can become a
bluejetty:00066289:ios.description:
In Sky, a fellow adventurer takes your hand and leads you somewhere you'd never have found on your own. That's the heart of it: real people quietly looking after each other across a beautiful, forgotten kingdom. A small gesture can become a friendship, and an unfamiliar player can make a lonely journey feel a little less lonely.
Free to play and with no ads to break the moment, Sky is a peaceful, award-winning social adventure from the creators of Journey. Explore seven hand-crafted realms, solve gentle puzzles, and find your way home alongside millions of players around the world. Anything you can buy is cosmetic, so all you need to bring is your curiosity.
Game Features:
FRIENDS YOU DIDN'T EXPECT
Light someone's candle, offer a hand, share a bench at sunset. There are countless small ways to meet another player here, and friendships tend to start with a gesture rather than a word.
MORE REASONS TO RETURN
Every day brings something new to find. Play regularly to unlock fresh experiences and earn candles you can redeem for cosmetics.
A STYLE THAT'S ONLY YOURS
Every season and event brings new looks and accessories. Express yourself, find a style of your own, and dress like someone worth recognizing across a crowded realm.
PLENTY TO DO TOGETHER
Learn new emotes and gain wisdom from Elder Spirits. Challenge a friend to a race, get cozy around a fire, jam on instruments, or fly down a mountainside. Just beware of the Krill.
CROSS-PLATFORM PLAY
Your friends are here, whatever they're playing on.
SHARE WHAT YOU SEE
Sky has a remarkable community of photographers, artists, and filmmakers. Capture your favorite moments and share the memories you make together.
Winner of:
-Mobile Game of the Year (Apple)
-Outstanding Design and Innovation (Apple)
-Most users in a concert-themed virtual world (Guinness World Record)
-Mobile Game of the Year (SXSW)
-Best Visual Design: Aesthetic (Webby)
-Best Gameplay & People’s Choice (Games for Change Awards)
-Audience Award (Game Developers Choice Award)
-Best Indie Game (Tap Tap Game Awards)
As required by Indonesian law, this game is classified as 13+ by IGRS.

- NWS watches, warnings, advisories: the US only. 
- Radar images: the US (Continental US, Alaska (except northern), Hawaii, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands and Puerto Rico), Mexico (northern), Canada (southern), Australia, the UK, Ireland, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy (northern and north-western), Denmark, Austria, Sweden, Finland, Spain, Portugal, Switzerland, Norway, Poland, Andorra, Japan, Taiwan and more. 
- Satellite images, Precipitation map, hurricane & lightning trackers, detailed weather info: most of the world.  
UPGRADE TO PREMIUM

- No Ads

1, 9 sects of mutual generation and conflict - RE-REPRESENTING VU LAM'S MEMORIES:
In Nhat Kiem Chi Vuong, our ultimate martial arts world, you will be immersed in the exquisite recreation of the legendary Vo Lam. Choose one of 9 factions with unique characteristics and skills. Each choice will take you on a unique journey, full of attractions and challenges. You can re-experience the memories of the first days of entering classical Vo Lam.

We want you to have a unique VIP experience. With the opportunity to receive VIP Level 9 for free, you will have access to unlimited offers and experiences. With more than 100 unique PVP activities, you will always have the opportunity to unleash PK anytime, anywhere. There is never boredom in this world of martial arts, when you have to face strong and dramatic opponents. Only the strong can survive, and you can be that person!
4, CONSTITUTION TRANSACTIONS - AUCTION TO RECEIVE VOLUME OF KNB:

Welcome to CTA Dex — the most complete companion app for Pokémon trainers, covering every main series game from Red & Blue to Legends ZA, plus TCG Pocket and Pokopia!
POKÉDEX & COLLECTION TRACKING
Complete National Dex with all forms: regional variants, Mega, Gigantamax, Tera, gender, and alternate forms
Track your regular dex, living dex, and shiny living dex — all in one place

Build and save teams for every supported game
Set moves, ability, held item, nature, IVs, EVs, and Tera type
View calculated stats based on your inputs

Interactive type effectiveness chart and matchup calculator
Gym leader & Elite Four teams with full rosters and levels
TCG POCKET
Track your card collection across 25+ expansion sets
Filter by rarity, type, energy, and pack
Track cosmetics: coins, emblems, sleeves, playmats, deck covers, icons, and display boards
POKOPIA
Pokédex and event Pokédex tracker
Habitats and event habitats
Fossils, CDs, and Lost Relics (S & L) collections
Complete moves database

bluejetty:00180257:ios.description:
What is e-Pay?
e-Pay is the first ever government payment gateway designed to allow the citizens of Punjab to pay their taxes digitally through alternative delivery channels (ADC). The solution that is developed by The Punjab Information Technology Board and backed by the Finance Department of Punjab provides individuals to pay their dues using the following three payment channels.
• Internet Banking
• ATM 
• OTC (Over the Counter) banking transaction 
Payment Process and Channels
To pay the tax dues, an individual will access e-Pay application or website to generate a 17-digit PSID number. The PSID number that is unique for each transaction could subsequently be used on the aforementioned three payment channels i.e. internet banking, ATM or OTC by the citizens to pay the tax dues.
All three payment channels are made technically equipped to process the payments through the collective efforts of The Finance Department of Punjab, State Bank of Pakistan, 1-Link, all scheduled banks, and Punjab Information Technology Board (PITB).   In its first phase (FY 18 -19) following tax receipts can be paid via e-Pay: 
Excise & Taxation
• Token Tax for Vehicle
• Motor Vehicle Registration
• Vehicle Transfer
• Property Tax
• Professional Tax
• Cotton fee
Board of Revenue (BOR)
• e Stamping
• Mutation fee
• Fard fee
Industries
• Business Registration fee
Tax Descriptions
Token Tax for Vehicle: Annual tax paid by owners of motor vehicles.
Motor Vehicle Registration: One-time fee paid by the buyer of new vehicle at the time of purchase.
Vehicle Transfer: Fee paid at the time of transfer of vehicle to a new owner.
Property Tax: Annual tax paid by property owners in urban areas.
Professional Tax: Taxes paid by the working professional on his profession on an annual basis.
Cotton Fee: Fee paid on raw cotton brought to ginning factory.
e-Stamping: Payment of stamp duties on judicial, non-judicial, CVT, registration and comparison fee.
Mutation Fee: Fee paid by the buyer at the time of transfer of property to a new owner.
Fard Fee: Fee paid by the owner of property for the issuance of property ownership document.
Business Registration Fee: Fee paid by the owner to register his business.

NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED. AD-FREE, UNLIMITED ACCESS FOR NETFLIX MEMBERS.
Unleash your creativity in the salon and whip up any style you can imagine. Get creative with makeup, face paint, hair and beard tools and much more! Whether you choose a character and create a brand-new look you've dreamed up, or just see where the tools take you, each makeover is an adventure. 
CUT, COLOR AND STYLE AT THE HAIR AND BEARD STATION
Trim, shave and even re-grow hair anywhere on your character's head. This station has all the hot tools you need for curling, straightening and texturizing. Or grab the bottles of hair dye and choose any color of the rainbow for a bold new look. Your hair salon, your rules! 
GET CREATIVE WITH MAKEUP AT THE FACE STATION
Play around with makeup in every color for endless makeover options. Create lush lashes with mascara, and pick a tool to put on eyeliner, eyeshadow or blush. In the mood for a bolder look? Grab the face paints and draw right onto your character's face.
PICK OUT A NEW OUTFIT AT THE STYLE STATION
What's a makeover without some new clothes to go with it? There are hundreds of styles to suit that new look at the style station! Change up your character's outfit, pick out some stickers and add a finishing touch with accessories like glasses and hats. 
SNAP A PIC IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
Choose a background, watch them strike a pose, and snap a picture of your character's new style. You can even save a picture of your character's makeover in a photo book and return to styling them later. 
SCRUB UP SOME SUDS AT THE SHAMPOO STATION
Ready for a fresh start? Wash hair, towel off and blow dry at the shampoo station. Watch their face paint and makeup drip away so you can create a brand-new look at the salon!
ABOUT TOCA BOCA 
Toca Boca is an award-winning game studio that makes digital toys for kids. We think playing and having fun is the best way to learn about the world. Therefore we make digital toys and games that help stimulate the imagination, and that you can play together with your kids.
- Created by Toca Boca.

bluejetty:00157912:ios.description:
Welcome to Suta
Suta is the most humble product we meet and live with every day. It means thread. Su- Sujata and Ta- Taniya were elated when they discovered the magic of the syllables in their names. It feels that it’s meant to be. Silly childhood game of selling bags made out of handkerchief suddenly started looking like a signal. Su and Ta always had a special liking for the countless and varied forms of art and culture across India. Even after spending many years in the corporate world, theirpassion never abated. Thus in 2016, fighting many odds, Suta was born. 
The brand SUTA is a fresh design house that centers on creating a range of attire with a blend of tradition and contemporaneity. Suta’s crafted inspirations pay attention to details and the designs add elegance, boldness and grace. SUTA or thread, the basis of the brand's inspiration is a reminder of the craft traditions of India. Like a pure creation that begins with a needle and thread, SUTA offers novelty each time it is experienced.
Suta is the maker of simple and humble designs using our very own and known fabrics to make our souls sing with joy. Artisans from all around the country create raw and uninhibited designs usingtheir ancestral weaving processes. Suta talks to tradition and weaves its own creation. We salute their craftsmanship and are thankful to them for keeping this art alive. Suta products are just a token of representation of the innumerous souls who have touched the fabric. We aspire to keep the undying spirit of artistry alive.
Suta celebrates raw threads, traditional boldness and uninterrupted simplicity!
How different are we:
That inexplicable thing that sets Ma’s food apart from even the top chefs of the world, that makes a girl feel more secure in her dad’s company than in the company of 10 trained commandos. We call it ‘love’. The love Su and Ta have for each Suta product is what sets SUTA apart. Each design is unique and has an inspiration. The final product that you witness is dipped in love and that shows in the photographs which Ta clicks and mostly Su models.
Know Su and Ta:
Your very own Su and Ta are designers by choice and sheer passion. Su did her engineering from CET Bhubaneswar and MBA from IIFT Delhi. She then worked for 6 years across the Essar group and Jindal group. Ta did her engineering from NIT Rourkela and MBA from IIM Lukhnow. She worked for 3 years across the TATA group and IBM.

listings.description:
Welcome to Suta

Suta is the most humble product we meet and live with every day. It means thread. Su- Sujata and Ta- Taniya were elated when they discovered the magic of the syllables in their names. It feels that it’s meant to be. Silly childhood game of selling bags made out of handkerchief suddenly started looking like a signal. Su and Ta always had a special liking for the countless and varied forms of art and culture across India. Even after spending many years in the corporate world, theirpassion never abated. Thus in 2016, fighting many odds, Suta was born. 

The brand SUTA is a fresh design house that centers on creating a range of attire with a blend of tradition and contemporaneity. Suta’s crafted inspirations pay attention to details and the designs add elegance, boldness and grace. SUTA or thread, the basis of the brand's inspiration is a reminder of the craft traditions of India. Like a pure creation that begins with a needle and thread, SUTA offers novelty each time it is experienced.

Suta is the maker of simple and humble designs using our very own and known fabrics to make our souls sing with joy. Artisans from all around the country create raw and uninhibited designs usingtheir ancestral weaving processes. Suta talks to tradition and weaves its own creation. We salute their craftsmanship and are thankful to them for keeping this art alive. Suta products are just a token of representation of the innumerous souls who have touched the fabric. We aspire to keep the undying spirit of artistry alive.

 

Suta celebrates raw threads, traditional boldness and uninterrupted simplicity!

How different are we:

That inexplicable thing that sets Ma’s food apart from even the top chefs of the world, that makes a girl feel more secure in her dad’s company than in the company of 10 trained commandos. We call it ‘love’.  The love Su and Ta have for each Suta product is what sets SUTA apart. Each design is unique and has an inspiration. The final product that you witness is dipped in love and that shows in the photographs which Ta clicks and mostly Su models.

Know Su and Ta:

Your very own Su and Ta are designers by choice and sheer passion. Su did her engineering from CET Bhubaneswar and MBA from IIFT Delhi. She then worked for 6 years across the Essar group and Jindal group. Ta did her engineering from NIT Rourkela and MBA from IIM Lukhnow. She worked for 3 years across the TATA group and IBM.

bluejetty:00079572:ios.description:
The myAmaCruise mobile app is packed full of features specifically designed to enhance your river cruise experience.
Access a live cruise tracking map showing your cruising route, the location of your ship as well as photos and information about each of the destinations and shore excursions you will experience along the way.
Upload your river cruise photos to your personal cruise album. Photos will pin automatically to your live cruise tracking map so you can easily recall where each one was taken. You can also send your friends a beautiful email postcard of each of your photos or share on Facebook and Twitter.
During your cruise you will be able to access an electronic version of your Daily Cruiser newsletter which provides up-to-date information about the day ahead including a detailed schedule of shore excursions, on-board activities and more.

bluejetty:00016094:ios.name: Brawl Stars
bluejetty:00016094:ios.summary:
Fast paced 3v3 & 5v5 MOBA and Battle Royale made for mobile! Play online with friends or solo across a variety of PvP arena game modes in under three minutes.
Unlock and upgrade dozens of Brawlers with powerful super abilities, star power
bluejetty:00016094:ios.description:
Fast paced 3v3 & 5v5 MOBA and Battle Royale made for mobile! Play online with friends or solo across a variety of PvP arena game modes in under three minutes.
Unlock and upgrade dozens of Brawlers with powerful super abilities, star powers and gadgets! Collect unique skins to stand out and show off. Battle in a variety of mysterious arena locations within the MOBA Brawliverse!
Brawl Stars is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.
◉ BATTLE IN MULTIPLE GAME MODES:
▶ Gem Grab (3v3,5v5): Team up for real time 3v3 and 5v5 MOBA arena PvP battles against online players from across the world. Team up to battle and out strategize the opposing team. Collect and hold 10 gems to win, but get fragged and lose your gems.
▶ Showdown (solo/duo): A MOBA battle royale style fight for survival. Collect power ups for your Brawler. Grab a friend or play solo, be the last Brawler standing in the rowdiest MOBA PvP battle royale yet. Winner takes it all! 
▶ Brawl Ball (3v3,5v5): It's a whole new brawl game! Show off your soccer/football skills and score two goals before the other team. There are no red cards here.
▶ Bounty (3v3,5v5): Battle to take out opponents and earn stars, but don’t let them pick you off. The squad with the most stars wins the match!
▶ Heist (3v3,5v5): Protect your team’s safety and try to crack open your opponents’. Navigate the arena to sneak, blast, battle and blow your way clear to the enemies treasure.
▶ Special MOBA Events: Limited time special MOBA PvE and PvP arena battle game modes.
▶ Championship Challenge: Join Brawl Stars' esports scene with in-game qualifiers!
◉ UNLOCK AND UPGRADE BRAWLERS:
Collect and upgrade a variety of Brawlers with powerful super abilities, star powers and gadgets! Level them up and collect unique skin.
A fast paced battle royale MOBA made for mobile. Unlock and collect new, powerful "brawlers", each with a signature attack and super ability.
◉ BRAWL PASS:
Complete quests, open Brawl Boxes, earn Gems, pins and an exclusive Brawl Pass skin! Fresh content every season.
◉ BECOME THE STAR PLAYERS
Battle to climb the local and regional PvP leaderboards to prove you’re the greatest MOBA brawler of them all! Join or start your own MOBA club with fellow players online to share tips and battle together. Climb to the top of the PvP leaderboards in global and local rankings.
◉ CONSTANTLY EVOLVING MOBA
Look out for new "brawlers", skins, maps, special events and game modes in the future. Customize Brawlers with unlockable skins. Enjoy PVP battles solo or with friends online.
New PVP and PVE events and game modes daily. Player designed maps offer challenging new terrain to master.
From the makers of “Clash of Clans”, “Clash Royale” and “Boom Beach”!
The IGRS Rating for this game is 15+

Brawl Stars may request permission via in-game pop ups to access your camera and send you notifications.
Camera: For in-game scanning of QR codes

Consent is optional and you can use the app and play the game regardless of whether or not you consent. You may refuse to give consent within the game. However, certain app features may not work properly if you refuse optional access permissions.

bluejetty:00037323:ios.description:
Browsec is a free VPN that helps protect your privacy online. Browsec products are used by 8 million people every month.
- Protect all your apps. Browsec encrypts the internet traffic from all your apps over any internet connection, including Wi-Fi and mobile networks, while the VPN is connected.
- Keep your browsing private. Help keep the websites you visit private from your internet service provider and others on your local network.
- Hide your IP address. Browsec masks your public IP address so websites see the IP address of the VPN server.
- Access any website from any country except China, where reliable access is not guaranteed.
- No in-app ads. Browsec Free and Browsec Premium are both ad-free.
- Choose from four free locations: the United States, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and Singapore.
Upgrade to Browsec Premium
- More locations. Choose from 46 Premium locations: Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hong Kong, Hungary, Iceland, India, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Romania, Russia, Serbia, Singapore, Slovenia, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States, and United States (West).
- Faster, more consistent speeds. Connect to a separate network of servers reserved for Premium users.
- Priority support. Requests from Premium users are handled first.
Subscriptions
Browsec Premium is available through an auto-renewable subscription. Available plans and prices are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

מסעדות, חנויות, בעלי מקצוע, אירועים ועוד אלפי קטגוריות בכל הארץ, לפי כל מה שקרוב, מה שטוב ו/או מה שמשתלם! 
איזי היא אפליקציית החיפוש המקומי הגדולה בישראל, המחברת בין אנשים ועסקים טובים.
המידע באיזי מתעדכן על ב
bluejetty:00065489:ios.description:
איזי - למצוא את כל מה שסביבך!
מסעדות, חנויות, בעלי מקצוע, אירועים ועוד אלפי קטגוריות בכל הארץ, לפי כל מה שקרוב, מה שטוב ו/או מה שמשתלם! 
איזי היא אפליקציית החיפוש המקומי הגדולה בישראל, המחברת בין אנשים ועסקים טובים.
המידע באיזי מתעדכן על בסיס יומי, מבוסס על אלפי אתרים וכולל מאות אלפי עסקים, נק' עניין ובעלי מקצוע. 
העסקים ברשימה מדורגים לפי ציון איזי המשקלל נתונים וביקורות מכל רחבי הרשת. לאיזי קהילת משתמשים גדולה ופעילה המורכבת מעשרות אלפי חברים אשר מוסיפים תמונות, ביקורות ועדכונים ודואגים בכך להעשיר את המידע המוצג לך. 
ויש גם ווידג'ט! משתמשים הרבה באיזי? במיוחד בשבילכם, חיפוש בקליק אחד. כי תמיד אפשר יותר איזי :)
להוספה לחצו לחיצה ארוכה על אייקון האפליקציה ומשם נותר רק למקם על המכשיר. תהנו!
באיזי אפשר למצוא את כל הפרטים על עסקים בישראל!
כתובות, טלפונים, שעות פתיחה, תמונות, הנחות, מבצעים, ביקורות גולשים ומומחים, מחירונים ועוד! 
מצאת עסק מתאים? אפשר ליצור איתו קשר בטלפון או באמצעות הצ'אט באפליקציה, לנווט ליעד בקלות, להזמין מקום ועוד שלל אפשרויות.
איזי כוללת מאגר של אנשי מקצוע במאות קטגוריות: אינסטלטורים, חשמלאים, מנעולנים, טכנאים, רופאים, עורכי דין, מורים פרטיים ואפילו דוג-ווקרים - כל נותני השירות בארץ בכל תחום, במקום אחד. 
שירות easyFix
 חוסך זמן ומאפשר לך לשלוח פנייה לקבלת שירות למס' בעלי מקצוע במקביל בהתאם לפרטי התקלה ולפי השעות שנוחות לך. להזמין איש מקצוע מעולם לא היה כל כך קל ובטוח!
יש לך עסק?
כנראה שהוא כבר נמצא באיזי! ניתן לתפוס בעלות על העסק בחינם
דרך האפליקציה או האתר. 
ניהול עמוד העסק באיזי יאפשר לך לשלוט בנראות העמוד ולהשתמש בכלים מתקדמים כמו קידום, סטטיסטיקות, משלוחים ועוד.
איך משתמשים באיזי?
מערכת החיפוש המתקדמת של איזי מבוססת מיקום ומורכבת מאלפי קטגוריות ואפשרויות פילטור שעוזרים לך למצוא בדיוק את העסק שחיפשת עם כל הפרטים הנחוצים. את התוצאות ניתן לסדר בעזרת הסליידר לפי מה שטוב ו/או מה שקרוב. רוצה לנסות?
"מסעדת בשרים מתאימה לילדים" 
"מסלול טיול בחורף"
"פלאפל ללא גלוטן"
"מסעדה איטלקית כשרה חלבית" 
"ברים עם אוכל טבעוני" 
"אטרקציות נגישות"
"מסעדה פתוחה בשבת"
• רוצים לאכול? באיזי ניתן למצוא בקלות את כל המסעדות באזורכם, עם חלוקה לפי סגנון מטבח, אווירה, סוג כשרות, צמחוני, טבעוני, ידידותי לילדים, אמצעי תשלום, חבר מועדון ועוד!
• צריכים איש מקצוע? באיזי רשומים עשרות אלפי אנשי מקצוע, כולל ביקורות של משתמשים אחרים, תחומי התמחות, מחירון ואפילו תו "יצאת צדיק". קצרים בזמן? נסו את easyFix לשליחת בקשת שירות למס' בעלי מקצוע במקביל.
• עם הילדים? אפשר לחפש פעילויות לכל הגילאים - ג'ימבורי, חדרי בריחה, גני שעשועים ועוד! 
• הולכים לטייל? אפשר למצוא מסלולי טיול לפי עונה מומלצת! וגם: שמורות טבע, גנים לאומיים, חופי רחצה, מעיינות, יערות ועוד! 
• בדרכים? חיפוש "על הדרך" מאפשר לך לבחור עסקים ומקומות לאורך המסלול ממיקומך הנוכחי כל הדרך אל היעד.
• מתכננים שופינג? באיזי אפשר למצוא חנויות מקומיות מכל התחומים: אופנה, ספורט, מזון, חשמל, רהיטים ועוד המון.
• מתכוננים לסופ"ש? כל סוגי הפעילויות והאטרקציות, עם חלוקה לגילאים, מחירים והתאמה לעונות השנה.
• יוצאים לבלות? הופעות, סטנד אפ, סרטים, אירועי ספורט ומסיבות - כל האירועים לפי סוג, מיקום ותאריך. 
• הכל סביבך באיזי! תחנות דלק, כספומטים, בתי כנסת, דואר ישראל, אנטנות סלולריות, גינות כלבים, מיחזוריות ועודדדדדדדדדד.

bluejetty:00164817:ios.description:
Greetings, Hero!
Welcome to Darkest AFK — a dark fantasy Idle RPG filled with magic, dungeons and epic battles. Summon heroes, form your team and fight through endless auto-battles, even when you're offline!
• Collect and upgrade heroes
Knights, Paladins, Archers and Mages — each with unique skills and powerful equipment. Build the ultimate squad!
• Explore a vast world
Travel through cursed forests, ancient ruins and dark dungeons. Face PvE challenges, conquer levels and prepare for brutal boss fights.
• Enjoy effortless auto-combat
Tap to unleash special attacks or let your team battle automatically. Perfect for both casual players and experienced RPG fans.
• Discover an epic story
Unravel mysteries hidden in a grim world full of secrets, monsters and ancient evil.
• Play your way
Level up, collect loot, enhance your gear and become the hero this world needs.
Darkest AFK is free to play with optional in-app purchases. The game supports English, Español, Français, Русский, Deutsch and Italiano.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/darkestafk
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/darkestafk
Discord: https://discord.gg/ksfpxCYbnA
About subscriptions:
The “Heroic subscription” gives you access to the following privileges within a particular period of time:
- Hero Exp earned in IDLE is increased by 25%
- Hero Exp earned in the Mines of Abyss is increased by 25%
The “Golden subscription” gives you access to the following privileges within a particular period of time:
- Basic gold earned in IDLE is increased by 25%
- Gold earned in the Mines of Abyss is increased by 25%
Each subscription costs $ 0.99 per week and is automatically renewed when the initial subscription term expires. (Price may vary depending on your location.)
The Subscription cycle is 1 week.
Purchasing the Subscription requires the same methods of payment used to make any kind of purchase in the app.
How to cancel the Subscription: to cancel or modify your Subscription, you need to open your account page in the app store and change the corresponding settings.
Subscription Renewal: at the end of the cycle, the Subscription will automatically be renewed for one more cycle.
User Agreement: https://darkestafk.com/terms 
Privacy Statement: https://darkestafk.com/policy

bluejetty:00186783:ios.description:
Tap, fill, cheer! A bright, happy coloring book for little artists, with Dino the friendly dinosaur cheering you on.
Pick a page, tap a part and it fills with color. Paint never spills outside the lines, so every picture comes out neat. Bigger kids can zoom in and paint the fine details with a finger or Apple Pencil.
120 PAGES IN 17 TOPICS
• Dinosaurs, ocean, space, fantasy, pets, farm and wild animals
• Vehicles, food & sweets, toys, sports, holidays, places, flowers and more
• Mandalas and patterns for calm coloring
• Easy, medium and detailed pages, so there is something for every age
• Search by word: type "cat", "rocket" or "cake"
MAGIC PAINTS
• 8 fill styles: solid, puffy, watercolor, crayon, shiny foil, hearts, stars and scales
• Brush, glitter and rainbow brushes, plus an eraser
• Color palettes from classic to pastel, nature, ocean, candy and skin & hair
• Undo and redo, any time
STICKERS
• 48 cute stickers: unicorns, rockets, cupcakes, animals and more
• Move, turn and resize them with your fingers
PLAY WITH YOUR ART
• A big "Great job!" cheer when a picture is done
• Turn your picture into a jigsaw puzzle: 3x3, 4x4 or 5x5 pieces
• Watch a time-lapse of how you colored it and save it as a video
• Every picture saves itself and waits for you in My art
MADE FOR KIDS AND PARENTS
• Big buttons, simple icons and happy little haptics
• No accounts and no sign-up
• Every page is free; a small ad banner sits at the bottom of the screen
• For iPhone and iPad, with a roomy layout made for iPad
Pick a page. Tap to color. Great job!

bluejetty:00136219:ios.name: Bookworm Reads
bluejetty:00136219:ios.summary: Bookworm Reads is a book tracker & joyful community app. On Bookworm, you can track your books, see what your friends are reading, rate, review, and discuss books, create and join book clubs, and be a part of a vibrant digital community of
bluejetty:00136219:ios.description:
Bookworm Reads is a book tracker & joyful community app. On Bookworm, you can track your books, see what your friends are reading, rate, review, and discuss books, create and join book clubs, and be a part of a vibrant digital community of readers. We're like Goodreads but for the girls, gays, and theys. Plus, you get to be a worm.
Discover new books to save to your library, create your own customizable bookshelves, send and receive book recommendations from friends, and join community reading challenges. 
The best part of all: dress up your wormy avatar from a variety of outfits, hats, accessories, and more!
Import your Goodreads data: Say goodbye to Amazon-owned Goodreads, and keep your bookshelves just as you left them. Import from Goodreads and start using Bookworm.
Simple, beautiful, book tracking. Track & categorize your books into bookshelves: books you want to read, have read, are currently reading. Plus, create your own custom bookshelves. Your 5-star club, books you DNF (did not finish), abandoned, repeat reads; whatever your heart desires. Add as many shelves as you want--no power-tools required.
Join community reading challenges. Set a reading goal for yourself and let your friends cheer you on. The number of books you set as your goal is only visible to you. Upon joining, you get the option to give your wormy a badge to show you're participating in the community challenge. And, you can edit your goal number as the challenge continues.
Share book recommendations. Send recommendations to friends and get them in return. Get notified whenever someone starts reading the book you recommended, and check out their review when they finish. All books recommended to you get saved to a bookshelf so you'll never lose them.
Create, organize, and join book clubs. Find like-minded readers and host discussions in the app. You can create collaborative shelves, where everyone in the club can add to your shared to-read shelf, or you can do the choosing and let readers to follow along. Get started by joining Thee Bookworm Book Club--the Bookworm-wide club.
Dress up your wormy avatar. Hands down the best feature on Bookworm Reads: dress up your wormy avatar! Choose from outfits, wigs, accessories, and more to keep your wormy as fresh as you are. Get creative, and change your outfit as much as you want! You can also buy a real life bookworm bookmark + sticker pack to keep your books adorned with Bookworm swag.
Social sharing included. Share books to your instagram story with pre-made, gorgeous backgrounds. You can tweet, text, email, or whatever kind of sharing you'd like with everything on Bookworm. From books, to posts, to your wormy's outfit, share on whatever platform is your favorite.
Features:
• track & categorize your books into bookshelves: books you want to read, have read, are currently reading
• plus, create your own custom book categories. for example, create a bookshelf for books you couldn't finish, or your favorite books you want everyone to read
• join reading challenges: set a goal for yourself and get that lil dopamine hit every time you finish a book
• recommend books to friends and get notified when they read your suggestion
• organize your book club: set your books, your next meeting info, and host discussion in your club
• discover new clubs: join one of the many public book clubs to find new reading buddies
• design your wormy's outfit
• share all of this to social media 
• import from Goodreads, Storygraph, Libib, or wherever you track your books. No need to start over! Bring your Goodreads/Storygraph data right into Bookworm.
Download Bookworm Reads, create your wormy, and join the community!

bluejetty:00038924:ios.description:
KORAIL+ is the official mobile app of Korea Railroad Corporation (KORAIL).
[Key Features]
■ Home
You can check various recommended information including connected transportation services and travel products at a glance, based on the itinerary of your ticket. 
■ Ticket Reservation
You can easily check train information and quickly reserve your desired train on a simple and intuitive screen.
■ Travel Service Reservation
Browse and book a variety of travel products including tourist trains and KORAIL Passes. 
■ My Ticket
Enjoy a more convenient trip with a ticket list that shows your itinerary at a glance on a ticket screen optimized for train travel. 
■ Full Menu
A well-organized menu structure helps you to quickly and easily find the functions you need. 
■ Language Support
Multiple language support makes train reservation easy and convenient for foreigners.
[Access Permission Information]
· Optional access permission
 · Location Information: Select a nearby station when searching for a station
 · Photo: Save and share tickets
 · Camera: Self-checkin for non-reserved seats, credit card number recognition 
※ You can change access permission settings in Phone Settings > Apps > Korail+
[Developer Information]
· Contact: 1588-7788
· Address : KORAIL Corporation, 240 Jungang-ro, Dong-gu, Daejeon (34618)

bluejetty:00087268:ios.description: Hydro-Presse est le journal d’entreprise des employés et des retraités d’Hydro-Québec depuis près de 100 ans. C’est en 1922 que la Montreal Light, Heat and Power Consolidated (MLHPC) lance un journal bilingue, The Dual Service / Le service double. La publication change de nom en 1936 pour l’Entre-Nous. Et 35 ans plus tard, le magazine adopte le nom qu’il porte encore aujourd’hui : Hydro-Presse. Au fil du temps, le magazine a toujours conservé sa mission : contribuer à l’engagement et à la fierté des hydroquébécoises et des hydroquébécois grâce à une information de qualité sur les grands enjeux de l’entreprise.

bluejetty:00078029:ios.name: LP Old Norse
bluejetty:00078029:ios.summary: Old Norse can be studied as the language of the Eddas and the Icelandic sagas; the ancestor of the Scandinavian tongues; or, because of the Viking presence in the British Isles, a major influence on the development of English. But while man
bluejetty:00078029:ios.description:
Old Norse can be studied as the language of the Eddas and the Icelandic sagas; the ancestor of the Scandinavian tongues; or, because of the Viking presence in the British Isles, a major influence on the development of English. But while many of its words are recognisable, the connections are often vague or misleading, and it follows a more complicated grammar than most of its modern relatives. The answer is ultimately memorisation, which is where Liberation Philology Old Norse can help.
Whenever you have a moment to spare, your phone can call up a rolling multiple-choice test that helps you practise Old Norse vocabulary and grammar. Each answer you give is immediately confirmed or corrected, and your knowledge is reinforced by as much repetition as you find useful.
• Vocabulary: 335 levels, each testing your ability to translate ten words between English and Old Norse. Interspersed among these are cumulative levels reviewing what has been learned earlier (for a total of 377 levels).
• Nouns: Tests your ability to parse and to decline all types of Old Norse nouns.
• Pronouns: Tests the declension of Old Norse pronouns.
• Verbs: Tests your ability to parse and to conjugate Old Norse verbs, present and past, indicative and subjunctive, active and middle (revised and expanded in 2020).
An additional Reference module allows you to review the word-list for the vocabulary test, and the paradigms for nouns, verbs, and pronouns.

bluejetty:00040647:ios.description:
Bring your drawings to life with Animated Drawings. Draw right in the app or upload a drawing from paper, pick how you want it to animate, and watch it start moving as you wish.
Animated Drawings is an interactive and educational app designed to ignite the imagination of children. With this app, kids can transform their static drawings into dynamic and animated creations. By simply drawing characters or objects on the screen, children can bring them to life and make them move, jump, and dance.
NEW IN THIS VERSION
We rebuilt Animated Drawings from the first tap to the final share a brand new look with bigger buttons and clearer steps, plus:
- A Daily Challenge: a fresh character to draw every day
- My Studio: all your characters in one gallery, dancing right on their cards
- A Sticker Book to spend your collected stars in
- Whole scenes: add more than one character, move them, resize them, add props
- Backgrounds: choose one of ours, or use your own photo
- Sound: music that plays along, and record your own voice into the video
- A clearer Parent Zone for grown-ups
The app provides a user-friendly interface that allows children to easily navigate and explore various tools and features. They can choose from a wide range of colors, brush sizes, and patterns to create their unique characters and designs. The intuitive and responsive animated drawings tools make it easy for kids of all ages to express their creativity.
Once drawings are complete, the real magic begins. With a simple tap, the characters instantly come alive, captivating children with their animated movements. They can watch their creations interact with each other on a stage they build themselves.
Animated Drawings not only entertains but also nurtures important skills. Children can use their imagination to invent narratives around their animated characters, fostering language development and creative thinking.
Parents can join in on the fun too! The app provides an opportunity for quality bonding time as families can enjoy watching and discussing the animated drawings together. It's a wonderful way to appreciate and encourage children's artistic endeavors.
With regular updates and new features, Animated Drawings offers endless possibilities for children to explore and create. Download the app now and unlock the magical world where drawings come to life, inspiring imagination and delighting young minds.
How to animate a drawing:
- Draw in the app, or upload your drawing or painted sample
- Select the appropriate size by cropping
- Pick the motion you want
- The drawing will become animated and you can download it or share in social media
Application features:
- Easy and simple interface
- Best Animated Drawings
- Draw in the app, or bring a drawing from paper
- Adjust and modify the movements you want on the drawings
- Ready models and animations
- A new Daily Challenge every day
- My Studio gallery, stars and a Sticker Book
- Several characters in one scene, with props and backgrounds
- Music and your own recorded voice
- The ability to download the animations as video
- Parent Zone for grown-ups

bluejetty:00123233:ios.description:
TaxSlayer takes the stress out of tax filing with step-by-step instructions and a 100% accuracy guarantee. Use your smartphone or any device to prepare your federal and state tax returns. Choose the tax filing option that’s right for you. Unlimited phone and email support are always included.
• File from any device - Mark taxes off your to-do list anytime, from anywhere. File your return on the go with your phone, tablet, laptop, or desktop.
• Prior year compare - Before you file, we check and provide year-over-year comparisons to ensure you get everything you deserve.
• Upload a return - Switching from another tax service is easy – upload your tax return, and we’ll import the data for you.
• Max refund guarantee - We guarantee you will receive the maximum refund you are entitled to, or we will refund you the applicable TaxSlayer purchase price paid.
• Unlimited Support - Get the help you need when you need it with unlimited phone and email support included. Want more? From Ask a Tax Pro to Audit Defense, we have you covered.
• Zero out-of-pocket fees - We offer you the option to deduct your TaxSlayer filing fees directly from your federal tax refund.
• Safe and secure - We take security seriously. Protecting your tax information when you’re filing and when you’re finished is our top priority, always.
**TaxSlayer Simply Free Features**
• Start, prepare, and file your federal tax return for free if you qualify.
• Fast, easy filing – Our best option for tax filers with simple situations, filing as single or married with a W-2 and no dependents.
• Education tax breaks - Max your refund with student loan interest deduction and education credits included.
**TaxSlayer Classic Features**
• All deductions & credits - Get all the tax breaks you deserve – children or dependents, homeowners, retirement income, interest, dividends, investments, and more.
• All income types - Tax filing for all tax situations – no forced upgrades or form restrictions. Everything you need included.
• IRS inquiry assistance - We will work with you to resolve IRS inquiries regarding your federal return for up to one year after the IRS accepts your e-file.
**TaxSlayer Premium Features**
• Priority support - Skip the line and get phone, email, and live chat support when you need it. Talk to a real person for convenient technical help to get through your return fast.
• Ask a Tax Pro - One-on-one help from a tax professional for your toughest tax questions. Unlimited personal guidance – file your return with the confidence you did it right.
• IRS audit assistance - Our trusted staff of enrolled agents (EAs) and IRS-certified experts are ready to assist you in the case of an IRS audit up to three years after the IRS accepts your e-file.
**TaxSlayer Self-Employed Features**
• 1099 & Schedule C support - Maximize your work expense deductions and receive 1099 income and Schedule C guidance. Get the peace of mind you deserve with unlimited phone, email, and live chat support.
• Ask a Self-Employment Tax Pro - If you’re self-employed, you know that your tax situation tends to be a little different. Talk to a tax professional with self-employed expertise for your most difficult questions.
• Tax payment reminders - Keep up with your tax payments all year and avoid unnecessary fees. Print payment vouchers in a few simple steps, then get back to business.

bluejetty:00061908:ios.description:
Developed to support students enrolled in ilearntoboat's Official Interactive Boating Safety Course, this app is the mobile companion to the web-based course.  
The ilearntoboat interactive course is built around a branching-narrative story called “The Mystery of Kalkomey Island” where you'll complete your boating safety education requirements by joining four friends as they embark on a boating adventure encountering storms, boat thieves, and a mysterious island.  
While completing the course, you'll make real-world boating decisions as you unlock a series of immersive, role player–learning activities timed to occur at relevant points as boating adventure story unfolds.   
Each learning activity is aligned to a specific student performance objective and features a robust learning engine that teaches, assesses, and provides remediation based on your input.   
This innovative approach to online education was developed using research in cognitive and behavioral science to create a highly motivational learning experience. 
  The ilearntoboat interactive course is the first and only interactive course that meets The National Association of State Boating Law Administrators (NASBLA) requirements for interactive learning aligned to the American National Standards Basic Boating Knowledge—Power.   
Course features: 
* No minimum time requirements
* Go as fast as you want! 
* Real-life situations 
* Role-playing simulations
* Earn achievements

bluejetty:00179006:ios.summary:

Arch
bluejetty:00179006:ios.description:
Archery Scoresheets lets you record scores, bow details, arrows details, sight marks for standard rounds as well as lets you create custom rounds. Analyze your performance on graphs, sign, print or email your scoresheets and much more
Archery Scoresheets app for the Archers, by the Archers
Download free, no adverts, no restrictions
Features:
Standard Rounds:
- Record scores for standard rounds, covering, WA, GNAS, USA, Australia and New Zealand
- Covers both Indoor and Outdoor rounds, Metric and Imperial
- 252 Awards Scheme
- Burntwood and WA VI rounds for visually impaired archers
Custom Rounds:
- Create custom rounds 
- Select Target, Shooting Type and Scoring Type
- Create single or multiple distances for the round (specifying Target size, Ends and Arrows per End)
Multiple Archers:
- Record scores together with family or friends
- Sign scoresheets
- View graphs 
- Email scoresheets to other archers and edit scores
- Supports up to four archers for a session
Classifications and Handicaps
- Archery GB Indoor and Outdoor Classifications and Handicaps 
- Handicap Tables
Scoring:
- Add scores by plotting arrows on Target Face
- Or add scores using colour coded keyboard
- If plotting arrows on target face
 - View graph of all arrows plotted
 - Filter arrow plots by distance or archer (for multi archer session)
Scoresheets:
- Sign scoresheet from within the app by both Archer and Target Captain
- Email scoresheets 
- Print scoresheets
- Share scoresheets or session graphs
- Upload photo of scoresheets for a session
Equipment
- Manage all your bows at one place
- Manage all your arrow types (e.g. Carbon, Aluminium)
- Create Sightmarks for a bow
- Create and save Locations where you shoot
Analysis:
- Analyze your scores on various graphs and see your personal best
- Complete Statistics of your sessions filtered by Round and Date
Tools:
- Classifications Calculator
- Handicaps Calculator
Filter:
- Search/Sort filter to list specific sessions
- Sort by Date, Points, Name (A..Z, Z..A)
- Filter by 
 - Bow Type
 - Standard, Custom, Favourite or Personal Best rounds
 - Indoor or Outdoor
 - With or Without Notes
 - Practice or Competition
 - Specific Round
ELITE Version:
- Scan Paper scoresheet: Scan your paper scoresheet with camera or select scoresheet photo from photo library and let the app read your hand written scores. App will read your hand written scoresheet and will give you the full scoresheet with totals of each end, running total, hits, golds and grand total.
- Best Arrows Selector: This feature lets you select the best arrows from your arrow set.
- Sightmarks Calculator: Calculate your sightmarks for various distances in meters and yards. If you have entered two sightmarks, app will calculate the sightmarks required for other distances to give you a good starting point.
- Compare Grouping Patterns: Select sessions you have entered by plotting on the target face and compare how groupings have changed over time.
- Delayed Video Feed: It helps you check your training form after you take a shot after a given delay in seconds.
- Grouping by Arrow Numbers: View grouping of arrows by arrow numbers. Archer can analyse their shots by filtering by each arrow number. If it is a multi archer round, then each archer can further filter either by All or by individual archer and their arrow number.
Other Features:
- Timer that can be used for competition or during practice session
- View summary for your sessions 
- Can edit score later
- View round details before choosing the round for practice
- Add Sessions you regularly shoot to Favourites
- Add notes for each session
- Add club location for session
- Help and FAQs (available from About screen)
We are constantly improving the app, if you like specific features, please do let us know and we make that a priority. Any feedback would be much appreciated.
Email: info@appshay.com
Terms of Use (EULA) 
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00120476:ios.description:
Play 5 different challenging puzzle games, match the shapes of the animals and cars, and drag the puzzle tiles to help Baby Shark find its way home!
"Baby Shark Jigsaw Puzzle Fun" is a free, fun puzzle matching game app for all players. 
Matching puzzles will help players develop their basic skills, including short-term memory and cognitive skills.
Choose your favorite Pinkfong Baby Shark illustration and difficulty level and dive right into this puzzle game journey!
App's Key Features:
CHOOSE HIGH-QUALITY PUZZLE BOARDS
- There are over 50 puzzle boards featuring illustrations of the Shark Family, Sea Animals, Cars, T-rex and more!
- Choose your favorite topic, ranging from Summer, Colors, Cooking, and Dinosaurs, and match the puzzle pieces.
- Choose your own difficulty level: from 4 pieces to 24 pieces.
GUESS THE ANIMALS
- Who's Hiding in the Jungle? Play hide-and-seek with Pinkfong's friends!
- Look at the silhouettes of the animals and guess who they are! Drag the images of the animals to match their shapes.
- There are other topics too: cars, toys, food, Christmas, and Halloween. Choose your favorite topic!
MATCH THE TILES & ROAD
- Match the tiles end-to-end to make a road. Help Baby Shark arrive at its destination.
- Matching games will help players develop their logical thinking and problem solving skills. 
COMPLETE THE SHAPES OF ANIMALS & VEHICLES
- What does a lion look like? What are the characteristics of a bunny? Drag each body part to complete the shape of each!
- Choose among different options: penguin, elephant, lion, police car, helicopter, and more!

bluejetty:00035779:ios.description:
My mission is to deliver a workout training log app that will help you make progress, build strength, and ensure hypertrophy, all that for free.
I will never change the free feature to a paid one, spam the paywall, limit routines or workout logs, etc. (all the bad stuff other workout trackers do).
What stands Strive apart:
- Create unlimited workout routines, most trackers paywall this
- Crate workout plans, assign workouts to days or in an order
- Share your workouts with your friends or followers - train together without paying
- Set weight or reps for the next workount and ensure progressive overload, go get those gains
- RIR/RPE tracking with effective reps metric
- Sync cardio and bodyweight with Health so you don't have to input the data manually
- Mark workouts as deloads to better understand and analyze the data
- Advanced charts without paywall, analyze routine, bodypart or exercise progress
- Fully offline - I know some gyms have poor reception
- Rest timer personalizeable per exercise
- Personalizable dashboard - Choose from many widgets in various sizes to compose your dashboard, just like your phone's homescreen. Have all the data visible at a glance!
- Placeholder exercise, select exercise category and bodypart or a group of exercises and then select the actual exercise when working out, based on the feelings or what's free at the gym
- Custom keyboard to input workout data frictionlessly, allows to copy value from previous set, set value to all sets, and increment and decrement value 
- Wrapped, see your year in review at the end of the year
- Themes & theme creator
- Privacy first - no data tracking 
- No ads
Rest of the features that you would expect:
- Measurements and weight ins
- Notes
- Backup - never loos your data
- Prs
- Use all the set types, warmup, dropset, myo reps etc
- Workout finish reminder - never again open an app to see that you have not saved the previous training
- Dark mode
- Exercise database
I hope my app will help you achieve your goals, in general, just progress and get better. 
I promise to develop this app until it is your favorite gym log and workout tracker app.
Remember, we all are gonna make it!
Your gym bro, Artur.

bluejetty:00063375:ios.name: Flight Simulator FlyWings 2014
bluejetty:00063375:ios.summary:
FlyWings Flight Simulator 2014 is the most advanced simulation already developed for iOS. 
We have been improving the physics for years, and finally we are proud to announce our flight simulator! 
Prepare for the real experience of flying
bluejetty:00063375:ios.description:
FlyWings Flight Simulator 2014 is the most advanced simulation already developed for iOS. 
We have been improving the physics for years, and finally we are proud to announce our flight simulator! 
Prepare for the real experience of flying a aircraft over New York city! 
Choose one of the most famous airports in the world and fly with more than 16 aircraft, over 400 different missions! 
The game also simulates weather conditions, with clear sky, thunderstorms, turbulence and more! 
Become a Airliner Pilot, freelance pilot, military skilled pilot or a acrobatic pilot! Your choice! 
We created 4 separate sets of planes: 
- learning aircraft 
- commercial aircraft 
- cargo and transportation aircraft 
- military jets 
Here is some planes you can choose: 
- Boing 747-400 
- Boing 757 
- Boing 707 
- Arbus A320 
- Cezna 172 
- Beech Musketeer 
- Leerjet 60 xr 
- Antonov Av-12 
- Antonov Av-24 
- British Aerospace BAE 147 
- F-18 
- F-22 
- MIG-29 
- SU-35 
- Antonov Av-24 Militar 
- NEW!!! Endeavour Space Shuttle
And also, we created the 8 detailed airports in New York City 
- La Guardia international Airport (LGA) 
- John F Kennedy International Airport (JFK) 
- Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) 
- Essex County Airport (CDW) 
- Morristown Municipal Airport (MMU) 
- Lincoln Park Airport (N07) 
- Teterboro Airport (TEB) 
- Linden Airport (LDJ) 
FEATURES: 
- 16 aircraft 
- 400 missions 
- Exclusive missions depending on your aircraft! 
- Military Jet exclusive missions 
- Detailed airports 
- Detailed world, with threes, buildings, clouds, water and ocean. 
- Functional instruments. 
- 2 types of controls: Accelerometer or touch to control the aircraft. 
- Dynamic instruments 
Some technology provided by Nasa: 
- Realist terrain using Nasa’s photos and elevation. 
- Using Nasa’s utility FoilSim 3 to calculate the physics of the airplane (really realistic). 
- Using real airfoils from our library in the aircrafts, like NACA airfoils and BAC airfoils. 
Real world simulation: 
- Weather forecast (clear sky, some clouds, raining and storms) 
- Turbulence and G-Force 
- Real clouds 
- Crashes and fire on engines. 
We are thinking everything we can to improve the flight simulator experience! So please, feel free to contact us to give your feedback! 
Have a nice flight pilot!
Link for the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://www.thetisgames.com/p/thetis-games-privacy-policy-effective.html

bluejetty:00089104:ios.description:
Welcome to GoDiary, your ultimate fitness companion. Unlike other fitness apps, GoDiary doesn't require manual start and stop for activities. Just take your phone along on your workout, and it will automatically detect your Runs, Rides, and Walks. Skeptical? Try it out and prepare to be impressed!
**Effortless Activity Tracking** Our state-of-the-art technology automatically recognizes your runs, walks, and rides. With no user input required, you can focus on your workout while we take care of the tracking.
**Comprehensive Activity List** Easily view all your activities in one place. Whether it’s a morning jog or an evening ride, every workout is logged for your convenience.
**Customizable Views** Track your workout progress with our intuitive display, segmented by week, month, year, or all-time. It's fitness tracking that adapts to your schedule.
**Goal-Oriented Approach** Set and monitor weekly, monthly, or yearly goals. Our goal screen not only sets targets but also keeps you motivated by showing how close you are to achieving them.
**Live Activity Status** See your current activity live on the status screen. GoDiary will automatically start recording your activities. While you are exercising, the Status screen displays the state of your run, ride, or walk. Have confidence that GoDiary is working by navigating to the Status screen.
**Route Mapping** Visualize your journey with detailed maps, providing a clear overview of your entire route.
**Rich Data Display** Delve into extensive data about each activity - distance covered, duration, average pace, elevation gain, calories burned, and more.
**Split Analysis & Elevation Graph** Break down your performance with split analysis and understand your elevation gains over time through an insightful graph.
**Unlock Full Potential with GoDiary Premium**
GoDiary is a freemium app offering two subscription models – monthly and annual – to unlock full access to all data and features.
Subscribers enjoy comprehensive insights, detailed data analysis, and personalized goals tracking to maximize their fitness journey.
GoDiary isn’t just an app; it’s a partner in your fitness journey. From casual strolls to intensive training sessions, it’s designed for every step, ride, and stride. Elevate your fitness experience - download GoDiary today and embark on a journey towards a healthier, more active lifestyle.

bluejetty:00027672:ios.name: twinme private messenger
bluejetty:00027672:ios.summary:
twinme is a free secure instant messaging and High-Definition voice/video call application, protecting your privacy and giving you full control over each of your relationships and contents.
WHY USE TWINME:
. PRIVACY BY DESIGN: twinme does
bluejetty:00027672:ios.description:
twinme is a free secure instant messaging and High-Definition voice/video call application, protecting your privacy and giving you full control over each of your relationships and contents.
WHY USE TWINME:
. PRIVACY BY DESIGN: twinme doesn’t ask, store, or use any of your personal data. You do not need to subscribe and provide any personal information to use twinme.
twinme is about the only messaging app that does not use your phone number (no email address or social network ID either), and that does not snoop into your address book to suck your contacts’ phone number and other private information.
. PERSONALIZED CONTACTS: you can choose what you disclose about yourself to each of your twinme contact individually: your name, your image, which you can change at any time. You control how each of your contacts can reach you (or not). Since your contact information is personal to each of your contacts, it cannot be transferred to nor used by anyone else. You are in full control, whether you interact with a close friend or a complete stranger.
. PRIVATE CONVERSATIONS: all conversations happen in peer-to-peer with no relay server storing contents in-between devices. Data exchanged always stay within devices. Messages and voice/video calls are end-to-end encrypted . You clear all messages of a conversation on both ends simultaneously in one tap.
. FAST MESSAGING AND HIGH DEFINITION VOICE/VIDEO CALLS: twinme peer-to-peer message transfers are instantaneous when both ends have an active data connection.
twinme voice and video calls leverage the latest state-of-the-art real-time multimedia protocols and codecs that adapt to device configurations and changing network conditions to provide the highest quality voice and video definition achievable on the market today.
. FREE WITH NO ADVERTISING: since twinme does not access any of yours or your contacts personal information, it cannot be used for commercial purposes. Unlike most other messaging apps, you are not a product.
. INTERACT ONLINE LIKE IN REAL LIFE: you are free to decide with whom, when and how you interact. 
Have one of your profiles’ invitation twincodes (QR-Code) scanned by a friend next to you or someone you just met, or send it by text, email or any other means to a family away, or post it to your website or tweet it to your followers: you decide.
If you don’t want to continue a relationship any further just remove it from your twinme contact list, and he/she cannot reach you anymore: no unsolicited call, no harassment, no spam are possible with twinme.
. IDEAL FOR KIDS: twinme helps you turn any tablet into a safe communication device for children. Without a phone number, your kid cannot discover or be discovered on line by unknown people. The only contacts allowed are those met in person (family and friends) that can flash the kid profile twincode (QR-code) with their device. Parents feel comfortable and kids can enjoy their first grownup social app safely.
. UNIQUE TECHNOLOGY: twinme extends the WebRTC open source technology (the new standard for secure real-time peer-to-peer multimedia exchanges on the web) with its unique twincode relationships model to provide the most disruptive communications services on the market today.
twinme uses your device Internet connection (WiFi or 3G/4G/LTE as available). Data charges may therefore apply. Check your carrier for details.
PERMISSIONS: 
. “Camera” & “Microphone” to take pictures, make voice/video calls 
. "Photos" for profiles and to send/receive photos in messages
. "Notifications" to be notified of calls and messages
. "Background App Refresh" to receive calls and messages while app sleeps in the background
. "Mobile Data" to be able to make and receive calls and exchange messages

bluejetty:00024711:ios.summary: Embark on an extraordinary visual journey into a realm of artistic wonders with Infinity Hunt, the captivating mobile game that will challenge your observation skills like never before. Prepare to immerse yourself in a mesmerizing world whe
bluejetty:00024711:ios.description:
Embark on an extraordinary visual journey into a realm of artistic wonders with Infinity Hunt, the captivating mobile game that will challenge your observation skills like never before. Prepare to immerse yourself in a mesmerizing world where hidden objects are concealed within multi-dimensional masterpieces, waiting to be discovered with each breathtaking zoom in.
Infinity Hunt takes the concept of hidden object and search games to exhilarating new heights, offering an innovative gameplay experience that will keep you on a captivating object hunt for hours on end. As you dive into the immersive depths of this enchanting universe, you'll find yourself exploring a plethora of vibrant and intricately designed artworks, each teeming with the potential to uncover a wealth of hidden treasures.
The core mechanic of the game revolves around the concept of infinite zoom. With a simple gesture, you can zoom in and out of the captivating artwork, unravel its secrets layer by layer and find the object. As you zoom in, the image reveals hidden pictures and bright elements previously concealed from the naked eye. It's a scavenger hunt unlike any other, where every zoom in brings you closer to the bright objects that lie within.
Prepare to be astounded by the artistic prowess that manifests in every brushstroke and detail. Infinity Hunt has crafted a collection of stunning visuals, ensuring that each artwork is a masterpiece in itself. Whether you find yourself amidst a hidden city, a lush forest, or a cosmic landscape, the attention to detail and vibrant color palettes will transport you to worlds beyond your imagination.
Hidden objects are cleverly concealed within the depths of these artistic tapestries. From minute details woven into the scenery to bright objects that catch the eye, the challenge lies in spotting them amidst the intricate chaos of the image. It's an object hunt that demands both focus and visual acuity as you explore each breathtaking panorama and find the object. With each discovered object, the thrill of accomplishment surges through you, and the words "found it" become a triumphant mantra.
Infinity Hunt goes beyond the traditional realm of hidden object games, offering a variety of engaging gameplay modes to keep your senses sharp. Delve into the realm of hidden pictures, where you must identify bright objects scattered throughout the scene. Or test your discerning eye with different challenges, where subtle variations hide within the seemingly identical artwork. The game seamlessly blends these interactive elements into a scavenger hunt, providing endless hours of entertainment for players of all ages.
Embark on an epic scavenger hunt that will push the boundaries of your perception. With Infinity Hunt, you'll unlock a world of breathtaking visuals and intricate puzzles, all wrapped into a single search game. Whether you're a casual gamer seeking a momentary escape or a dedicated aficionado of find object games, this title offers an immersive adventure that will leave you wanting more.
So, grab your magnifying glass and prepare to embark on a visual extravaganza like no other. With Infinity Hunt, the infinite zoom awaits, and the hidden objects beckon. Unleash your inner detective and lose yourself in the depths of these zoom out 3D artworks. It's time to embark on a journey to a hidden city where art and gameplay intertwine, where every zoom in is an invitation to uncover the hidden bright objects that lie within. Get ready to explore the unexplored, discover the undiscovered, and become a master of the infinite zoom! Found it!

bluejetty:00167121:ios.description:
Experience the all-new Explore.org app, completely redesigned based on user feedback to bring you the best in live nature cams, wildlife streaming, and educational films. 
Whether you’re an animal lover, a nature enthusiast, or simply curious about the world, our philanthropic mission, powered by the Annenberg Foundation, inspires you to connect deeply with the planet’s most captivating habitats.
What’s New?
• Revamped Interface & Faster Performance: Navigate effortlessly through our live webcams and nature documentaries with an improved layout and quicker load times.
• Enhanced Search & Filtering: Use our wildlife exploration categories to find animal cams featuring everything from bird watching to underwater cameras in a snap.
• Personalized Favorites: Save your most-watched live nature cams and get easy access to them anytime.
• Community Sharing: Share your favorite wildlife streaming highlights via email, Facebook, or Twitter to inspire others.
• Improved Accessibility: We’ve fine-tuned the app to ensure everyone can explore the wonders of nature with ease.
Features

bluejetty:00030406:ios.description:
مخمخ هو تطبيق للعبة كويتية مناسبة لأي مجموعة من الأهل والاصدقاء في التجمعات والدواوين الذين يبحثون عن وسيلة للترفيه، اختبار المعلومات، تحدي بعضهم البعض وإضافة المتعة إلى أي تجمّع ممل.
 مخمخ هي لعبة معلومات يمكن عرضها لأي جمهور على الهاتف أو تابلِت أو جهاز كمبيوتر. يُسمح للمستخدم بِعرض الالعاب على شاشة بروجكتر باستخدام Apple TV أو وصلة كيبل.
يمكن لمستخدمي مخمخ اختبار معلوماتهم في العديد من الفئات مثل المعلومات العامة، الجغرافيا، الرياضه العربيّه والعالميه، الأفلام والمسلسلات العربية والاجنبية، وغيرها من الفئات المختلفه، من قاعدة بيانات تحتوي على ما يزيد عن ٥٠٠٠ سؤال تم اختيارهم بدقّه.
يتيح التطبيق لمستخدميه اختيار مايصل إلى ٦ فئات مختلفة لكل لعبة، تغيير مستوى صعوبة الاسئلة، واختيار المؤثرات الصوتية لإضافة طابع فكاهي اثناء اللعب في حال الفوز والخسارة، كل ذلك في أقل من دقيقة! ويمكن للمستخدم الاحتفاظ بالألعاب التي سبق استخدامها وإعادة استخدامها في أي تجمع آخر ولعدد لا نهائي من المرات.
معلومات الشراء داخل التطبيق:
- لكل مستخدم لعبة مجانية للبدء بها، ويحدد المستخدم الفئات المناسبة للتجمع.
- بعد استخدام اللعبة المجانية، كل لعبة اضافة اضافيّه تكلف المستخدم ٣ دينار كويتي.
- يمكن للمستخدم شراء باقات تحتوي على عدة ألعاب بسعر مخفّض.
- يمكن للمستخدم اعادة شحن المحفظه بالمبلغ المناسب لشراء وانشاء الالعاب في أي وقت.
‏Mkhmkh is a Kuwaiti trivia game application that can be easily hosted for any audience on a phone, a tablet or a computer. It allows the user to display games on a screen or projector using Apple TV or a cable.
‏Mkhmkh is the perfect choice for any group of friends/family members who seek a way to have fun, test their knowledge, challenge one another, and add excitement to any dull gathering.
‏Mkhmkh users can create trivia games to test their knowledge on various categories of their choice including general knowledge, geography, sports, movies, TV series and many more from a database that contains +5000 carefully selected questions.
‏The application allows its users to choose up to 6 categories per game, choose the difficulty of the questions, and choose the winning and losing audios for each game, all of that in less than a minute! Users can also keep previously played games and reuse them at any other occasion for unlimited times.
‏IN APP PURCHASE INFORMATION
‏- Each user has a free game to start with, and gets to select the categories they enjoy.
‏- After using the free game, each additional game will cost the user 3 KWD.
‏- The user can purchase bundles to obtain games for a lower price.
‏- The user can recharge their wallet with the desired amount to purchase and create games at any time.

bluejetty:00123128:ios.description:
Welcome to SAB Mobile - Saudi Awwal Bank Digital Banking Application!
Enjoy the ease, privacy and convenience of online personal banking anywhere and anytime with SAB Mobile by Saudi Awwal Bank.
Manage your finances, track your spending, transfer funds, explore and apply for our banking products and enjoy many other services, all within one app. 
To benefit from the app, register or log in using any of the several logging-in methods provided by SAB.
SAB Mobile allows you to benefit from many services, including:
Account services: 
• View and manage your accounts 
• Open new current and saving accounts
• Request and download your digital banking documents
• Download your e-statements 
• Share your IBAN
SAB Banking Products:
• Apply for the best Credit Card for you
• Apply for Home Finance 
• Apply for Personal financing
SAB 360° Services to manage your finances:
• Track your spending
• Build and manage your budgets
• Create hashtags to manage your spending 
• Manage your spending through the Cash Wallet
Bill payment/ Government Services:
• Add, manage and Pay your bills 
• Pay your traffic fines
• Pay your government services fees
• Pay Esal Payments
• Bulk Bill Payment 
Transfers: 
• Add, activate and manage beneficiaries
• Transfer funds between your own SAB accounts 
• Transfer to any other SAB account
• Perform local and international transfers
• Mobile Wallet transfers and Cash Out services
• Register in instant transfer service and manage your Aliases 
• Schedule future transfers
Card services:
• SAB Aqsat program
• Apply for Supplementary Card
• Apply for Umlaty Card
• Issue and view Virtual Cards 
• Pay Credit Card
• Control the Online Payments Limit
• Provision your cards into Apple Pay wallet
SAB Loyalty Program: 
• View your points summary
• Redeem points and Cashback services 
• View your earned Qitaf points, Fursan miles and Emirates miles 
Different log-in Methods: 
• Username, Password and OTP
• Face ID, Touch ID
• Quick Access Pin
• Digital Secure Key
Other assistive services: 
• SAB Chat service for instant conversations with customer service representatives 
• SAB Bot service to answer your inquiries about SAB products and services
• Messages and complaints service that allows you to inquire about the services provided to you and raise your complaints to be handled by our team 
SAB Mobile introduces an all-new dashboards concept - a more interactive experience, designed to meet all of your personal banking needs. 
• Main Dashboard, where you can access your financials and view your cash holding and debt in addition to different category notifications. 
• Account Dashboard, where you can view all your transactions, access your statements, and share your IBAN.
• Bills and Payments Dashboard, where you can manage all your bills, including SADAD bills.
• SAB 360° Dashboard, where you can view your overall spend, your budget, your tags and cash wallet.
