bluejetty:00078252:ios.description:
The Almeida Bible (JFA) is one of the most trusted Portuguese translations, known for its accuracy and strong linguistic foundation. It has been widely used by generations of believers, offering a faithful representation of the original Scriptures.
Today, the JFA Bible continues to support daily reading, study, and worship, helping individuals deepen their understanding of God’s Word. It remains a reliable and respected choice for those seeking clarity, tradition, and spiritual growth in the Portuguese language.
Features -
Daily Verse: Set reminders to receive daily Bible verse notifications.
MY LIBRARY: Access your highlighted verses, notes, and bookmarked Scriptures in one place.
Old & New Testaments: Read both the Old and New Testaments within one app.
Verse Editor: Create beautiful Bible verse posts using different backgrounds and share them with others.
Nearby Churches: Discover churches near your location.
Books: Explore a collection of Christian eBooks.
Wallpapers: Browse a beautiful collection of inspiring wallpapers.
Videos: Watch videos on Jesus, hope, wisdom, motivation, gratitude, healing, and more.
Festive Calendar: Explore Christian festivals and feast days.
Popular Verse: Discover Bible verses by topics such as love, fear, peace, and more.
Customise Your Bible: Personalise your reading experience by adjusting fonts and text colours.
1000 Praises: Explore a devotional collection celebrating God's names and attributes.
Bible Quotes: Share Bible quotes in both image and text formats.
Bible Quiz: Test your knowledge of the Bible through engaging quizzes.
Bible Stories: Explore timeless and inspiring Bible stories for readers of all ages.
Help Desk: Submit support requests and attach photos to provide additional details.
Dictionary: Explore a searchable, Bible-based dictionary for easy reference.
Dream Meanings: Discover Biblical and Christian perspectives on dream meanings.
Word Highlights: Highlight specific words or letters for deeper reflection.
App Activity: Track your reading streaks, time spent, refreshes, and overall app usage.
Search: Quickly find Bible verses, chapters, and topics.
Products: Explore Bible-related products available within the app.
VerseBot: Get AI-powered explanations of Bible verses with convenient copying and sharing options.
Bible Verse Clips: Enjoy short, inspirational Bible clips shared by the community.
Prayer Request: Submit prayer requests and receive support from the community.
Nearby Events: Discover Christian events and gatherings near your location.
Chapter-Wise Video Learning: Watch videos that help you gain a deeper understanding of individual Bible chapters.
Bible Clips: Watch short, inspiring Biblical clips shared by the faith community.
Bible Streaks: Maintain your daily Bible reading streak and build consistency in Scripture reading.
Mark as Read – Quiz: Take quizzes based on the Bible verses you have read.
Audio Bible – Speed Control: Adjust audio playback speed to listen faster or slower according to your preference.
Worship Songs: Praise God and strengthen your connection with Him through uplifting worship songs and lyrics.
Audio Bible Experience: Listen to reading plans with text-to-speech narration and soulful background music.
Fasting Tracker: Track your fasting days, maintain spiritual discipline, and stay consistent with your fasting and prayer commitments.
Church Fathers: Submit prayer requests, discover nearby events, and explore upcoming events to stay connected with your faith community.
Journey Tracker: Follow your spiritual journey, monitor your progress, and build consistent habits in Bible reading, prayer, and faith.
Character Explorer: Discover Bible characters, explore their stories, and learn valuable lessons from their faith, challenges, and experiences.

bluejetty:00132008:ios.summary:

Here’s h
bluejetty:00132008:ios.description:
Sheiko Gold is a highly advanced training tool designed primarily for powerlifters and strength athletes. This app takes the principles of the well-known Sheiko powerlifting programs and enhances them with real-time customization.
Here’s how it works:
1. Personalized Training Programs: Sheiko Gold uses an initial 30-day observation period to gather data on how you respond to different training loads, exercises, and recovery periods. After this period, the app begins to create highly individualized training programs that adapt to your specific needs, aiming for sustainable long-term progress.
2. Real-Time Adjustments: Unlike static programs, Sheiko Gold adjusts your workout intensity and volume in real-time based on your readiness and feedback. This includes modifications to rest intervals, exercise selection, and load management to optimize performance while minimizing the risk of injury.
3. Advanced Features: The app incorporates several innovative features, such as velocity-based training (VBT) using the VELOS-ID barbell tracker. This allows Sheiko Gold to make even more precise adjustments during workouts based on the speed of your lifts, further personalizing the training experience.
4. Flexible and Responsive: The app is designed to be used in real-time. You can adjust your training schedule on the fly, and Sheiko Gold will recalibrate your program accordingly. This flexibility is ideal for lifters with unpredictable schedules or those who want to tailor their training to daily readiness levels.
5. Support for Various Goals: Whether you’re aiming to get stronger, improve technique, build muscle, or prepare for a competition, Sheiko Gold has tailored options. It can even guide you through off-season training or help you peak for a specific date, ensuring you’re at your best when it matters most.
Overall, Sheiko Gold stands out as a cutting-edge tool for serious lifters, combining the expertise of Sheiko training with modern technology to deliver a truly customized training experience. It’s particularly beneficial for those who appreciate detailed programming and real-time feedback that aligns with their performance and recovery needs .
HEALTH
Sheiko Gold also uses Apple’s Health app to read heart rate data so you can monitor your recovery between sets. 
SUBSCRIPTIONS
The Basic Subscription is available for $19.99/month, $89.99/6 months, or $119.99/year (prices may vary by territory) within the Sheiko Gold app.
You can subscribe and pay through your iTunes account. Payment will be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renew may be turned off after purchase by going to the 'Manage Subscription' page in settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. The subscription will renew at the same cost.
Privacy and terms: https://sheikogold.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00159791:ios.description:
No wearable required. Measure your HRV with just your iPhone camera — or connect Apple Watch, Polar, or Garmin, etc — and see how rested you actually are this morning.
Some mornings you wake up sharp. Some you don’t. Healthye reads your heart rate and HRV to show you why — how last night’s sleep landed, how stress is adding up, and whether today is a day to lean in or take it easy.
For anyone who’s tired of guessing why they feel the way they do.
WHAT YOU GET
A simple morning number for how rested you are, a trend you can follow over weeks, and the connections between them — no charts to decode, no jargon to learn.
DAILY INSIGHTS & MONITORING
• One-minute check-in: Measure with your camera, right after you wake up.
• Apple Health: Seamless integration.
• Visual Trends: Energy, balance, and recovery at a glance.
• Context Matters: Log sleep, stress, alcohol, workouts — and see what actually moves the needle for you.
• Long-term Tracking: Daily and weekly summaries in plain language.
PERSONALIZED GUIDANCE
• Trend Alerts: Know when your weekly baseline shifts.
• Tailored Insights: Practical suggestions based on your own data.
REPORTS & EXPORT
Review your full history with detailed reports. Export to PDF to share with your doctor, coach, or anyone helping you feel better.
PRIVACY FIRST
Your measurements are stored on your device.
Our mission is to help you understand your body and feel your best.
By using the app, you agree to our:
• Terms of Use: https://healthye.app/terms
• Privacy Policy: https://healthye.app/privacy
• Data Deletion Info: https://healthye.app/deletion
SUPPORT
Contact us: support@healthye.app
Website: https://healthye.app
NOTE
Healthye is intended for general wellness and informational purposes only. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment. Always consult a healthcare professional for any medical concerns.

bluejetty:00175001:ios.name: SailFlow: Sailing Forecasts
bluejetty:00175001:ios.summary:
Whether you’re racing, cruising, day sailing, you need precise sailing forecasts and real-time wind. SailFlow delivers both.
Powered by 90,000+ exclusive Tempest Weather Stations and 150,000+ total sources, SailFlow’s weather and wind app
bluejetty:00175001:ios.description:
Whether you’re racing, cruising, day sailing, you need precise sailing forecasts and real-time wind. SailFlow delivers both.
Powered by 90,000+ exclusive Tempest Weather Stations and 150,000+ total sources, SailFlow’s weather and wind app delivers unmatched accuracy. With stations on buoys, piers, and key waterfront locations, you get real conditions exactly where you sail.
Plan with confidence using our Tempest Rapid Refresh Model combined with government data to deliver industry-leading Nearcast AI predictions. Then go deeper with radar, high-resolution forecast maps, and fully customizable alerts so you never miss a session.
Real wind. Better sails.
- Coastal observations from proprietary Tempest Weather Systems along with all public domain marine forecasts and reports (NOAA, NWS, METAR, ASOS, CWOP) including all major airports creating over 150,000 unique stations.
- Exclusive Tempest Weather Systems deployed at key coastal locations report wind, rain, barometric pressure and more than 24 other weather observations. 
- Apple Watch compatibility
- Live wind from our stations support powerful wind flow visualization – augmented by current station reports with advanced quality control.
- Our Proprietary AI-enhanced Nearcast provides enhanced forecasting for temperature, wind gust, speed, direction, humidity, dewpoint, precipitation rate, probability of precipitation, and cloud cover percentage which is perfect for sailing.
- Public domain forecast models including High Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR), North American Mesoscale Forecast System (NAM), Global Forecast System (GFS), Canadian Meteorological Centre Model (CMC) and Icosahedral Non Hydrostatic Model (ICON).
- Create your own favorite station list to keep an eye on your go-to weather stations at all your marine and sailing spots. Check the tides in minutes so you never miss a day on the water.
- Maps: Live and Forecasted Wind Map, Forecasted Temperature, Radar, Satellite, Precipitation and Clouds, as well as Nautical Charts.
- Free subscription for unlimited wind notifications/alerts with customizable thresholds to email, text, or in-app.
- Monitor National Weather Service (NWS) Marine forecasts, high surf warnings, and other to better anticipate waves and current conditions, for safer, more informed decisions on the water. 
Additional weather parameters:
 - Tides charts
 - Wave height, wave period
 - Water temperature
 - Sunrise / sunset
 - Moonrise / moonset
 - Historical wind statistics
 - Windy days per month
 - Wind direction distribution
Go Beyond the Basics: Upgrade to Plus, Pro, or Gold membership to gain access to more weather stations, ad-free browsing, and more.
- Access exclusive Pro and hurricane-proof stations at premier coastal locations and unlock SailFlow’s hyper-accurate Pro forecasts, updated daily by expert meteorologists for sailing hotspots coast to coast.
- Detailed weather at points of interest to coastal residents and property owners near the ocean, rivers, and other bodies of water.
On the water features:
 - Sea surface temperatures
 - Sea surface currents
 - Detailed historical wind statistics
 - Historical wind speed average by year
Does your spot need a station? Join the Tempest Weather Network!
Get a Tempest Weather System for your club, dock, or backyard.

bluejetty:00186320:ios.name: Piano Academy by Yokee Music
bluejetty:00186320:ios.summary:
The fastest and most fun way to learn to play the piano!
Piano Academy is for anyone looking to learn the piano from scratch or those who have prior knowledge and want to continue learning by practicing playing along with their favorite so
bluejetty:00186320:ios.description:
The fastest and most fun way to learn to play the piano!
Piano Academy is for anyone looking to learn the piano from scratch or those who have prior knowledge and want to continue learning by practicing playing along with their favorite songs.
Piano Academy offers an on-screen touch keyboard so you can start playing immediately. The app also supports MIDI connection, and it can even detect the notes you play if you have an acoustic or electronic piano.
MAIN FEATURES
- Watch tutorial videos introduced to you by your private instructor, teaching you theory topics like notes, the staff, chords, and much more.
- The app listens to every note you play and gives you instant feedback, so you know how to improve.
- Practice playing tons of great tunes by reading real sheet music.
- Play fun games to train your musical hearing, hand coordination, and sense of rhythm.
WHO IS IT FOR?
Piano Academy is suitable for all ages, from kids to adults.
We have designed and built this app from the very beginning to help transform even complete beginners into actual pianists.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
We will teach you how to read notes, so you'll be able to play while reading sheet music. You'll play tons of wonderful classical pieces, as well as contemporary hit songs on your own.
As you progress, you'll learn to play with both hands, play chords, and much more.
Theory topics are introduced to you by your private instructor with the aid of animations and walk-through videos.
You will play fun games designed to train your senses, such as musical hearing, hand-coordination, and your sense of rhythm, among other skills.
And the crowning glory is our staff player that shows music notes as you see in real sheet music. The notes are perfectly synced with the background music that will accompany you while playing. The app listens to every note you play and gives you instant feedback, so you know whether you hit the correct note at the right time.
BOTTOM LINE, you're going to have an enriching, rewarding, and challenging experience, and you're going to love it!
UNLIMITED PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all features and content offered within Piano Academy.
- Watch all premium tutorials, play all premium games, and practice any of the songs, including premium songs, as much as you like from any Apple device and enjoy an ad-free experience.
- Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected, depending on the subscription plan.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period and identify the renewal cost.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.
- Private Policy - https://www.pianoacademy.app/privacy-policy/
- Terms of Use - https://www.pianoacademy.app/terms-of-use/
ABOUT YOKEE
Yokee Music is the creator of Yokee™, the world's #1 ranked sing-along mobile app, with over 100 million users and the creator of Piano by Yokee, the most successful piano app game available in its genre.
If you're having any issues with the app, please don't hesitate to contact our support team at support@pianoacademy.app
Also, please join the Piano Academy community on Facebook and let us know what you think: https://www.facebook.com/groups/PianoAcademyCommunity/

bluejetty:00014566:ios.name: PDFOptim
bluejetty:00014566:ios.summary: PDFOptim is a simple and intuitive way to compress, optimize and reduce PDF documents on iPhones and iPads. PDFOptim provides easy and effective ways to compress large image and graphics heavy PDF files. Inbuilt side-by-side preview to comp
bluejetty:00014566:ios.description:
PDFOptim is a simple and intuitive way to compress, optimize and reduce PDF documents on iPhones and iPads. PDFOptim provides easy and effective ways to compress large image and graphics heavy PDF files. Inbuilt side-by-side preview to compare original and compressed PDF.
* * * PDFOptim for Mac is also available on the Mac App Store. * * *
Compressed PDF documents requires less disk space for storage and faster uploads and downloads saves transmission time and cost. PDFOptim rewrites the entire PDF documents using selected compression options as efficiently as possible without compromising the document's integrity.
If your PDF documents are in another app (For Example Mail, DropBox or SkyDrive etc.) that uses the Open In… button, tap the button to open the PDF document in PDFOptim. You can also transfer PDF documents from your desktop computer via iTunes into PDFOptim application on your iPhone or iPad.
KEY FEATURES:
AUTO COMPRESSION MODE 
- PDFOptim analyze document’s contents and apply algorithm to generate a smallest possible PDF by maintaining the document’s visual quality. Choose one of the four predefined Auto compression methods and let the app do the hard work for you. No further user interaction required to provide technical compression options.
MANUAL COMPRESSION MODE 
- Change compression options manually to generate optimum sized PDF of your need. You can choose compression options to set from Image Color Model, Image Resolution, JPEG Image Quality, Optimise vector graphics level and Advance option.
- Image color model to choose from RGB, Gray and Mono. Selecting Monochrome color model option converts raster PDF contents into black and white which helps reduces PDF file size to greater extent. It is very helpful when compressing scanned books mainly containing text.
- Image resolution ppi (pixels/inch) control to resize raster image contents. Downsampling at lower resolution decrease the file size dramatically.
- Quality control. Set quality from lossless to least for resampling all raster images into PDF. It allows you to control compressed PDF size and viewing quality.
-Advance options to remove PDF content properties like alternate images, page thumbnails, documents structure hierarchy and output intent.
- Optimize vector graphics option removes superfluous information to reduce vector graphics heavy PDF. Increase in optimize vector from 'Level 1' to 'Level 5' reduces output PDF file size less to more respectively. 
This option is very useful when PDF content mainly consist of high precision vector graphics, Usually PDF drawing, note-taking and PDF markup apps creates large vector graphics heavy PDF files which can be compressed by this option efficiently.
- Password protected PDF documents supported for compression using correct password.
- Single or multiple compressed PDFs can be shared as single ZIP (*.zip) file.
- Allows Compressed PDFs to Open In… another application, Mail, Message, Print, share PDFs to nearby iOS devices via AirDrop.
- Use Copy to iTunes to save and share compressed PDFs on your desktop computer.
PDF VIEWER:
- Inbuilt PDF viewer with fully selectable and searchable text contents. Select and copy text to clipboard for further use.
- Pinch out and Pinch in to ZoomIn and ZoomOut view and search feature to find a character, word and sentence.
- Scroll through your document by thumbnail view or Go to page feature.
Note: PDFOptim is standalone application running natively to compress PDF documents securely on your iOS device.
You can refer User Manual for any assistance Or Contact Support.
*The free version has limitation to export one compressed PDF per week. Get Premium to remove all restrictions and start exporting an unlimited number of compressed PDFs.
Privacy Policy: http://rootrisetech.com/pdfoptim-privacy-policy
Terms of Use(EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

AI POWERED TEMPLATES:
Powered by AI, eZy Watermark introduces adaptive templates that intelligently adjust watermarks across videos, delivering a consistent and refined batch watermarking experience.

SNAP TO GRID:

We make it easy to import videos from your camera, library, or capture a new video directly from camera. Save your edited videos with stylish watermarks to your gallery or share them instantly on Instagram, Pinterest, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, or Google Drive! bluejetty:00112186:android.summary:

The full Nation
bluejetty:00112186:android.description:
NOTE: Please read the full description before assigning a low rating and referencing something the app specifically states it does not do.
Live Data : Game scoring data updates every 30 seconds while games are in progress.
The full National Football League (NFL) schedule (preseason, regular season and postseason) for each week and all 32 teams styled in the colors of your favorite team. Easy, tabbed navigation to weekly schedules, team schedules, a bye week schedule and schedules for the Thursday, Sunday and Monday night games as well as overall standings by conference and division.
Game schedules provide both summary and detail views. Game data includes team records (overall, home and away), won/loss streak, scores, scoring by quarter (detail view) and game status (detail view).
This football schedule and scoring app is free and without ads. Effort has been spent to make it fast and a relatively small install. It requires the minimum permissions necessary to refresh data over the internet.
LIVE APP DATA
• Data updates are retrieved every 30 seconds while games are in progress.
• Data updates occur if the device is on and the app is in the foreground.
• Data is not pushed to the app. It retrieves data when in the foreground.
• Feature updates will continue to be delivered via Play store releases.
DISCLAIMERS
• Not affiliated with, nor endorsed by, the National Football League (NFL).
• The app does not track any data about you or your device.
PERMISSIONS
• Requires the minimum necessary to retrieve data updates over the internet.
• Can be installed to SD card.
NAVIGATION TIPS
• Tabbed navigation...no 'back button' use. 'Back button' will prompt to exit.
• When viewing week tab, after navigating away from current week, tap week tab again to re-display current week.
• When viewing week tab, after scrolling away from your team's game, tap week number in header to re-scroll to preferred team's game.
• When viewing team tab, after navigating away from your team, tap team tab again to re-display your team.
• When viewing team tab, after scrolling away from the current week's game, tap team's helmet icon in header to re-scroll to current week's game.
• Tap on a team anywhere in the app to go to the team tab and view that team's schedule.
FEATURES
• Preseason, regular season and postseason games.
• View games per week and per team.
• View separate Thursday night, Sunday night and Monday night schedules.
• View NFL standings with won/loss record splits and current streak.
• View NFL playoff seeding.
• View complete bye weeks' schedule.
• App is styled in the user's selected NFL team colors.
• Preseason weeks are automatically hidden after the preseason ends.
• Gallery-based schedule navigation.
• Choose to use international-style date format instead of U.S. (setting)
• Choose to start the app showing the team tab. (setting)
• Game scoring includes a breakdown by quarter, but can be hidden. (setting)
• Won/Loss records...including home, away and division breakdown.
• Game times shown in your local time.
NFL FLEX SCHEDULING
The NFL uses flexible game time scheduling for Sunday games in weeks 5 thru 17.
A team's game time may be adjusted including who plays Sunday night. The NFL announces
changes at least 12 days before the week being changed (6 days in week 17).

bluejetty:00088501:ios.description:
Princess Dress Color: Bring Your Royal Dreams to Life!
Step into a magical world with Princess Dress Color, the ultimate coloring game where you can bring stunning princess outfits to life. Whether you love sparkling ball gowns, elegant tiaras, or dazzling accessories, this game is your ticket to creativity and enchantment.
Unleash Your Inner Fashion Designer
Princess Dress Color allows you to design royal masterpieces that reflect your unique style. Choose from a variety of princess dresses, accessories, and magical backdrops. Add vibrant colors, intricate patterns, and beautiful textures to create outfits fit for royalty.
Features of Princess Dress Color:
Diverse Gown Styles: From fairy tale princess gowns to wedding dresses, summer frocks, and ball gowns, there’s a design for every occasion.
Exquisite Accessories: Complete your looks with crowns, necklaces, earrings, gloves, heels, and handbags.
Dreamy Themed Backgrounds: Enhance your designs with enchanting backdrops like castle gardens, starry stages, romantic chapels, and magical forests.
Seasonal and Holiday Events: Join exclusive events for special, limited-edition outfits during Christmas, Halloween, and wedding seasons.
Soft Color Schemes: Enjoy beautiful, harmonious colors that suit elegant tastes.
High-Quality Details: Delve into intricately designed gowns and accessories with stunning textures and patterns.
Each themed gallery offers intricate dresses and accessories to spark your creativity and imagination. With hours of coloring fun ahead, you can craft beautiful, magical designs.
Wide Range of Beautiful Dresses
From classic ball gowns to modern fairy-tale dresses, explore a wide selection of princess outfits, each one a blank canvas for your artistic touch.
Relaxing Gameplay
Coloring is a soothing activity, and Princess Dress Color offers a relaxing experience with its easy-to-use interface. Lose yourself in a world of creativity and calm.
Save and Share
Show off your finished masterpieces by saving them in your gallery or sharing them with friends and family. Every design you create is a work of art to be proud of!
Why You’ll Love Princess Dress Color:
Perfect for Relaxation: Escape the hustle of everyday life and enjoy the peaceful process of coloring.
Ideal for Princess Fans: If you’ve always dreamed of a fairy tale life, this game will transport you to a world of magic and creativity.
Princess Dress Color is perfect for:
Those looking for a relaxing, creative outlet.
Fans of fashion design and art games.
Download Princess Dress Color Now!
Step into the world of royal fashion and experience the joy of coloring and design. Whether you’re crafting the perfect ball gown or adding sparkle to a tiara, every moment is filled with fun and creativity. Don’t wait—begin your royal journey today!

With a subscription, you’ll enjoy an ad-free experience (removing non-optional banners and interstitial ads), unlimited hints, and the ability to remove watermarks from your completed images.
We’re committed to providing you with a fun coloring experience. Enjoy coloring by number!

bluejetty:00182920:ios.name: Factory Balls
bluejetty:00182920:ios.summary: You might think that working on the assembly line is tedious work, but not if you're manufacturing Factory Balls! Your job in this logic puzzle game is to custom craft each ball. You've got all the tools you need to fulfill each order... ex
bluejetty:00182920:ios.description:
You might think that working on the assembly line is tedious work, but not if you're manufacturing Factory Balls! Your job in this logic puzzle game is to custom craft each ball. You've got all the tools you need to fulfill each order... except the instruction manual.
In each level, you'll see the target design of your ball on the shipping box. Starting from a plain white ball, get to work by clicking the tools you want to use and try to manufacture the correct ball.
For example, the target ball might be orange with white eyes and black pupils, which means you need to use different spectacles to block the paint and create the different patterns. Need to make a beak? Maybe you have to pull a few times with a pair of pliers.
There is no time limit or punishment for making incorrect moves, so you can try several different configurations to reach your goal.
If you enjoy a cerebral challenge and are keen for a mental workout, you will enjoy Factory Balls and the 200 original levels!
This is the official Factory Balls game by Bart Bonte/bontegames.

bluejetty:00095302:ios.description:

* Accurate & Reliable: Utilizes your device’s sensors to deliver precise directional readings.

* Flashlight: Illuminate your path when it gets dark.

Always know which way to go, no matter where your journey leads!

bluejetty:00065201:ios.description:
PBZ digital banking is your solution for banking on the go.
Imagine notifications in real time, an easy way to pay and send money anywhere you want in the world, full control of your finances at your fingertips. Great, right?
Join our satisfied customers and experience new and easier banking.
Open account online
Become a PBZ client online: open an account and sign up for digital banking via your mobile device in a few steps, simply and completely online. Start now by downloading the mobile application and soon you will be able to manage your finances whenever and wherever you want.
Control and manage your money
● Get notifications in real time for activities on your account, cards, savings, loans
● Withdraw money on ATMs wthout the card using #withCASH
● Round up every payment with Visa Inspire card and save from your spare change as you go with #withSAVE
● Set up your personal transaction limits
Pay quick and easy
● Make worldwide payments easier than ever before
● Make payments to friends at lightspeed #withPAY
● Use Apple Pay for fast, simple and contactless payments with your mobile phone and Visa Inspire card. It’s free.
● Pay to the selected recipients without additional authorization
● Scan 2 D barcode on your bills and pay online
Personalize your app
● Select TOP 5 shortcuts for the most commonly used functionalities
● Check the status of the selected account without loging in to the mobile app
● Use a fingerprint or face ID to quickly register and authorize transactions
Transfer money in the easier way
● Transfer money abroad in different currencies
● Set up direct debits and recurring payments in seconds
● Split the bill with friends and family and we’ll take care of the math
Safety & security
● All data related to accounts and PIN are not saved on the mobile phone
● After three repeated input of the wrong PIN, the app becomes inactive, which is further secured from unwanted access
● Biometric ID (fingerprint or face ID) is used for quicker and safer login and autorization of the transactions
● Your card transactions when shopping online are 3D Secure for additional authentication and fraud protection
You can use our app even if you're not our client so you'll have the overview of PBZ ATMs and branches as well as the Bank's contacts available when you need them.
PBZ digital banking is banking made easy.

PLAYING METHODS
-Control your little fish to swim freely on the bottom of the sea, up stream or diving.
-Wonderful adventures at the bottom of the sea, eating fish smaller than you and growing up.
-Bombs、healing items and other game props will appear randomly, making your survival war more intense and exciting.

bluejetty:00098144:ios.description:
Website: tos.neocraftstudio.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/sWNZcqPsE2
X: https://x.com/TreeofSaviorNEO
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/TreeofSaviorNEO
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/TreeofSaviorNeo/
"Where Ancient Tree Whispers Your Story..."
Embark on a heartfelt journey through the enchanting, vibrant world of Norn—a living MMORPG where bonds are forged, mysteries unfold, and every player can carve their own legend. Tree of Savior: NEO invites you into a realm of breathtaking beauty, deep storytelling, and warm community spirit.
YOUR JOURNEY, YOUR WAY
Create a Heroine Truly Your Own: With deep customization, design a character that reflects your unique style—from elegant spellcasters to graceful archers, each with intricate outfits, hairstyles, and expressions.
Build Your Home Away From Home: Design and decorate a cozy cottage using rare materials gathered across the world—a peaceful retreat to share with friends or guildmates.
FORGE MEANINGFUL CONNECTIONS
Vibrant Social World: Join a thriving community of adventurers. Trade, chat, form guilds, or even celebrate in-game weddings under the celestial World Tree.
Adopt Loyal Companions: Befriend mystical Cat Spirits and other enchanting creatures who will accompany and aid you on your journey.
EXPLORE A WORLD ALIVE WITH WONDER
Uncover Rich Stories & Landscapes: Traverse over 12 uniquely magical zones—from starlit forests to blossom-filled meadows—each with hidden lore, dynamic weather, and over 50 boss encounters filled with narrative depth.
Experience Living World Events: Chase exclusive glowing mounts during meteor showers, or uncover hidden treasures during sudden blizzards. The world responds to your presence.
TACTICAL & EXPRESSIVE GAMEPLAY
150+ Classes with Fluid Playstyles: Choose from a vast array of divine callings—not just to conquer, but to express. Heal allies with celestial light, weave nature magic, support with songs, or master strategic roles that value cleverness over pure force.
Cook, Craft & Contribute: Prepare feasts that buff your raid team, brew potent potions, and contribute meaningfully to your guild’s success through life skills that feel just as impactful as combat.
RAID & GROW—TOGETHER
Cooperative Dungeons & Raids: Team up for over 150 visually striking dungeons and epic encounters like the 72 Demon Gods—where strategy, teamwork, and timing triumph over brute force.
Join Cross-Server Festivities: Compete or collaborate in seasonal events, friendly tournaments, and guild-based island sieges that emphasize camaraderie and collective achievement.
A GAME THAT GROWS WITH YOU
Tree of Savior: NEO is designed to be a welcoming, enduring home for those who love:
Beautiful worlds full of mystery and magic
Characters with emotional depth and customizability
Forming friendships and communities that last
Playing at your own pace—whether that means intense raids or decorating your cottage under a virtual sunset

bluejetty:00027388:ios.name: Meu Auxílio
bluejetty:00027388:ios.summary: Com o aplicativo Meu Auxílio, você pode acompanhar facilmente a situação do seu Auxílio Emergencial, Novo Bolsa Família ou Auxílio Brasil, Auxílio Gás entre outros benefícios fornecidos. Consulte seu cadastro e confira a data correta de pag
bluejetty:00027388:ios.description:
Com o aplicativo Meu Auxílio, você pode acompanhar facilmente a situação do seu Auxílio Emergencial, Novo Bolsa Família ou Auxílio Brasil, Auxílio Gás entre outros benefícios fornecidos. Consulte seu cadastro e confira a data correta de pagamento do seu benefício. Abaixo confira os melhores recursos:
Com o Meu Auxílio, você poderá consultar as parcelas já disponibilizadas pelo Auxílio Brasil ou Bolsa Família no portal da transparência. As parcelas disponíveis para consulta são aquelas que já foram concedidas pelo benefício, ou seja, os pagamentos já recebidos. 
Na aba de calendário, localizada na parte superior da tela, você poderá conferir seu dígito NIS e, logo abaixo, visualizar o dia de pagamento do mês atual, bem como o calendário completo de pagamentos do benefício Auxílio Brasil e Calendário Bolsa Família 2025.
Cálculo de Frete, insira um cep de origem e cep de destino, insira as dimensões do pacote para calcular quanto será gasto no envio de encomendas.
Situação cadastral do CPF, consulte a situação cadastral, o comprovante emitido não apresenta dados sobre a condição econômica, financeira ou fiscal do titular do CPF, servindo apenas para atestar a situação cadastral no CPF.
Por razões de segurança, não é possível consultar os valores do benefício no aplicativo. No entanto, você pode verificar as informações de cadastro do beneficiário ao inserir um número válido de NIS.
Para conferir a data de pagamento do seu benefício, basta acessar a aba Calendário e selecionar seu dígito NIS. A data será informada de acordo com o mês atual.
Para mais informações sobre o aplicativo, consulte nossa Política de Privacidade: 
https://www.estoqueapps.com/política-de-privacidade
Baixe agora o Meu Auxílio e tenha todas as informações sobre o seu benefício na palma da sua mão. Não perca mais tempo e mantenha-se sempre atualizado sobre o seu Auxílio.

PDF Editor: Scan, Convert & Sign Documents
Working with PDFs should feel simple and efficient.
PDF Editor helps you scan documents, edit PDFs, convert files, and sign documents—all in one easy-to-use app. Whether you're managing work files, study materials, or personal documents, everything stays organized and accessible.
All-in-One PDF Editor & Scanner
Edit, merge, convert, and manage your PDFs with a smooth workflow designed for everyday use.
Edit, Merge & Organize PDFs
Stay in control of your files with powerful editing tools:
• Add text and annotations to PDFs
• Merge multiple PDFs into one file
• Split large PDFs into smaller sections
• Reorder, rotate, or delete pages
• Manage pages with simple controls
Perfect for organizing documents, notes, and reports.
Sign & Protect Documents
Handle important files securely:
• Add signatures to forms and documents
• Set passwords to protect sensitive PDFs
• Open password-protected files
Convert Files to PDF
Use a fast PDF converter while keeping formatting consistent:
• Image to PDF
• Text to PDF
• Word to PDF
• Excel to PDF
Scan Documents Anytime
Turn your device into a portable PDF scanner:
• Scan receipts, notes, and documents
• Automatic edge detection for clear scans
• Adjust, crop, and enhance scans
• Save instantly as PDF files
Import Files from Multiple Sources
Access your documents easily:
• Files app
• Photos
• iCloud Drive
• Dropbox
• Import via URL
(Third-party services are supported for import functionality only. 
This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by these services.)
Read or Listen to PDFs
Review documents your way:
• Smooth PDF reader with zoom and navigation
• Listen with built-in text-to-speech
Organize Your Files Efficiently
Keep everything structured:
• Rename, move, or duplicate files
• Create folders
• Search by file name or type
Share & Print Easily
• Share via Mail, AirDrop, or other apps
• Print documents directly
Privacy-Focused Experience
Your documents are handled with care, focusing on reliable performance and respecting your privacy.

From the same makers of the #1 C25K® Trainer app, Half Marathon Trainer follows the same successful recipe to create an easy simple 13.1 (21k) program. Ideal for first-time beginners and those who are new to running a half marathon. The program uses a blend of running and power walking in training and racing. You’ll soon be able to run-walk the entire half marathon.

◉ Train to complete a full 13.1 (21k) half marathon using a RUN/WALK ratio

Don’t think that just because walking is involved that your time will be slower or that you'll be accomplishing less. Many veteran runners have posted personal best times after switching to this run walk method! Using a ratio of running and walking will better manage your fatigue and give you the muscle resource and mental confidence to handle the later parts of the race.
Turn on our award winning music and just press start! Our audio coach will guide you through your run! It's that easy!
≈ Less is More ≈
◎ Easy to learn. Just press start!
◎ Ideal for beginners.

With drag & drop on iPad, drag colors out into other
bluejetty:00070427:ios.description:
Capture and collect color palettes with Pastel!
Pastel is an app for amateur developers & artists (like us!) that lets you build up a library of color palettes to use in your projects.
With drag & drop on iPad, drag colors out into other apps that support dropped colors, like Pages and Keynote, or many third-party apps from your favorite developers, so you can use your Pastel library as your master color collection across apps.
Seamlessly sync your library across devices with iCloud.
Analyze photos from the photo library or from Files to determine their dominant colors — choosing specific colors manually if you wish — and save their color palettes to Pastel.
Includes a variety of color pickers, like wheel, RGB sliders, and crayons, or pick named colors from your color library that you curate yourself. On iPad, drag and drop from the sidebar to any palette.
Copy a variety of developer-focused code representations, like RGB, hex, Objective-C, Swift and SwiftUI. Paste hex codes into the sliders color picker.
Copy a pixel bitmap representation of a palette to paste into your favorite pixel editor, share a screen-sized version to set as your wallpaper or Apple Watch face, or export a palette to Procreate®.
Create beautiful, colorful wallpapers in various different 2D & 3D styles using Pastel's wallpaper creator.
In the free version, try out the built-in library, and add your own palettes up to a limit of 8 items total. Upgrade to the unlimited version using in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00074466:ios.description:
Let Kinsa guide you from the first sign of sickness through recovery and beyond! As seen in Apple’s “Parenthood” commercial, Parents Magazine, USA Today, Good Morning America, The New York Times, CBS This Morning, and more!
KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT
Our care recommendations give you peace of mind with age-specific fever and symptom guidance - so you can know when it’s important to take extra precaution or see a doctor.
REMEMBERS FOR YOU
Easily track temperatures, symptoms and medication for everyone in your family! Remember details such as when symptoms began, how high the fever got, or when to give another dose of medication and share it with another caregiver or your doctor. Temperature data integrates seamlessly with HealthKit and the Health app.
WHAT PARENTS ARE SAYING
“The app tracks and organizes our family’s temps and symptoms and keeps the history. This is a wonderful app for a busy and sleep deprived mom!” 
“Hands down my favorite feature is that the app gives you suggestions on how to keep your little one comfortable and gives practical advice for a speedy recovery!”
“The Kinsa app keeps all my data in one place and makes doctors appointments a breeze…”
“We are a family of 6! Kinsa helps us keep track of everyone’s medical situation!”
“This has to be one of the best products on the market for families, especially families with little ones!” 
The free Kinsa app works best with Kinsa's award-winning, pediatrician-recommended QuickCare, QuickScan, and Smart Ear thermometers, available for purchase online and in retail stores across the U.S. If you have an older Smart Stick thermometer that plugs into the headphone jack of your phone, please use the Kinsa Smart Stick app instead. 
We hope your family doesn't get sick, but if they do, we'll be there to help your family feel better faster!
All information, images, and other content shared through Kinsa’s mobile or web applications is for informational purposes only and is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment from an appropriately qualified and licensed physician or other healthcare provider. Always seek the advice of a qualified healthcare provider with any questions you may have regarding your health, including any symptoms that are severe or concerning. If you are having a medical emergency, call 911 or the number for the local emergency ambulance service. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking medical treatment because of something you have read on or accessed through this application.

bluejetty:00035262:ios.name: SubTime - Sub Timer & Rotation
bluejetty:00035262:ios.summary:
Trusted by more than 60,000 coaches and used for over 600,000 games.
Coaching should be about your players and the game - not trying to remember who needs to come off, who has played the longest, or when the next substitution should happen
bluejetty:00035262:ios.description:
Trusted by more than 60,000 coaches and used for over 600,000 games.
Coaching should be about your players and the game - not trying to remember who needs to come off, who has played the longest, or when the next substitution should happen.
SubTime takes the stress out of game-day management. Built for youth sports coaches, it helps you manage playing time, plan substitutions, organize lineups, track game events, and keep your coaching team on the same page - all from one app.
GIVE EVERY PLAYER FAIR PLAYING TIME
No more guessing who has played the most.
The game clock and sub timer run together, so you see each player's playing and bench time at a glance throughout the match. SubTime makes it easier to balance minutes, spot who is due for a rest, and give every player a fair opportunity to participate.
It's especially useful for youth coaches who want to keep playing time transparent and avoid the post-game question: "Why didn't my child play more?"
TAKE THE STRESS OUT OF SUBSTITUTIONS
Plan your substitutions before the game or manage them as the action unfolds.
SubTime shows who's currently playing, who's on the bench, and who should come on next - so you can make changes without losing focus on the match. Auto Plan also works mid-game, so you can rebuild the rotation after a late arrival or an injury.
ARRIVE WITH A GAME PLAN
Build your roster, mark attendance, assign player positions, and prepare your starting lineup before kickoff.
Pick a standard formation or build a custom one, then save your favorite lineups and reuse them for future games.
You can also plan your rotation in advance: either create your own substitution plan or use the Auto Plan feature to generate one that spreads playing time evenly.
DEALING WITH THE UNEXPECTED
Game day rarely goes to plan, and SubTime has been fine-tuned over years of real matches to cope.
A player arrives late. Someone picks up an injury. You make a substitution in the heat of the moment and forget to record it. A guest player turns up to fill a gap in the squad.
Rework the squad, the rotation, and the record - adjust as you go or amend after the game, without restarting or losing what you've already tracked.
TRACK THE GAME WHILE YOU COACH
Record events as they happen - goals, assists, cards, substitutions, and custom events of your own.
When the final whistle goes, everything is already organized. Review playing time, player participation, game history, and season statistics without rebuilding it from memory. Game history and player stats export to CSV for club reporting, auditing, or season records.
COACH TOGETHER WITH SUBTIME LIVE
Game management doesn't have to fall on one person.
Share your team with assistant coaches and team managers. With SubTime Live, multiple coaches can collaborate during the same game - one manages substitutions while another tracks events. Family and friends can follow along as viewers, at the field or from home.
FOR CLUBS AND MULTIPLE TEAMS
Running more than one team? SubTime Club links your club's teams together, lets you view and export game history and player stats across every squad, and lets you buy SubTime access for club teams in bulk at discounted rates.
Details at https://www.subtimeapp.com/club
IS MY SPORT SUPPORTED?
Pick your sport and SubTime is already set up for it: soccer/football, futsal, basketball, lacrosse, rugby, and field hockey.
Coaching something else? Build a custom sport with your own positions and events - netball, or however your team plays.
SUBSCRIPTION
SubTime is free to use for games up to 40 minutes. A paid subscription is required to record games longer than 40 minutes, to use SubTime Live game sharing, and for advanced Auto Plan features.
Privacy policy: https://www.subtimeapp.com/appprivacypolicy
Terms and conditions (EULA): https://www.subtimeapp.com/general-8

bluejetty:00100673:ios.description:
Transform your iPhone into a portable mobile fax machine with the eFax® app. 
- Designed specifically for our eFax® Plus, eFax®Pro and eFax®Protect subscribers
- Enjoy mobile faxing wherever you are without the need for a fax machine
- Send and receive faxes directly from your iPhone or iPad. 
- Secure and reliable faxing ensures your documents are transmitted safely.
- Hassle-free online fax service with a user-friendly interface
- No set-up fees or long-term commitment 
FAQs
Q. Can I send a fax from my iPhone?
A. Yes, you can receive and send a fax from your iPhone using the eFax® app. Simply download the app, register your account, and start faxing.
Q. What is eFax®
A. eFax® is the official digital, cloud-based fax brand service, that enables you to fax online without requiring a physical fax machine, supplies or dedicated phone line. 
Q. Does eFax® offer other online faxing options beside the mobile app?
A. Yes. eFax subscribers can also send and receive faxes from the eFax web portal and even fax by email with no fax machine required. 
Q. Is there a free fax app for iPhone? 
A. The eFax® mobile app is included at no extra cost with an eFax® subscription. New users can download the app and sign up through iTunes (USA only) or the eFax® website.
Q. Why choose eFax® 
A. eFax® is the official online fax brand and a global online fax leader serving 25M+ users since 1995
eFax® subscription details: The $16.99 (USD) monthly subscription fee includes a personal fax number and 300 fax pages per month. The fee will be charged through iTunes when you confirm your purchase in the app. You can manage your subscription in your iTunes account. Your monthly subscription will renew automatically unless your subscription is canceled in your iTunes account by turning off auto-renew 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged $16.99 for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. No cancellation of the current month allowed during the active subscription period. For further terms and conditions see https://www.efax.com/legal#agreement.
Download the eFax® faxing app and start faxing in minutes

bluejetty:00024387:ios.name: Hidmont - Hidden objects games
bluejetty:00024387:ios.summary:
Immerse yourself in the world of hidden objects games and puzzle game genres with Hidmont! Only 1% of people can successfully look and find hidden objects and solve puzzles, but with Hidmont, you can be one of them!
Play riddles and brain
bluejetty:00024387:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of hidden objects games and puzzle game genres with Hidmont! Only 1% of people can successfully look and find hidden objects and solve puzzles, but with Hidmont, you can be one of them!
Play riddles and brain teasers whenever you're feeling stressed or anxious. Get ready for an exciting journey with this challenging find missing objects game that will test your skills and keep you unique! This puzzle quest is a definite mind storm that includes all your favorite search and find games!
Feel the atmosphere of a new adventure with our finding object games for free:
- Use hints if you're deeply confused. The levels become harder as you progress, developing your mind and brain skills.
- Hidmont will be a real challenge for you, guaranteeing lots of fun with our hog games!
- Train your brain and attentiveness by using all your detective and observational skills to find more than 15 elements in every picture with our find items in pictures games!
- Play with your friends and family by passing all the way to the finish line together!
- Enjoy magnificent themes that capture your imagination with a house, nature, city, detective, and fun in our find pictures games!
- Compete and have fun by being faster than your friends! Use tips to win the race and get your bonus level!
Hidmont features:
- Simple intuitive user-friendly interface allows you to enjoy finding elements.
- Regular updates including brand new levels to complete.
- Explore 3500+ locations with highly-detailed art graphics.
- Collect at least a star to move on to the next challenge.
- Countdown to make the game dynamic and immersive.
- Hint system to make it easier to find all hidden objects in the pictures.
- Daily challenge.
Use helpful hints and stay tuned! Relax your mind and play our addictive and challenging hidden objects games free. 
Welcome to an addictive and challenging journey where you can seek items and feel like a first-mover as Sherlock Holmes or Ariadne Oliver. 
Become an object finder and make your day brighter with Hidmont! Join the Hidmont community on Instagram (https://instagram.com/hidmontgame?utm_medium=copy_link) and Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/hidmontgame/) to stay up-to-date with the latest news and updates. 
We make our brain teasers with the soul, so join us now!

bluejetty:00019518:ios.description:
VPN - Super Unlimited Proxy is a free VPN and proxy app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro. Connect in one tap and enjoy unlimited bandwidth and fast speeds, no account or sign-up required. Optional Premium plans add 10Gbps speeds, streaming-optimized servers, and more server locations. With 1B+ downloads, VPN Super is built for everyday browsing, streaming, gaming, and staying protected on public WiFi.
FREE VPN FEATURES
- Unlimited VPN: no time limits or usage caps
- 40+ free server locations, including 20+ US cities
- Enterprise-grade encryption for maximum security
- Kill Switch: Protect your IP address and data from being exposed if your VPN drops
- Strict no-activity-logs policy
- Multiple VPN protocols (V2Ray in select locations)
- Works on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision with iOS 16.0 or later
HOW DOES A VPN WORK?
A VPN (virtual private network) creates an encrypted tunnel between your device and a VPN server. Your traffic is routed through that server, so websites see the server's IP address instead of yours. People use a VPN to:
- Encrypt their connection on public Wi-Fi networks
- Keep their browsing activity less visible to their internet service provider
- Use messaging apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, and Discord
- Use social apps like Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Snapchat, X, and Reddit
- Watch streaming services like Netflix, HBO Max, Hulu, and YouTube
- Play mobile games like PUBG Mobile, Call of Duty: Mobile, Free Fire, Genshin Impact, Pokemon GO, Roblox, Minecraft, Fortnite, Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, Honor of Kings, Clash of Kings, Rise of Kingdoms, and Plato
WHO IS VPN SUPER FOR?
- Anyone looking for a free VPN for iPhone with no data caps or time limits
- Travelers and students using public Wi-Fi hotspots at airports, hotels, cafes, and campuses
- Mobile gamers connecting to game servers in other regions
VPN PROTOCOLS
VPN Super supports OpenVPN, IKEv2, and V2Ray. Protocol access vary by location. With Auto Mode, the app selects the fastest protocol for your network.
VPN SERVER LOCATIONS
3,000+ servers in 60+ countries:
- North America: United States (34+ cities), Canada (3 cities), Mexico
- Europe: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Moldova, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Russia, Serbia, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Ukraine, United Kingdom (3 cities)
- Asia Pacific: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Japan, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Vietnam, Thailand, and more
- Central Asia: Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan
- Middle East: Israel, Turkey
- South America: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Peru
- Africa: Egypt, South Africa, Nigeria
FREE VS PREMIUM
Premium users get everything included in the free version, plus:
- 10Gbps servers for up to 10x faster speeds
- Exclusive access to our apps for Mac, Apple TV, and more
- Full server fleet of 65+ countries
- Streaming-optimized servers
- No ad breaks
- VPN protection on up to 10 devices
PREMIUM PLANS
- Weekly: $9.99/week
- Monthly: $11.99/month
- Yearly: $79.99/year
Plans may have a free trial period for new users.
FAQs
Is VPN Super a free VPN?
Yes. The free VPN version includes unlimited bandwidth and access to 40+ server locations.
Do I need an account?
No. Just download the VPN app and tap connect.
Does VPN Super keep logs?
No. We follow a strict no-activity-logs policy. More details are in our Privacy Notice.
How many devices can I use VPN Super on?
With Premium, you can cover up to 10 devices with one subscription.
PRIVACY COMMITMENT
VPN - Super Unlimited Proxy is committed to privacy with zero activity logs. We don't collect or retain any information that could compromise your online security.
- Privacy Notice: https://www.vpnsuper.com/privacy-notice
- Terms of Use: https://www.vpnsuper.com/terms-of-service

Revive Grandpa’s dusty drive-thru on America’s legendary Route 66, serve hungry travelers, expand with motels, restrooms, EV chargers and a convenience store, then outsmart rival Victor to b
bluejetty:00153540:ios.description:
Drive Thru Tycoon – Idle Route 66 Roadside Empire
Revive Grandpa’s dusty drive-thru on America’s legendary Route 66, serve hungry travelers, expand with motels, restrooms, EV chargers and a convenience store, then outsmart rival Victor to become the ultimate highway entrepreneur.
FAST-MOVING IDLE GAMEPLAY
• Tap to serve burgers, fries, shakes and coffee.
• Upgrade ordering counters, hire order crew and watch wait-times shrink.
• Earn money even while offline—return to a pile of cash ready to reinvest.
BUILD A FULL SERVICE STOP
Travelers need more than food:
• Motel – Add comfy rooms, faster check-in and evening bonuses.
• Restroom – Keep facilities spotless for bigger tips.
• EV Charging Station – Install ultra-fast chargers to attract modern drivers.
• Convenience Store – Stock snacks, drinks and souvenirs for extra revenue.
STRATEGIC UPGRADES
• Automate cash collection with Safe-O-Matic systems.
• Unlock Express Kitchen, Fast Check-In and Turbo Cleaning to speed every business.
• Improve roads, signage and visitor magnetism to boost traffic flow.
PROGRESS, MILESTONES & BOOSTERS
• Collect Stars to unlock new side businesses.
• Earn Crystals and Hammers at key levels, then upgrade powerful cards in the Workshop for global bonuses.
• Prestige to reset, gaining permanent income multipliers.
FACE OFF AGAINST VICTOR
Victor Steele wants to buy you out—refuse, survive his sabotage events, and prove that passion beats corporate muscle on Route 66.
KEY FEATURES
• Satisfying idle tycoon loop—easy to start, deep to master.
• Stylish 2D cartoon art with a sun-baked desert backdrop.
• Offline earnings, limited-time events and seasonal challenges.
• Game Center achievements and leaderboards to compare scores with friends.
Download Drive Thru Tycoon today, turn a forgotten diner into a bustling roadside empire, and own the highway—one burger at a time!

bluejetty:00159699:ios.description:
Free and unlimited forever
Create polls, vote, and view the results directly in iMessage
—— How it works ——
• Create polls, vote, and view the results in iMessage
• Updates to the poll are shown at the bottom of your conversation and update live for everyone to see
—— Features ——
Customize Polls with 4 new controls:
• See Who Voted: Leave it on to let everyone see who is voting on what. Toggle it off to keep it anonymous 
• Edit Poll: Leave it on to let everyone help with the poll, or toggle it off and you’re the boss, no one else can edit
• Multiple Votes: Leave it on, sometimes we like more than one thing, so let people like multiple options. Toggle it off and friends can only vote on one option, but can change their vote if they need to
• Declare a Winner: Leave it on and the winner will be declared once everyone votes. Toggle it off, when everyone votes on your poll everything stays the same, just no confetti
- Create a picture poll with photos from your camera roll
- Smart Calendar helps you coordinate, if you type a date, we’ll make it look pretty
- Add links to polls, like Yelp for restaurants or Airbnbs for rentals
- New cards give you even more space for more awesome options
—— Team ——
Jeff Hanna, Kevin Hanna, Dominic King
—— Business Development ——
Interested in working with us? You can reach us at partner@pollsforimessage.com

bluejetty:00032766:ios.name: Frontline Heroes: WW2 Warfare
bluejetty:00032766:ios.summary: Immerse yourself in the intense battlegrounds of World War II with Frontline Heroes: WW2 Warfare, a gripping single-player FPS game that puts you in the boots of young American soldiers experiencing the brutal realities of world war. Get re
bluejetty:00032766:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the intense battlegrounds of World War II with Frontline Heroes: WW2 Warfare, a gripping single-player FPS game that puts you in the boots of young American soldiers experiencing the brutal realities of world war. Get ready for heart-pounding action shooter as you embark on daring landing missions, engage in frontline trench warfare, and defend strategic bases against relentless enemy forces. Join the army of war heroes and lead your squad to victory in this epic WW2 shooter!
Historically Accurate WWII Setting:
Step into the boots of a young American soldier in Frontline Heroes: WW2 Warfare, where you'll witness the chaos of war unfold across meticulously recreated battle zones in Europe. From the D-Day landings to the harsh frontline trench warfare, every detail reflects the historical accuracy of World War 2. Experience the intensity of warfare as you fight for victory in this authentic WW2 shooter game.
Daring Landing Missions:
Experience the adrenaline rush of storming enemy-held beaches in this World War 2 game. Engage in daring landing missions where you strategically plan your assault, overcome obstacles, and engage in intense firefights as you push forward against enemy forces. The fate of the war rests on your shoulders in this gripping WW2 shooter game.
Trench Wars:
Navigate the treacherous trenches and engage in close-quarter combat as you fight for every inch of ground. Feel the tension rise as you confront the enemy face to face on the frontline, using authentic WWII weapons to gain the upper hand. Adapt to the ever-changing battlefield conditions to survive and triumph.
Base Defense:
Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding action of gun shooting games with Frontline Heroes. Commandeer strategic bases and defend them against waves of enemy forces hell-bent on breaking your line. Utilize a variety of weapons, fortifications, and teamwork to repel the enemy and secure victory in this thrilling shooting game. Your tactical decisions will shape the outcome of the battle as you take on the role of a sniper in the frontline defense.
Key Features:
Frontline Heroes: WW2 Warfare immerses you in the sights and sounds of World War 2, offering detailed graphics and a realistic world war shooting gaming experience.
Diverse Mission Objectives: From stealthy infiltration to all-out assaults, each mission offers a unique and challenging experience.
Historically Inspired Weapons: Equip yourself with a vast arsenal of weapons used during the era, each with its strengths and weaknesses.
Engaging Storyline: Follow the journey of world war heroes as they navigate the challenges of war, shooting at enemies and freeing European territories.
Become a Frontline Hero: Are you ready to rewrite history and become a legend on the frontlines of World War II? Download Frontline Heroes now and experience the ultimate FPS shooter adventure on your mobile device. The fate of the world is in your hands!

bluejetty:00046434:ios.description:
The Unofficial Guide is an independent application and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by The Villages.
The Unofficial Guide is your comprehensive companion for navigating and enjoying everything The Villages, Florida has to offer.
This latest version comes packed with exciting new features and improvements, including an enhanced user interface for easier navigation, updated points of interest, and real-time community event listings. Discover all The Villages have to offer: recreation centers, golf courses, music, activities and so much more.
Save your favorites, and stay informed about what's happening in the community. Whether you're a long-time resident, new to the community, or just visiting, our guide is designed to help you make the most of your time in The Villages.
Key Features:
-- Entertainment-First Focus: Our guide is 100% focused on lifestyle and entertainment. We are an independent resource dedicated to helping you enjoy The Villages, not a real estate tool.
-- Powerful Activity Search: Instantly search through thousands of daily activities, events, and entertainment listings to find exactly what you're looking for, right from the 'Community' screen.
-- Community Ratings & Reviews: Rate bands, restaurants, and activities to keep track of what you love. See what's popular in the community with transparent, user-driven ratings.
-- Personalized Favorites: Favorite your top bands, places, and activities to create a personalized dashboard. Never miss an event from your favorites again.
-- Calendar Integration: Effortlessly add any event or activity directly to your phone's calendar with a single tap, so you never miss a show or your favorite activity.

bluejetty:00073158:ios.description:
What is SPEAKTOR?
SPEAKTOR is a text to speech converter that takes any text file, turns it into a speech, and reads it to you. This AI-powered text to speech app converts any written word into a speech.
Speech has become more convenient to consume and share thoughts and ideas. The digital world sees more of this conversion through text to speech converters. The emergence of text to speak converters has made it easier for all kinds from researchers to travelers tirelessly waiting at the airport. There are multiple benefits of the text to speak communication. TTS can be excellent for businesses that operate at a fast pace.
Why do People Love SPEAKTOR?
See the speech synthesizer read aloud for you
Convert English text to speech to be more productive
Automatically convert text to voice within minutes with the natural reader
Work faster in school and work with the text to speak converter
SPEAKTORS text reader can help you read any article
Listen to lessons and books with text to voice converter
Scan a book and watch SPEAKTOR read out loud
Has a built-in screen reader
It takes SPEAKTOR only minutes to scan and read text
I want an app to read to me!
Do you want to listen to a book on the go but don't have time or simply don’t like reading? Have you ever thought, “I wish someone would read to me”? Then SPEAKTOR is for you.

bluejetty:00185090:ios.description:

* Kids friendly content without violence or scary treatments
* Made for kids of ages 6-8, but everyone will enjoy playing in this universe.
Are you ready to begin your space adventure? Get started now by downloading this app!

bluejetty:00182897:ios.name: Gravity Rider Zero
bluejetty:00182897:ios.summary:
Here there are no upgrade parts, no difficulty spikes or races against overpowered vehicles: every track is perfectly balanced so you can always beat it right now, using your favorite ride.
MAKE YOUR WAY OVER OBSTACLES
In this bike balanci
bluejetty:00182897:ios.description:
Here there are no upgrade parts, no difficulty spikes or races against overpowered vehicles: every track is perfectly balanced so you can always beat it right now, using your favorite ride.
MAKE YOUR WAY OVER OBSTACLES
In this bike balancing game, you will be climbing over obstacles, discovering new clever mechanics and trials to overcome in each level. 
Giant ramps, lasers, spikes, or good old gravity will try to get in your way. No sweat though, your vehicle has the perfect speed to pass through - with a bit of finesse, you will be fine and not fall off.
DOZENS OF HI-TECH PROTOTYPES TO RIDE
Collect dozens of unique racing vehicles with futuristic designs. Unlock new bikes by completing tasks, beating challenges or breaking track records: there’s always a new objective and a new reward to look forward to. From trials bikes to ATVs, WW2 era motorbikes to space rockets, they’re all in there.
NO GRINDING
Here’s a list of what you won’t find in Gravity Rider Zero:
- No overpriced upgrade parts
- No grinding
- No tickets
- No time gates
- No difficulty spikes
- No artificial difficulty 
- No limited garage space. 
WHAT YOU WANT, WHERE YOU WANT
You can unlock all the racing cars and bikes you want. You can dash on your moto, mmx buggy or quad whenever you want. You can speed with them on any track you want - their stats are always perfectly balanced for the race you’re in. Yep, no secret ultimate cheat bike, no special wheels of doom - here, all motorcycles are good.
IT’S ALL YOU
The controls in Gravity Rider Zero are simple and precise. Accelerate and tilt your bike in the right places to pass over obstacles faster. Brake in time to avoid traps. Always tilt after a jump to touch the ground earlier and gain more traction. Brake before a jump to minimize your air time, try and try again. 
Or, just focus on making sure you pass obstacles, don’t crash and beat the level. Bike racing is a customizable experience: you decide how deep you want the mechanics to be.
FULL CAREER MODE
Enjoy a classic solo career progression system: you get enough lives to clear 3 stages and then move onto the next world. Each new world features a new gimmick, and you will see a planets’ load of environments. That’s not an image: you will literally travel from planet to planet to face the craziest tracks in the universe. Oh and of course, your vehicle stats will increase along the way: it’s all balanced, but you will get faster.
COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE 
Admire and customize your vehicle collection. Give your race car a new paint job, give your motorbike a different color, or upgrade your kart with a neon lights trail. Even if your motorcycle is always perfectly tuned, that doesn’t mean you cannot upgrade your style!
JUST CHILL 
Gravity Rider Zero is all about two things: getting cool rides, and pure racing. That’s how we do things here, in the career mode. We focus on what matters, and to heck with the fluff. You want to optimize your turns, race against the clock, get the best time? You can.
You want to take your time getting through creative levels? You can too.
Just enjoy the ride and pop a wheelie. :)
Got a question? Contact us at support@vividgames.com
By downloading the game you accept our End User License Agreement, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: http://support.vividgames.com/policies

apple-itunes:391304000.name: Maps 3D PRO - Hike & Bike
apple-itunes:391304000.description:
Maps 3D PRO – Explore the outdoors in beautiful 3D
Plan, discover, and navigate your next outdoor adventure with maps that reveal the landscape as it really is. Unlike traditional flat maps, Maps 3D PRO lets you explore mountains, valleys, trails, and terrain in immersive 3D, making it easier to understand the landscape before you head out.
Whether you're hiking, cycling, trail running, skiing, or simply exploring new places, Maps 3D PRO helps you plan smarter, stay oriented, and—even far from mobile coverage—calculate entirely new routes offline.
Professional outdoor maps in 3D
Maps 3D PRO combines detailed topographic maps with realistic 3D terrain to give you a better understanding of the world around you.
– Beautiful 3D terrain visualization
– Detailed outdoor and topographic maps
– Smooth map navigation and intuitive controls
– Search for towns, streets, mountain peaks, lakes, and more
– Worldwide map coverage
Plan your adventures
Everything you need to prepare for your next trip.
– Create and edit routes directly on the map
– View elevation profiles before you go
– Measure distance and elevation gain
– Record your GPS tracks with precise elevation data
– Review and analyze completed tours
Explore offline
Go beyond offline maps. Maps 3D PRO doesn't just let you view maps without a connection—it also lets you calculate entirely new routes offline. Even in remote mountains, forests, or national parks, you can continue planning your adventure without mobile coverage.
– Worldwide offline maps
– Full offline route calculation
– GPS recording with precise elevation data
– Offline map search
– Reliable navigation anywhere
– Save battery by using pre-downloaded maps
Import and share
Take your adventures with you wherever you go.
– Import GPX tracks from many sources
– Export recorded routes
– Share your adventures with friends and family
Trusted by millions of outdoor enthusiasts
For more than a decade, Maps 3D PRO has helped more than 2.5 million outdoor enthusiasts explore the world in realistic 3D. Whether you're planning your next hiking trip, cycling tour, or weekend adventure, Maps 3D PRO gives you the tools to explore with confidence.
Why Maps 3D PRO?
– Realistic 3D terrain for a better understanding of the landscape
– Worldwide offline maps for reliable adventures anywhere
– Unique offline route calculation—even without mobile coverage
– Powerful route planning and GPS recording
– GPX import and export
– Fast, intuitive, and built specifically for outdoor adventures
Award-winning app
– Featured by Apple with a main banner in the US App Store Navigation category
– 3rd Place – Best App Ever Awards (148Apps), Best Outdoor App
– Reached #1 in the Navigation category in more than 75 countries
For over a decade, Maps 3D PRO has been one of the world's leading 3D outdoor navigation apps, trusted by millions of hikers, cyclists, runners, skiers, and outdoor enthusiasts.
Notes
– Continued use of GPS running in the background can reduce battery life.
– Download maps before your trip to use all offline features.
Thank you for using Maps 3D PRO. We are continuously improving the app and always appreciate your feedback.

apple-itunes:6737522164.name: Map Canvas: Draw on Maps
apple-itunes:6737522164.description:
Map Canvas is a tool for drawing and collaboration on Apple Maps. 
Key features:
1. Tools for creating lines, polygons, circles, map pins and text on the map.
2. Create journals with photos and drawings for maps. 
3. Google Maps as an alternative map engine.
4. Collaboration via iCloud.
5. Map templates of countries and regions overlays for illustrations.
6. Current weather and forecast for the marked locations.
7. GeoJSON, KML and GPX files import.
8. GeoJSON and KML export.

apple-itunes:406889139.name: Coin Master
apple-itunes:406889139.description:
Join your Facebook friends and millions of players around the world for prize-winning spins as you build village after village on your journey to the top!
Do you have what it takes to be the next Coin Master?
Get ready to team up with friends for thrilling expeditions or join forces with a crew of fellow players. You’ll always find a new adventure with an ever-changing lineup of special events, packed with unique challenges and exciting surprises to keep you on your toes!
Spin and Attack!
Spin the wheel to discover your fortune- or attack friends' villages and steal their coins to help build your own! You can also win gold sacks to build magnificent villages throughout the game and advance through thousands of levels. Don't forget to win shields from the wheel too—you'll need them to guard your village from other players trying to attack you back! Become the Coin Master with the most impressive villages and the most incredible prizes!
Embark on Fun Expeditions with Friends!
Earning coins from the prize wheel isn’t the only way to gather resources—you can find them on exciting expeditions too! Team up with friends to journey to other villages and uncover treasures that will help you build and advance to the next level. You never know what wonders you'll find in the next world you explore!
Collect all the Cards!
It's not always about the coins; it's about the treasure too! Collecting cards completes sets and unlocks the next village in your grand adventure. With thousands of villages to create and build, each completed set is a step forward in your journey. With every village you master, your wins will be even greater.
Play and Create Teams with Friends!
Trade your cards with our online community to collect them all! Join our fast-growing interactive Facebook community to meet new friends, create your dream team, earn big rewards, and trade treasures to help each other build and progress faster!
Coin Master is free on all devices with in-app purchases
Coin Master is intended for amusement purposes only and does not offer ‘real money’ gambling, or an opportunity to win real money or real prizes based on game play. 
Coin Master does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game. You can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
